en: to use something in a way that helps you
exampleEn: We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.
exampleCn: 我们需要确保尽可能充分利用资源。

en: to keep or continue to have something
exampleEn: She has lost her battle to retain control of the company.
exampleCn: 她被打败了，失去了继续掌管公司的权力。

en: basic
exampleEn: Her knowledge is still only rudimentary.
exampleCn: 她仍然只是粗通皮毛。

en: in a way that is simultaneous (= happening or being done at exactly the same time)
exampleEn: Two children answered the teacher's question simultaneously.
exampleCn: 两个孩子同时回答了老师的问题。

cn: 与众不同的，独特的，特别的
en: Something that is distinctive is easy to recognize because it is different from other things.
exampleEn: The unusual-looking leaves give the plant its distinctive appearance.
exampleCn: 不同寻常的叶子赋予了这种植物独特的外观。

en: happening after something else
exampleEn: The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from politics.
exampleCn: 书中讲述了他患病及随后隐退政坛的事。

cn: 周围地区；邻近地区；附近
en: the area around a place or where the speaker is
exampleEn: There are several hotels in the immediate vicinity of the station.
exampleCn: 就在车站附近有好几家旅馆

en: happening or changing slowly over a long period of time or distance
exampleEn: There has been a gradual improvement in our sales figures over the last two years.
exampleCn: 在过去的两年里，我们的销售额一直在逐步上升。

en: possible when the necessary conditions exist
exampleEn: A number of potential buyers have expressed interest in the company.
exampleCn: 一些潜在的买主表达了对该公司的兴趣。

en: in the end, especially after a long time or a lot of effort, problems, etc.
exampleEn: It might take him ages but he'll do it eventually.
exampleCn: 这或许会花去他很长时间，但最终他会成功的。

en: that is the reason or explanation for
exampleEn: Generally, the layering occurs on an annual basis, hence the observed changes in the records can be dated.
exampleCn: 一般来说，分层是按年进行的，因此我们可以确定记录中观察到的变化的日期。

cn: 彻底地 ； 激烈地，大幅度地
en: in a way that is severe and sudden or has very noticeable effects
exampleEn: The supply of money in circulation was drastically reduced overnight.
exampleCn: 一夜之间流通货币的供应就急剧减少了。

en: to make something happen sooner or more quickly
exampleEn: There is little doubt that poor medical treatment hastened her death.
exampleCn: 毫无疑问，糟糕的治疗加速了她的死亡。

en: sudden and unexpected, and often unpleasant
exampleEn: Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.
exampleCn: 乔治突然冲进房间里，我们的谈话戛然而止。

cn: 不可避免的；必然发生的
en: certain to happen and unable to be avoided or prevented
exampleEn: The accident was the inevitable consequence of carelessness.
exampleCn: 这一事故是粗心导致的必然结果。

en: If something accounts for a particular fact or situation, it causes or explains it.
exampleEn: What might account for this strange phenomenon?
exampleCn: 什么可以解释这种奇怪的现象？

cn: （通常指轻微地）改动，修改；改变，（使）变化
en: to change something, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change
exampleEn: Giving up our car has radically altered our lifestyle.
exampleCn: 弃车不用使我们的生活方式发生了根本性的变化。

en: only
exampleEn: This offer is available exclusively to our established customers.
exampleCn: 只有本店老客户才能享受这一优惠价。

cn: 迅速地；心甘情愿地；轻而易举地
en: quickly, immediately, willingly, or without any problem
exampleEn: He readily agreed to help.
exampleCn: 他乐意帮忙。

cn: 强化，加深，进一步证实（观点、看法等）
en: If something reinforces an idea or opinion, it provides more proof or support for it and makes it seem true.
exampleEn: The final technical report into the accident reinforces the findings of initial investigations.
exampleCn: 对事故作出的最终的技术性报告进一步证实了最初的调查结果。

cn: 大的；可观的；价值巨大的；重大的
en: large in size, value, or importance
exampleEn: The findings show a substantial difference between the opinions of men and women.
exampleCn: 这些发现表明男性和女性之间存在着重大的意见分歧。

en: something that controls what you do by keeping you within particular limits
exampleEn: Financial constraints on the company are preventing them from employing new staff.
exampleCn: 公司财务紧张使得他们不能再聘请新员工。

cn: （用于强调所说的即为所想表达的）仅仅，只，不过
en: used to emphasize that you mean exactly what you are saying and nothing more
exampleEn: Francis Watson was far from being merely a furniture expert.
exampleCn: 弗兰西斯·沃森不仅仅是位家具专家。

en: to encourage people to like, buy, use, do, or support something
exampleEn: Greenpeace works to promote awareness of the dangers that threaten our planet today.
exampleCn: 绿色和平组织致力于促使人们了解当前威胁地球的危机。

en: to increase suddenly and strongly
exampleEn: The company's profits have surged.
exampleCn: 公司的利润激增。

en: finally, after a series of things have happened
exampleEn: Ultimately, of course, he'd like to have his own business but that won't be for some time.
exampleCn: 当然，他最终想拥有自己的企业，但那不会很快实现的。

cn: 史无前例的，空前的；绝无仅有的
en: never having happened or existed in the past
exampleEn: This century has witnessed environmental destruction on an unprecedented scale.
exampleCn: 环境在本世纪遭到了空前的破坏。

cn: 充满活力的；有力量的；精力旺盛的
en: very forceful or energetic
exampleEn: She was a very vigorous sort of person.
exampleCn: 她是那种精力非常旺盛的人。

cn: （使）融入（某社会或群体）；（使）成为一体
en: to mix with and join society or a group of people, often changing to suit their way of life, habits, and customs
exampleEn: He seems to find it difficult to integrate socially.
exampleCn: 他似乎觉得很难与别人打成一片。

en: felt or experienced very strongly or in an extreme way
exampleEn: His mother's death when he was aged six had a very profound effect on him.
exampleCn: 他六岁时母亲的过世对他的影响很大。

en: to make something last a longer time
exampleEn: We were having such a good time that we decided to prolong our stay by another week.
exampleCn: 我们过得非常愉快，决定再多呆一个星期。

cn: （使）加快，（使）增速；促进；提前，（促使）早日发生
en: to happen or make something happen sooner or faster
exampleEn: The runners accelerated smoothly around the bend.
exampleCn: 赛跑运动员在转弯处顺畅地加速。

en: to reduce or be reduced in size or importance
exampleEn: The world's resources are rapidly diminishing.
exampleCn: 世界资源正在迅速减少。

en: the length of time that something lasts
exampleEn: The duration of previous geologic periods was difficult to determine.
exampleCn: 以前很难确定地质期的持续时间。

en: to make something certain to happen
exampleEn: The airline is taking steps to ensure safety on its aircraft.
exampleCn: 航空公司正在采取措施以确保其航班的飞行安全。

cn: 向（某人）传授专门知识；（通过某种仪式）接纳（新会员）
en: to teach someone about an area of knowledge, or to allow someone into a group by a special ceremony
exampleEn: Hundreds are initiated into the sect each year.
exampleCn: 每年有好几百人被接纳到这个教派中。

cn: （尤指生意、职位或活动）赚钱的，盈利的
en: (especially of a business, job, or activity) producing a lot of money
exampleEn: The merger proved to be very lucrative for both companies.
exampleCn: 事实证明，这次兼并使两家公司都获利丰厚。

en: used to say what you think is the likely situation
exampleEn: They can presumably afford to buy a bigger apartment.
exampleCn: 他们大概买得起一套大一点的公寓。

en: If you pursue a plan, activity, or situation, you try to do it or achieve it, usually over a long period of time.
exampleEn: He decided to pursue a career in television.
exampleCn: 他决心从事电视广播业。

en: to get something from something else
exampleEn: The institute derives all its money from foreign investments.
exampleCn: 该机构的资金均来自于国外投资。

cn: （尤指用特殊方法）发现，察觉，看出
en: to notice something that is partly hidden or not clear, or to discover something, especially using a special method
exampleEn: Financial experts have detected signs that the economy is beginning to improve.
exampleCn: 金融专家已经注意到了经济开始有好转的迹象。

en: to prevent something, especially a system, process, or event, from continuing as usual or as expected
exampleEn: Heavy snow disrupted travel into the city this morning.
exampleCn: 今晨的大雪扰乱了入城交通系统的正常运行。

en: to cause something to start
exampleEn: Nuts can trigger off a violent allergic reaction.
exampleCn: 坚果可以引起严重的过敏反应。

en: having a negative or harmful effect on something
exampleEn: So far the drug is thought not to have any adverse effects.
exampleCn: 迄今为止，人们一直认为这种药物没有任何副作用。

en: to spread across or move away over a large area, or to make something do this
exampleEn: When the rain came down the crowds started to disperse.
exampleCn: 雨下来时人群开始四处散开。

en: able to last a long time without becoming damaged
exampleEn: The resolution calls for a durable peace settlement.
exampleCn: 该决议呼吁出台一个持久的和平解决方案。

en: to make someone able to do something, or to make something possible
exampleEn: Computerization should enable us to cut production costs by half.
exampleCn: 实现计算机化可以使我们的生产成本减半。

cn: （常指以不正当手段）操纵，控制
en: to control something or someone to your advantage, often unfairly or dishonestly
exampleEn: The opposition leader accused government ministers of manipulating the statistics to suit themselves.
exampleCn: 反对派领导人指责政府部长篡改统计数据以满足自身利益。

en: acceptable or right for someone or something
exampleEn: The film is not suitable for children.
exampleCn: 这部电影不适宜儿童观看。

cn: 关键性的；决定性的；至关重要的
en: of the greatest importance to the way things might happen
exampleEn: The president's support is critical to this project.
exampleCn: 总统对该计划的支持至关重要。

cn: 决定性的，具有决定意义的
en: strongly affecting how a situation will progress or end
exampleEn: She has played a decisive role in the peace negotiations.
exampleCn: 她在和谈中起了关键作用。

cn: 对…不予理会，摒弃，（从头脑中）去除
en: to decide that something or someone is not important and not worth considering
exampleEn: He dismissed the idea with a firm shake of his head.
exampleCn: 他坚定地摇了摇头，否定了那个想法。

en: to remove or take out something
exampleEn: He rifled through his briefcase and extracted a file.
exampleCn: 他在公文包内搜索一番，取出一份文件。

en: the highest, strongest, or best point, value, or level of skill
exampleEn: Prices reach a peak during August.
exampleCn: 八月份价格达到高峰。

en: using ideas and methods that have never been used before
exampleEn: The school has won awards for its pioneering work with the community.
exampleCn: 该校因与社区开创性合作而获奖。

cn: 持续严厉的；持续强烈的
en: continuing in a severe or extreme way
exampleEn: It's always about relentless forward progress.
exampleCn: 这始终就是不断地前进。

en: (an amount that is) more than is needed
exampleEn: The world is now producing large food surpluses.
exampleCn: 世界上目前生产的食品大大过剩。

cn: 足够的；合格的；合乎需要的
en: enough or satisfactory for a particular purpose
exampleEn: Will future oil supplies be adequate to meet world needs?
exampleCn: 未来的石油供应能满足世界的需要吗？

cn: （事件、发明或人物的）出现，来临，到来
en: the fact of an event happening, an invention being made, or a person arriving
exampleEn: Life was transformed by the advent of the steam engine.
exampleCn: 蒸汽机的出现使人类生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

en: to imagine or expect that something will happen
exampleEn: We had one or two difficulties along the way that we didn't anticipate.
exampleCn: 在进行的过程中，我们遇到一两个没有预料到的难题。

cn: （理由、论证等）令人信服的，很有说服力的
en: If a reason, argument, etc. is compelling, it makes you believe it or accept it because it is so strong.
exampleEn: It's a fairly compelling argument for going.
exampleCn: 去的理由很有说服力。

en: one of the parts that a substance or combination is made of
exampleEn: What are the basic constituents of the mixture?
exampleCn: 这种混合物的基本成分是什么？

en: to come from other places to meet in a particular place
exampleEn: 100,000 people are expected to converge on the town for the festival.
exampleCn: 预计有十万人聚集镇上庆祝节日。

en: to (cause something to) spread in many directions
exampleEn: Television is a powerful means of diffusing knowledge.
exampleCn: 电视是传播知识的有力工具。

en: the fact of something becoming known or starting to exist
exampleEn: Another condition that contributes to the development of autonomous theater is the emergence of the aesthetic sense.
exampleCn: 另一个促进独立戏剧发展的条件是审美意识的出现。

cn: 邂逅，不期而遇，偶然碰到
en: to meet someone unexpectedly
exampleEn: On their way home they encountered a woman selling flowers.
exampleCn: 在回家的路上他们碰到一位卖花的女子。

en: too much
exampleEn: Excessive exercise can sometimes cause health problems.
exampleCn: 体育锻炼过度有时也会导致健康问题。

en: the natural purpose (of something) or the duty (of a person)
exampleEn: The function of the veins is to carry blood to the heart.
exampleCn: 静脉的功能是将血液输送回心脏。

en: to cause something to happen
exampleEn: Pills for seasickness often induce drowsiness.
exampleCn: 晕船药经常会令人昏昏欲睡。

en: to examine a crime, problem, statement, etc. carefully, especially to discover the truth
exampleEn: We are of course investigating how an error like this could have occurred.
exampleCn: 我们当然正在调查发生此类错误的原因。

en: best; most likely to bring success or advantage
exampleEn: A mixture of selected funds is an optimal choice for future security and return on investment.
exampleCn: 同时选择几种基金是确保未来投资安全和投资收益的最佳选择。

cn: 占主导地位地；占绝大多数地；显着地
en: mostly or mainly
exampleEn: She is predominantly a dancer, but she also sings.
exampleCn: 她主要是跳舞，但也唱歌。

en: to be the largest in number or the most important
exampleEn: In industrial areas, the dark-coloured variety of the moth now predominates.
exampleCn: 在工业区，深色型蛾子现在占绝大多数。

cn: 非凡的；奇异的；引人注目的
en: unusual or special and therefore surprising and worth mentioning
exampleEn: Nelson Mandela was a truly remarkable man.
exampleCn: 纳尔逊．曼德拉确实是个了不起的人。

en: small in numbers or amount, often spread over a large area
exampleEn: Information coming out of the disaster area is sparse.
exampleCn: 来自灾区的信息很少。

cn: 易受伤的；易受影响（或攻击）的；脆弱的
en: able to be easily physically, emotionally, or mentally hurt, influenced, or attacked
exampleEn: It is on economic policy that the government is most vulnerable.
exampleCn: 政府最易受人诟病的是经济政策。

cn: 陪同，陪伴；伴随，和…一起发生（或存在）
en: to go with someone or to be provided or exist at the same time as something
exampleEn: Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.
exampleCn: 抑郁症几乎总是伴有失眠。

en: typical of a person or thing
exampleEn: She spoke with characteristic enthusiasm.
exampleCn: 她说话带着特有的热情。

en: If you try to compensate for something that is wrong or missing in your life, you try to do something that removes or reduces the harmful effects.
exampleEn: A surge in domestic sales helped compensate for a fall-off in export sales.
exampleCn: 国内销售的增长帮助补偿了出口销售的减少。

en: causing disagreement or discussion
exampleEn: Immigration is a controversial issue in many countries.
exampleCn: 移民在很多国家都是一个有争议的问题。

en: traditional and ordinary
exampleEn: It's not a hotel, in the conventional sense, but rather a whole village turned into a hotel.
exampleCn: 从传统意义上来说，这并不是一个旅馆，而是变成了旅馆的整个村庄。

cn: 发出，射出，散发（光、噪声、气味或气体）
en: to send out a beam, noise, smell, or gas
exampleEn: We should minimize the use of private cars, which emit a large amount of greenhouse gases.
exampleCn: 我们应该减少私家车的使用，因为私家车排放大量的温室气体。

en: to continue to exist for a long time
exampleEn: Hearing and telling stories about events may help children store information in ways that will endure into later childhood and adulthood.
exampleCn: 听和讲述关于事件的故事可能会帮助孩子们以一种持续到童年后期及成年的方式储存信息。

cn: （因特殊、重要或巨大而）给人留下深刻印象的
en: If an object or achievement is impressive, you admire or respect it, usually because it is special, important, or very large.
exampleEn: The bridge is not as impressive as some guides would have you believe.
exampleCn: 这座桥并不像有些导游试图让你相信的那样令人印象深刻。

cn: 心灵手巧；足智多谋；独创力
en: someone's ability to think of clever new ways of doing something
exampleEn: I was impressed by the ingenuity and energy of the contestants.
exampleCn: 参赛者的聪明才智和活力给我留下了深刻的印象。

en: a way of doing something that is planned or part of a system
exampleEn: There's no mechanism for punishing arms exporters who break the rules.
exampleCn: 对于违反规定的军火出口商还没有惩罚机制。

en: to organize or prepare something, such as a group of people, for a purpose
exampleEn: Representatives for all the main candidates are trying to mobilize voter support.
exampleCn: 所有主要候选人的代表正在努力鼓动选民们给予支持。

en: not large in size or amount, or not expensive
exampleEn: They live in a fairly modest house, considering their wealth.
exampleCn: 就他们拥有的财富而言，他们的住所不大。

en: very big
exampleEn: We have a monumental task ahead of us.
exampleCn: 极其繁重的工作在等着我们。

cn: 清楚的；显然的，明显的；明白的
en: easy to see, recognize, or understand
exampleEn: They have a small child so for obvious reasons they need money.
exampleCn: 他们有个年幼的孩子，所以显然很需要钱。

en: said when you are judging one thing in comparison with other things
exampleEn: Relatively speaking, it's a fairly poor country.
exampleCn: 相对而言，这是个很贫穷的国家。

en: very seriously
exampleEn: Their daughter was severely injured in a car accident.
exampleCn: 他们的女儿在一次车祸中受了重伤。

en: to encourage something to grow, develop, or become active
exampleEn: The government plans to cut taxes in order to stimulate the economy.
exampleCn: 政府计划减税以刺激经济发展。

en: the state of having what you need in order to stay alive, but no more
exampleEn: The family was living at subsistence level.
exampleCn: 这家人过着勉强糊口的生活。

en: enough for a particular purpose
exampleEn: This recipe should be sufficient for five people.
exampleCn: 这份食谱应该足够五个人吃。

en: to leave a place, thing, or person, usually for ever
exampleEn: By the time the rebel troops arrived, the village had already been abandoned.
exampleCn: 当叛军杀到时，村民们已经撤离了村子。

cn: 可进入的，可接近的；可得到的
en: able to be reached or easily got
exampleEn: These documents are not accessible to the public.
exampleCn: 公众无法看到这些文件。

en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something
exampleEn: Exams are not the only means of assessing a student's ability.
exampleCn: 考试并不是评定学生能力的唯一手段。

cn: 一贯的；坚持的；始终如一的
en: always behaving or happening in a similar, especially positive, way
exampleEn: We must be consistent in applying the rules.
exampleCn: 我们在实施这些规则时必须保持一致。

en: to help to cause an event or situation
exampleEn: High thin clouds contribute to heating while low thick clouds cool Earth.
exampleCn: 高而薄的云层有助于升温，而低而厚的云层使地球冷却。

en: having parts that are close together so that it is difficult to go or see through
exampleEn: We fought our way through the dense vegetation.
exampleCn: 我们在茂密的植被中开出一条通路。

en: clearly noticeable; that certainly exists
exampleEn: His voice was quiet but every word was distinct.
exampleCn: 他说话声音不大，但字字清晰。

en: raised
exampleEn: The doctor said I was to keep my leg elevated.
exampleCn: 医生说我要保持腿部抬高。

en: to use something completely
exampleEn: How long will it be before the world's fuel supplies are exhausted?
exampleCn: 再过多长时间地球上的燃料就耗尽了？

en: extremely large in size or degree
exampleEn: They spent an immense amount of time getting the engine into perfect condition.
exampleCn: 他们花费了大量时间使发动机运转完美。

en: seeming likely to be true, or able to be believed
exampleEn: This explanation fits the facts and is psychologically plausible.
exampleCn: 这一解释与事实相符，从心理角度看也有理。

en: gradually
exampleEn: My eyesight has got progressively worse over the years.
exampleCn: 这些年来我的视力越来越差了。

cn: 残余（部分）；剩余（部分）；零头；零料
en: a small piece or amount of something that is left from a larger original piece or amount
exampleEn: The bone fragment might be a remnant from your injury five years ago.
exampleCn: 那个骨片可能是你五年前受伤的残留物。

en: almost never
exampleEn: Seldom do we receive any apology when mistakes are made.
exampleCn: 出错的时候，我们很少听到道歉的话语。

en: very near, next to, or touching
exampleEn: They work in adjacent buildings.
exampleCn: 他们在相邻的两座楼里工作。

cn: （尤指某人或某组织的）办事能力
en: (especially of a person or organization) the ability to do a particular thing
exampleEn: Do you think it's within his capacity to do the job without making a mess of it?
exampleCn: 你认为他有能力完成这项工作而不把它搞砸吗？

en: a part that combines with other parts to form something bigger
exampleEn: The factory supplies electrical components for cars.
exampleCn: 这家工厂供应汽车电器部件。

en: as a result
exampleEn: This poses a threat to agriculture and the food chain, and consequently to human health.
exampleCn: 这会对农业和食物链造成威胁，由此而危及人的健康。

en: to develop a plan, an idea, etc. and make it complicated or detailed
exampleEn: In his plays he takes simple traditional tales and elaborates them.
exampleCn: 他在剧本里采用了一些简单的传统故事并进行了发挥。

en: necessary or needed
exampleEn: Water is essential to living things.
exampleCn: 水对于生物来说是必不可少的。

cn: 广阔的，大面积的；覆盖范围广的
en: covering a large area; having a great range
exampleEn: The story had an extensive popularity among American readers.
exampleCn: 这本小说在美国读者中赢得广泛的声望。

en: in addition; more importantly
exampleEn: The house is beautiful. Furthermore, it's in a great location.
exampleCn: 这座房子很漂亮，而且位置也非常好。

en: extreme and forceful or (of a feeling) very strong
exampleEn: He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.
exampleCn: 他突然觉得背部一阵剧痛。

en: the outer edge of an area
exampleEn: The plant tends to grow in the lighter margins of woodland areas.
exampleCn: 这种植物往往生长在植被较稀疏的林地边缘。

en: despite what has just been said or referred to
exampleEn: I knew a lot about the subject already, but her talk was interesting nevertheless.
exampleCn: 关于这个话题我已经知之甚多，但她的报告听起来还是很有趣。

cn: 持续的；存留的；顽强存在的
en: lasting for a long time or difficult to get rid of
exampleEn: Symptoms of the illness include a high temperature and a persistent dry cough.
exampleCn: 病症包括高烧和持久的干咳。

en: to get control or influence
exampleEn: I am sure that common sense will prevail in the end.
exampleCn: 我相信常识最终会获胜。

en: successful, usually by earning a lot of money
exampleEn: In a prosperous country like this, no one should go hungry.
exampleCn: 在这样一个繁荣的国家里，不应该有人挨饿。

cn: 远的；遥远的；久远的；关系疏远的
en: far away in distance or time, or not closely related
exampleEn: They take little interest in a conflict far from their homes and remote from their everyday problems.
exampleCn: 这是一场远在他们家乡千里之外的冲突，和他们每天遇到的问题也毫不沾边，他们对其不怎么感兴趣。

en: to (cause to) move far apart in different directions
exampleEn: Wreckage from the plane was scattered over a wide area.
exampleCn: 飞机失事残骸散落在一个广阔地域。

en: not moving, or not changing
exampleEn: The traffic got slower and slower until it was stationary.
exampleCn: 车流移动得越来越慢，最后完全不动了。

en: happening or moving quickly or within a short time, especially in a smooth and easy way
exampleEn: The police took swift action against the rioters.
exampleCn: 警方对暴动人员迅速采取了行动。

en: extremely big
exampleEn: A vast audience watched the broadcast.
exampleCn: 大量的观众观看了转播。

en: almost
exampleEn: Their twins are virtually identical.
exampleCn: 他们的双胞胎长得几乎一模一样。

en: existing or happening over a large area or among many people
exampleEn: There are reports of widespread flooding in northern France.
exampleCn: 有报道说法国北部到处洪水泛滥。

cn: 使有可能；允许，准许；容许
en: to give permission for someone to do something, or to not prevent something from happening
exampleEn: Her proposals would allow more people to stay in full-time education.
exampleCn: 她的提议会使更多的人能够继续接受全日制教育。

cn: 含糊不清的；引起歧义的，模棱两可的；不明确的
en: having or expressing more than one possible meaning, sometimes intentionally
exampleEn: His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.
exampleCn: 他对我的提问回答得有些含糊不清。

cn: 消耗；耗费（资源、金钱、精力等）
en: to reduce something in size or amount, especially supplies of energy, money, etc.
exampleEn: If we continue to deplete the earth's natural resources, we will cause serious damage to the environment.
exampleCn: 如果我们继续消耗地球上的自然资源，将对环境造成严重的破坏。

en: the action of spreading in many directions
exampleEn: Modern communications make the diffusion of ideas extremely rapid.
exampleCn: 现代通讯使思想的传播极为迅速。

en: to a very great degree
exampleEn: We had an exceedingly good lunch.
exampleCn: 我们吃了一顿极其丰盛的午餐。

cn: 小片，小块；（尤指）碎片，碎块
en: a small piece or a part, especially when broken from something whole
exampleEn: The road was covered with fragments of glass from the shattered window.
exampleCn: 公路上到处是车窗的碎玻璃片。

cn: 令人不快的；严酷的；（无端地）严厉的
en: unpleasant, unkind, cruel, or more severe than is necessary
exampleEn: The children had had a harsh upbringing.
exampleCn: 孩子们的家教很严。

en: something that encourages a person to do something
exampleEn: Tax incentives have been very effective in encouraging people to save and invest more of their income.
exampleCn: 税收激励措施在鼓励人们将收入多储蓄和多投资方面很有效。

en: to put furniture, a machine, or a piece of equipment into position and make it ready to use
exampleEn: The plumber is coming tomorrow to install the new washing machine.
exampleCn: 水管工明天来安装新的洗衣机。

en: in a way that does not happen regularly or continuously; in a way that stops and starts repeatedly or with periods in between
exampleEn: We've discussed this problem intermittently, but so far we've failed to come up with a solution.
exampleCn: 我们断断续续地讨论过这个问题，但目前还没有找到解决方案。

en: to begin something such as a plan or introduce something new such as a product
exampleEn: The programme was launched a year ago.
exampleCn: 这项计划是一年前开始实施的。

en: after thinking about all the different facts or opinions
exampleEn: On balance, biotechnology should be good news for developing countries.
exampleCn: 总的来说，生物技术对发展中国家来说应该是好消息。

cn: 持续存在的；不断发展的；继续进行的；进行中的
en: continuing to exist or develop, or happening at the present moment
exampleEn: No agreement has yet been reached and the negotiations are still ongoing.
exampleCn: 还没有达成任何协议，谈判仍在进行。

en: exact and accurate
exampleEn: The bunker's precise location is a closely guarded secret.
exampleCn: 掩体的确切位置严格保密。

en: to look like or be like someone or something
exampleEn: You resemble your mother very closely.
exampleCn: 你长得很像你妈妈。

en: in a way that relates or belongs to each of the separate people or things you have just mentioned
exampleEn: Steven and James are aged 10 and 13 respectively.
exampleCn: 史蒂夫和詹姆斯分别是十岁和十三岁。

en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing
exampleEn: The government has restricted freedom of movement into and out of the country.
exampleCn: 政府已经限制出入境自由了。

en: a situation in which something is not easy to find or get
exampleEn: Either food scarcity or excessive hunting can threaten a population of animals.
exampleCn: 食物短缺或过度捕猎都可能威胁到动物的数量。

cn: 寻找；寻求（尤指非物质的东西）
en: to try to find or get something, especially something that is not a physical object
exampleEn: Hundreds of dissidents are seeking refuge in the US embassy.
exampleCn: 数百名持不同政见者到美国大使馆寻求庇护。

en: to guess possible answers to a question when you do not have enough information to be certain
exampleEn: A spokesperson declined to speculate on the cause of the train crash.
exampleCn: 一位发言人拒绝就火车相撞事件的原因作出推测。

cn: 保持，维持，使持续，使继续
en: to cause or allow something to continue for a period of time
exampleEn: The economy looks set to sustain its growth into next year.
exampleCn: 看来经济的增长会持续到明年。

en: showing all the characteristics that you would usually expect from a particular group of things
exampleEn: This kind of hot and spicy food is very typical of the food in the south of the country.
exampleCn: 这种辛辣食品是该国南部具代表性的食物。

en: negative and showing that you do not like something
exampleEn: He always talks about her in an unfavourable way.
exampleCn: 他在谈起她是总是很负面。

cn: 主张人；拥护人；支持者；提倡者
en: someone who publicly supports something
exampleEn: He's a strong advocate of state ownership of the railways.
exampleCn: 他是铁路国有的积极倡导者。

en: to state something as a fact but without giving proof
exampleEn: The prosecution alleges that she was driving carelessly.
exampleCn: 控方指控她粗心驾驶。

en: the quality in someone or something that makes him, her, or it attractive or interesting
exampleEn: Spielberg's movies have a wide appeal.
exampleCn: 斯皮尔伯格的影片广受欢迎。

en: to increase the size or value of something by adding something to it
exampleEn: He would have to find work to augment his income.
exampleCn: 他可能不得不找活儿干来增加收入。

en: to bring together different pieces of written information so that the similarities and differences can be seen
exampleEn: Roberts has spent much of his working life collating the data on which the study was based.
exampleCn: 罗伯茨花费很多工作时间来整理检点数据，以此作为该研究的基础。

en: to prove that a belief or an opinion that was previously not completely certain is true
exampleEn: His guilty expression confirmed my suspicions.
exampleCn: 他内疚的表情证实了我的猜疑。

en: to discover the meaning of something written badly or in a difficult or hidden way
exampleEn: Can you decipher the writing on this envelope?
exampleCn: 你能辨认出信封上的字吗？

cn: （常指坏事）有意的，故意的，蓄意的
en: (often of something bad) intentional or planned
exampleEn: Witnesses say the firing was deliberate and sustained.
exampleCn: 目击者说这次射击是蓄意的，而且还持续了一段时间。

en: to throw something away or get rid of it because you no longer want or need it
exampleEn: Discarded food containers and bottles littered the streets.
exampleCn: 街上到处都是被丢弃的食品包装和瓶子。

en: in a way that includes a lot of careful detail or many detailed parts
exampleEn: It was clearly an elaborately planned operation.
exampleCn: 这显然是一次经过周密策划的行动。

cn: 清楚明白的；明确的；不含糊的
en: clear and exact
exampleEn: I gave her very explicit directions how to get here.
exampleCn: 我明确地告诉她来这儿怎么走。

en: not intentionally
exampleEn: He inadvertently deleted the file.
exampleCn: 他不小心把文档删了。

en: not happening regularly or continuously; stopping and starting repeatedly or with periods in between
exampleEn: Although she made intermittent movie appearances, she was essentially a stage actress.
exampleCn: 她虽然断断续续地在电影中露面，但基本上还是一个舞台演员。

en: to gradually increase, rise, or get bigger
exampleEn: The children's excitement is mounting as Christmas gets nearer.
exampleCn: 随着圣诞临近，孩子们越来越兴奋。

cn: 相互的，彼此的；共同的，共有的
en: (of two or more people or groups) feeling the same emotion, or doing the same thing to or for each other
exampleEn: Theirs was a partnership based on mutual respect, trust and understanding.
exampleCn: 他们的合作是建立在相互尊重、信任和理解的基础之上的。

cn: 与…同时发生；与…相似；与…相当，比得上
en: to happen at the same time as something else, or be similar or equal to something else
exampleEn: Parallel experiments are being conducted in Rome, Paris and London.
exampleCn: 类似的试验正在罗马、巴黎和伦敦同时进行。

en: the state of being near in space or time
exampleEn: The best thing about the location of the house is its proximity to the town centre.
exampleCn: 这座房子在地理位置方面最好的一点就是邻近市中心。

en: to accept that something is legal, true, or important
exampleEn: The international community has refused to recognize the newly independent nation state.
exampleCn: 国际社会拒绝承认这个新独立的国家。

en: a person, group, etc. competing with others for the same thing or in the same area
exampleEn: He beat his nearest rival by 20 marks.
exampleCn: 他以领先二十分的成绩打败了和他水平最接近的对手。

cn: （人或动物）强壮的，茁壮的；（东西或系统）坚固的，耐用的，结实的
en: (of a person or animal) strong and healthy, or (of an object or system) strong and unlikely to break or fail
exampleEn: He looks robust and healthy enough.
exampleCn: 他看起来非常强壮健康。

en: approximately
exampleEn: We have roughly similar tastes/roughly the same tastes.
exampleCn: 我们的口味大致相同。

en: a description of possible actions or events in the future
exampleEn: There are several possible scenarios.
exampleCn: 有几种可能出现的局面。

en: important or noticeable
exampleEn: There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.
exampleCn: 近年来，女学生的人数有了显著增加。

en: only and not involving anyone or anything else
exampleEn: I bought it solely for that purpose.
exampleCn: 我仅仅是为那个目的才买的。

en: easy to understand or simple
exampleEn: The instructions are reasonably straightforward.
exampleCn: 用法说明还算简单易懂。

cn: 隐约的；暗淡的；不易察觉的，不明显的；微妙的
en: not loud, bright, noticeable, or obvious in any way
exampleEn: The room was painted a subtle shade of pink.
exampleCn: 房间被刷成了淡粉色。

en: the edge or border of something
exampleEn: They set up camp on the verge of the desert.
exampleCn: 他们在沙漠边缘扎下了营地。

en: the process of combining things or amounts into a single group or total
exampleEn: The aggregation of wealth by small groups of families caused social unrest.
exampleCn: 少数家族的财富聚集引起了社会动荡。

en: to show, say, or prove that something exists or is true
exampleEn: Contemporary accounts attest to his courage and determination.
exampleCn: 当时的报道证实了他的勇气和决心。

en: to come together in a small group or groups
exampleEn: The children clustered together in the corner of the room.
exampleCn: 孩子们聚集在房间的角落里。

en: involving a lot of different parts, in a way that is difficult to understand
exampleEn: The instructions look very complicated.
exampleCn: 这说明书看起来很难懂。

en: to make sth bad become even worse by causing further damage or problems
exampleEn: Severe drought has compounded food shortages in the region.
exampleCn: 严重的干旱加剧了该地区的食品短缺问题。

cn: 可想象的；可想到的；可以相信的
en: possible to imagine or to believe
exampleEn: It is conceivable that I'll see her tomorrow.
exampleCn: 我可能明天会见到她。

en: very noticeable or attracting attention, often in a way that is not wanted
exampleEn: The advertisements were all posted in a conspicuous place.
exampleCn: 广告都贴在了显眼的地方。

en: all the time or often
exampleEn: He's constantly changing his mind.
exampleCn: 他的想法时常在变。

en: to use fuel, energy, or time, especially in large amounts
exampleEn: The electricity industry consumes large amounts of fossil fuels.
exampleCn: 电力工业消耗大量的矿物燃料。

en: to match or be similar or equal
exampleEn: Decibel values correspond to various sounds.
exampleCn: 分贝值对应不同的声音。

cn: （与不同地方或组织的人或物）作用相同者，相对应者
en: a person or thing that has the same purpose as another one in a different place or organization
exampleEn: The Foreign Minister held talks with his Chinese counterpart.
exampleCn: 外交部长与中国外交部长举行了会谈。

en: to consider one thing along with or in addition to something else
exampleEn: Overproduction, coupled with falling sales, has led to huge losses for the company.
exampleCn: 生产过剩加上销售下降使这家公司遭受巨大损失。

cn: （作出评判、决定或处理的）标准，准则
en: a standard by which you judge, decide about, or deal with something
exampleEn: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth.
exampleCn: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准。

en: to become worse
exampleEn: The political situation in the region has deteriorated rapidly.
exampleCn: 该地区的政治形势已急剧恶化。

cn: 毁灭性的，破坏性极大的
en: causing a lot of damage or destruction
exampleEn: If the bomb had exploded in the main shopping area, it would have been devastating.
exampleCn: 如果炸弹在主要商业区爆炸，将会造成毁灭性的后果。

en: the process of giving things out to several people, or spreading or supplying something
exampleEn: Has the Channel Tunnel improved the distribution of goods between the British Isles and mainland Europe?
exampleCn: 海峡隧道是否改善了不列颠群岛与欧洲大陆之间的货物流通？

en: to cause something or someone to change direction
exampleEn: To prevent flooding, we shall have to divert the river from its course.
exampleCn: 为防止水涝，我们必须使河水改道。

cn: 骤然的；戏剧性的；激动人心的
en: very sudden or noticeable, or full of action and excitement
exampleEn: The announcement had a dramatic effect on house prices.
exampleCn: 这项公告对房屋价格产生了巨大的影响。

en: completely
exampleEn: I admit it was entirely my fault.
exampleCn: 我承认全都是我的错。

en: a period of time of which particular events or stages of development are typical
exampleEn: The fall of the Berlin wall marked the end of an era.
exampleCn: 柏林墙的倒塌标志着一个时代的结束。

en: to get rid of material such as solid waste or urine from the body
exampleEn: Most toxins are naturally excreted from the body.
exampleCn: 大部分毒素被自然排出体外。

cn: 技艺；功绩；业绩；英勇事迹
en: something difficult needing a lot of skill, strength, courage, etc. to achieve it
exampleEn: The Eiffel Tower is a remarkable feat of engineering.
exampleCn: 埃菲尔铁塔是工程技术上的一大非凡业绩。

en: a change, or the process of changing, especially continuously between one level or thing and another
exampleEn: The erratic fluctuation of market prices is in consequence of unstable economy.
exampleCn: 经济波动致使市场物价忽起忽落。

en: a principle, an idea or a fact that sth is based on and that it grows from
exampleEn: He laid the foundation of Japan's modern economy.
exampleCn: 他奠定了日本现代经济的基础。

cn: （天气或室内温度）寒冷的，严寒的
en: (of weather conditions or the conditions in a room) extremely cold
exampleEn: Few plants can grow in such a frigid environment.
exampleCn: 几乎没有什么植物能够在如此寒冷的环境下生长。

en: perfect, or the best possible
exampleEn: She's the ideal person for the job.
exampleCn: 她是这项工作的理想人选。

cn: 可能的影响；可能的后果
en: the effect that an action or decision will have on something else in the future
exampleEn: The company is cutting back its spending and I wonder what the implications will be for our department.
exampleCn: 公司正在削减开支，真不知道这将会对我们部门产生什么影响。

en: relating to the most important characteristics or ideas of something
exampleEn: In essence, both sides agree on the issue.
exampleCn: 从本质上说，双方在这个问题上的意见是一致的。

en: using new methods or ideas
exampleEn: She was an imaginative and innovative manager.
exampleCn: 她是个具有想象力和创新精神的经理。

en: to look at something or someone carefully in order to discover information, especially about their quality or condition
exampleEn: After the crash both drivers got out and inspected their cars for damage.
exampleCn: 撞车后，两辆车的司机都下来检查各自的车有无损坏。

cn: 完整无缺的；未经触动的
en: complete and in the original state
exampleEn: The church was destroyed in the bombing but the altar survived intact.
exampleCn: 教堂在轰炸中被毁，但神坛却完好无损。

cn: 密集的，集中的；加强的；深入的
en: involving a lot of effort or activity in a short period of time
exampleEn: Intensive bombing had reduced the city to rubble.
exampleCn: 密集轰炸把城市炸成了一片瓦砾。

en: to separate something from other things with which it is connected or mixed
exampleEn: A high wall isolated the house from the rest of the village.
exampleCn: 一堵高墙将这栋房子与村庄的其他部分隔离开来。

en: to limit something
exampleEn: We need to find ways of keeping our expenditure in check.
exampleCn: 我们必须想办法限制我们的开销。

en: to change something such as a plan, opinion, law, or way of behaviour slightly, usually to improve it or make it more acceptable
exampleEn: Instead of simply punishing them, the system encourages offenders to modify their behaviour.
exampleCn: 这个制度并不是单单惩罚犯罪者，而是鼓励他们改正自己的行为。

en: sometimes but not often
exampleEn: Occasionally I'll have a piece of chocolate, but it's very rare.
exampleCn: 有时我会吃块巧克力，不过这种时候极少。

en: to see something or someone, or to notice something that is obvious
exampleEn: Bill perceived a tiny figure in the distance.
exampleCn: 比尔注意到远处有个很小的身影。

en: to make something free from faults
exampleEn: He is keen to perfect his golfing technique.
exampleCn: 他热衷于提高自己的高尔夫球技。

en: to tell someone about some information, often because you believe they do not know it or have forgotten it
exampleEn: I feel I should point out how dangerous it is.
exampleCn: 我觉得我应该指出它的危险性。

cn: 讲究实际的，重实效的；实用主义的
en: solving problems in a sensible way that suits the conditions that really exist now, rather than obeying fixed theories, ideas, or rules
exampleEn: In business, the pragmatic approach to problems is often more successful than an idealistic one.
exampleCn: 在商业活动中，解决问题用实际的方法往往比空想更有成效。

en: to show, express, or be a sign of something
exampleEn: The statistics reflect a change in people's spending habits.
exampleCn: 这些统计数据显示出人们的消费习惯发生了变化。

en: used for describing what often or usually happens
exampleEn: Health and safety rules are routinely ignored.
exampleCn: 卫生和安全法规经常被忽视。

en: the careful and detailed examination of something in order to get information about it
exampleEn: The government's record will be subjected to scrutiny in the weeks before the election.
exampleCn: 政府的所为将在选举前的几个星期接受审查。

en: to form into a particular shape
exampleEn: The dripping water had sculpted strange shapes out of the rocks.
exampleCn: 滴水把石头变成了各种奇怪的形状。

en: to get something, sometimes with difficulty
exampleEn: He was disappointed by his failure to secure the top job with the bank.
exampleCn: 他因没能得到银行的高层工作而失望。

en: to rise very quickly to a high level
exampleEn: All night long fireworks soared into the sky.
exampleCn: 整个晚上焰火不断地升入高空。

en: the physical and/or mental strength to do something that might be difficult and will take a long time
exampleEn: The triathlon is a great test of stamina.
exampleCn: 铁人三项运动是对耐力的极大考验。

en: in a way that does not last for long or for ever
exampleEn: This office is closed temporarily for redecoration.
exampleCn: 这间办公室因重新装修而暂时关闭。

en: to care for something or someone
exampleEn: He carefully tended his sunflower plants.
exampleCn: 他精心照料他的向日葵。

en: as a result of this action
exampleEn: Diets that are high in saturated fat clog up our arteries, thereby reducing the blood flow to our hearts and brains.
exampleCn: 高饱和脂肪和高胆固醇的饮食容易阻塞我们的动脉，从而减少向心脏和大脑的供血。

en: not intentional
exampleEn: Perhaps he had slightly misled them, but it was quite unintentional.
exampleCn: 或许他有一点误导他们了，但完全是无意的。

cn: 使适应不同情况（或用途）；改动；改造；改装；改编
en: to change something to suit different conditions or uses
exampleEn: The good thing about children is that they adapt very easily to new environments.
exampleCn: 小孩的长处就是能够很容易地适应新环境。

cn: 清晰可见的；显而易见的；明白易懂的
en: able to be seen or understood
exampleEn: Her unhappiness was apparent to everyone.
exampleCn: 谁都看得出来她很不开心。

en: used to say that something seems to be true, although it is not certain
exampleEn: The two crimes are apparently unconnected.
exampleCn: 这两起犯罪似乎没有关联。

en: the act of recognizing or understanding that something is valuable, important, or as described
exampleEn: Max has no appreciation of the finer things in life.
exampleCn: 马克斯对生活中高雅点的事物都不懂欣赏。

en: independent and having the power to make your own decisions
exampleEn: He treated us as autonomous individuals who had to learn to make up our own minds about issues.
exampleCn: 他视我们为独立个体，必须学会自主处理问题。

en: having all the characteristics or qualities that you expect
exampleEn: He's a classic example of a kid who's clever but lazy.
exampleCn: 他是个典型的聪明却懒惰的孩子。

cn: （由于压力、无力或缺乏支持而）倒塌，坍塌；崩溃，垮掉
en: to fall down suddenly because of pressure or having no strength or support
exampleEn: Thousands of buildings collapsed in the earthquake.
exampleCn: 数以千计的建筑物在地震中倒塌了。

en: a book, CD, etc. that has been made from several separate parts
exampleEn: Her latest CD is a compilation of all her best singles.
exampleCn: 她最新的激光唱片收录了她的所有最佳单曲。

en: the state of having many parts and being difficult to understand or find an answer to
exampleEn: I was astonished by the size and complexity of the problem.
exampleCn: 这个问题的复杂性和涉及面之广使我感到惊讶。

cn: 全面的；综合的；包罗万象的；详尽的
en: complete and including everything that is necessary
exampleEn: He has written a fully comprehensive guide to Rome.
exampleCn: 他写了一本内容详尽的罗马旅游指南。

cn: 相当大的；相当多的；非常可观的；相当重要的
en: large or of noticeable importance
exampleEn: The fire caused considerable damage to the church.
exampleCn: 那场火灾给教堂造成了重大损失。

en: to restrict or limit sb/sth
exampleEn: Research has been constrained by a lack of funds.
exampleCn: 研究工作因经费不足而受限制。

en: the act of using energy, food or materials; the amount used
exampleEn: Gas and oil consumption always increases in cold weather.
exampleCn: 燃气和燃油的消耗量在天冷时总会增加。

cn: 对立的；相互矛盾的；不一致的
en: If two or more facts, pieces of advice, etc. are contradictory, they are very different from each other.
exampleEn: We are faced with two apparently contradictory statements.
exampleCn: 我们面前这两种说法显然是矛盾的。

en: polite and showing respect
exampleEn: The hotel staff are friendly and courteous.
exampleCn: 旅馆服务人员友好而有礼貌。

en: to leave something somewhere
exampleEn: I deposited my luggage in a locker at the station.
exampleCn: 我把行李存放在车站的储物柜里了。

cn: 多种多样的，形形色色的
en: including many different types of people or things
exampleEn: Spain is a composite of diverse traditions and people.
exampleCn: 西班牙是一个汇集了多种传统和民族的国家。

en: to raise something or lift something up
exampleEn: It is important that the injured leg should be elevated.
exampleCn: 将受伤的腿抬高是很重要的。

cn: 超过，超出（数量）；超越（规定的范围）
en: to be greater than a number or amount, or to go past an allowed limit
exampleEn: The final cost should not exceed $5,000.
exampleCn: 最终的花费不应超出五千美元。

cn: 使人精疲力竭的；使人疲惫不堪的
en: making you feel extremely tired
exampleEn: The trip has been exhausting and I'll be glad to be home.
exampleCn: 这个旅程令人疲惫不堪，要是能回家就好了。

en: to show something publicly
exampleEn: Some libraries exhibit children's art works from around the world.
exampleCn: 一些图书馆展出来自世界各地的儿童艺术作品。

en: to give an advantage to someone or something, in an unfair way
exampleEn: A strong wind will favour the bigger boats.
exampleCn: 强风对大船有利。

en: a substance that flows and is not solid
exampleEn: If you have a fever you should drink plenty of fluids.
exampleCn: 如果发烧，应多喝流质。

cn: 易损坏的；易碎的；脆弱的
en: easily damaged, broken, or harmed
exampleEn: The vase was quite fragile so we had to wrap it in soft material before we send it by post.
exampleCn: 这个花瓶很易碎，所以我们在邮寄前必须用软材料把它包起来。

cn: 通常，一般地，大多数情况下
en: usually, or in most situations
exampleEn: The baby generally wakes up three times during the night.
exampleCn: 通常这个婴儿会在夜间醒三次。

en: not giving or having a result or decision
exampleEn: The medical tests were inconclusive, and will need to be repeated.
exampleCn: 这些医学实验尚无定论，仍需重复进行。

en: extremely good
exampleEn: Yeah, it was an incredible performance.
exampleCn: 对，这是一场非常出色的表演。

en: Something or someone that is indispensable is so good or important that you could not manage without it, him, or her
exampleEn: This book is an indispensable resource for researchers.
exampleCn: 这本书是研究者必不可少的资料。

en: able to cause or causing death; extremely dangerous
exampleEn: Three minutes after the fire started, the house was full of lethal fumes.
exampleCn: 起火三分钟后，房子里充满了致命的毒气。

en: the large size or importance of something
exampleEn: They don't seem to grasp the magnitude of the problem.
exampleCn: 他们似乎未领会问题的重要性。

en: a reason for doing something
exampleEn: Why would she have killed him? She has no motive.
exampleCn: 为什么她会杀害他？她没有动机。

en: despite what has just been said or done
exampleEn: There are serious problems in our country. Nonetheless, we feel this is a good time to return.
exampleCn: 我们国家存在严重问题。但尽管如此，我们仍然感觉这是归国的好时机。

en: to force someone to do something, or to make it necessary for someone to do something
exampleEn: Parents are obliged by law to send their children to school.
exampleCn: 法律规定父母必须送子女入学。

en: a particular government or a system or method of government
exampleEn: The old corrupt, totalitarian regime was overthrown.
exampleCn: 腐败的旧极权政府被推翻。

en: being judged or measured in comparison with something else
exampleEn: We weighed up the relative advantages of driving there or going by train.
exampleCn: 我们权衡了一下，看看开车去那儿和乘火车去哪种方式更有利。

en: to make something slower
exampleEn: A rise in interest rates would severely retard economic growth.
exampleCn: 利率提高会严重阻碍经济发展。

en: to very much respect and admire someone or something
exampleEn: Nelson Mandela is revered for his brave fight against apartheid.
exampleCn: 纳尔逊‧曼德拉与种族隔离制度进行了无畏斗争，赢得了世人的崇敬。

en: to keep one thing separate from another
exampleEn: The systems will have to be able to segregate clients' money from the firm's own cash.
exampleCn: 该系统必须能够把客户的钱同公司的自有资金分开。

en: able to provide everything you need, especially food, for yourself without the help of other people
exampleEn: The programme aims to make the country self-sufficient in food production and to cut energy imports.
exampleCn: 这个项目旨在使国家在粮食上能自给自足，并减少能源进口。

en: seriousness
exampleEn: Even the doctors were shocked by the severity of his injuries.
exampleCn: 连医生也对他伤势的严重程度感到震惊。

en: intelligent or made in a complicated way and therefore able to do complicated tasks
exampleEn: I think a more sophisticated approach is needed to solve this problem.
exampleCn: 我认为要解决这个问题需要更为高明的方法。

cn: 使大吃一惊；使受惊，使吓一跳
en: to do something unexpected that surprises and sometimes worries a person or animal
exampleEn: She was concentrating on her book and his voice startled her.
exampleCn: 她正在聚精会神地看书，被他的声音吓了一跳。

en: to a large degree
exampleEn: The new rules will substantially change how we do things.
exampleCn: 新规则会在很大程度上改变我们的行事方式。

en: to be enough
exampleEn: One example will suffice to illustrate the point.
exampleCn: 举一个例子就足以说明这一点。

en: to produce a substance by a chemical reaction in plants or animals
exampleEn: There are many vitamins that the body cannot synthesize itself.
exampleCn: 有很多维生素是人体自身无法合成的。

en: used to emphasize that something is true
exampleEn: Mozart's compositions are undoubtedly among the world's greatest.
exampleCn: 莫扎特的作品无疑位列于世界上最伟大的作品之中。

en: a large amount of
exampleEn: Russia has a wealth of coal and timber.
exampleCn: 俄罗斯有丰富的煤炭和木材资源。

en: more than enough
exampleEn: Cheap consumer goods are abundant in this part of the world.
exampleCn: 在这个地区，大量的低廉消费品充斥其间。

cn: 为…提供方便；对…予以照顾性考虑
en: to give what is needed to someone
exampleEn: The new policies fail to accommodate people with disabilities.
exampleCn: 新政策未能满足残障人士的需求。

en: familiar with
exampleEn: The old generations are accustomed to everything of the past.
exampleCn: 老一代人习惯了过去的一切。

en: to accept, admit, or recognize something, or the truth or existence of something
exampleEn: She acknowledged that she had been at fault.
exampleCn: 她承认自己有过错。

en: to give attention to or deal with a matter or problem
exampleEn: The issue of funding has yet to be addressed.
exampleCn: 资金问题尚未得到解决。

en: having a natural ability to do something that needs skill
exampleEn: She's very adept at dealing with the media.
exampleCn: 她应付媒体游刃有余。

en: happening once every year
exampleEn: Companies publish annual reports to inform the public about the previous year's activities.
exampleCn: 公司发布年度报告，告知公众上一年的具体业务。

en: suitable or right for a particular situation or occasion
exampleEn: I didn't think his comments were very appropriate at the time.
exampleCn: 我觉得他在当时发表那些评论很不妥当。

en: made by people, often as a copy of something natural
exampleEn: I find that artificial sweeteners often have an odd aftertaste.
exampleCn: 我发现人工甜味剂回味很奇怪。

en: except if a particular thing happens
exampleEn: Barring accidents, we should arrive on time.
exampleCn: 除非有意外情况，我们应可按时到达。

cn: 平常的；常见的；普通的；普遍的
en: happening often or often seen or experienced and so not considered to be special
exampleEn: Electric cars are increasingly commonplace.
exampleCn: 电动汽车越来越普及了。

cn: （大小、数量或品质上）类似的，相当的，可比的
en: similar in size, amount, or quality to something else
exampleEn: The girls are of comparable ages.
exampleCn: 女孩们年龄相仿。

en: to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list
exampleEn: We're compiling some facts and figures for a documentary on the subject.
exampleCn: 我们正在为一部有关这个主题的纪录片汇编资料。

en: to press something into a smaller space
exampleEn: Firmly compress the soil in the pot so that the plant is secure.
exampleCn: 把盆里的土压实使植株固定。

en: a generally accepted opinion or decision among a group of people
exampleEn: There is a general consensus among teachers about the need for greater security in schools.
exampleCn: 教师们对必须加强学校的保安有普遍的共识。

en: without a pause or interruption
exampleEn: The rain has been continuous since this morning.
exampleCn: 从早上到现在这雨就没停过。

en: to make or become shorter or narrower or generally smaller in size
exampleEn: As it cooled, the metal contracted.
exampleCn: 金属冷却后收缩了。

en: in a way that is the opposite or reverse of something
exampleEn: Conversely, "cycle to work" days have done their job by creating pollution lows.
exampleCn: 相反，“骑车上班”的日子创造了污染低值，效果明显。

en: to take or carry someone or something to a particular place
exampleEn: The goods are usually conveyed by rail.
exampleCn: 这种货物通常通过铁路运输。

en: in a way that increases by one addition after another
exampleEn: Average home prices will rise only 4 percent cumulatively over the next two years.
exampleCn: 在接下来的两年里，平均房价仅会累积上升四个百分点。

en: a group of events that happen in a particular order, one following the other, and are often repeated
exampleEn: The scientists concluded that the solar wind activity must follow the same cycle.
exampleCn: 科学家们得出结论，太阳风的活动必须遵循相同的周期。

en: to influence something or make it necessary
exampleEn: Of course, a number of factors will dictate how long an apple tree can survive.
exampleCn: 当然，一棵苹果树能存活多久是由许多因素决定的。

en: a difference between two things that should be the same
exampleEn: There is some discrepancy between the two accounts.
exampleCn: 这两份账单之间有一些出入。

en: the action of spreading across or moving away over a large area, or of making people or things do this
exampleEn: The seeds are adapted to dispersal by ants.
exampleCn: 这些种子适应于通过蚂蚁传播。

en: to take part in something
exampleEn: They can get chances to engage in research.
exampleCn: 他们可以有机会从事研究。

cn: 事件；（相关的）一连串事件；一段经历
en: a single event or group of related events
exampleEn: This latest episode in the fraud scandal has shocked a lot of people.
exampleCn: 诈骗丑闻最新爆出的这一事件让很多人瞠目结舌。

en: to guess or calculate the cost, size, value, etc. of something
exampleEn: They estimate that the journey will take at least two weeks.
exampleCn: 他们估计这次行程至少需要两周时间。

cn: （使）逐步发展；（使）逐步演变；（使）逐渐形成；（使）进化
en: to develop gradually, or to cause something or someone to develop gradually
exampleEn: The company has evolved over the years into a multi-million dollar organization.
exampleCn: 该公司在数年内逐步发展成为一个拥有数百万美元资产的大企业。

en: to remove what is covering something so that it can be seen
exampleEn: The plaster on the walls has been removed to expose the original bricks underneath.
exampleCn: 墙上的灰泥已被除去，露出了里面原本的墙砖。

en: giving you an advantage or more chance of success
exampleEn: The terms of the agreement are favourable to both sides.
exampleCn: 协议条款对双方都有利。

en: to give attention, effort, etc. to one particular subject, situation or person rather than anothe
exampleEn: The discussion focused on three main problems.
exampleCn: 讨论集中在三个主要问题上。

en: to bring something into existence
exampleEn: She left a large sum of money in her will to found a wildlife sanctuary.
exampleCn: 她在遗嘱里留下了一大笔钱用来创建野生动物保护区。

en: to control something, usually in order to use its power
exampleEn: There is a great deal of interest in harnessing wind and waves as new sources of power.
exampleCn: 人们对开发利用风和波浪这些新能源非常感兴趣。

en: a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance
exampleEn: Some monkeys have a very complex social hierarchy.
exampleCn: 有些猴群中出现了非常复杂的种群等级。

en: coming or likely to happen very soon
exampleEn: A strike is imminent.
exampleCn: 一场罢工即将来临。

en: something that is the driving force behind or reason for something else
exampleEn: The plan will give an impulse to industrial expansion.
exampleCn: 这个计划将促进工业的扩展。

en: to include something as part of something larger
exampleEn: Suggestions from the survey have been incorporated into the final design.
exampleCn: 调查中取得的建议已被纳入了最终的设计之中。

cn: 不确定地；不清楚地；无限期地
en: for a period of time with no fixed end
exampleEn: The negotiations have been put off indefinitely.
exampleCn: 谈判被无限期地推迟了。

cn: 内在的；固有的，生来就有的
en: existing as a natural or basic part of something
exampleEn: I have an inherent distrust of lawyers.
exampleCn: 我生来对律师就有种不信任感。

en: to prevent sth from happening or make it happen more slowly or less frequently than normal
exampleEn: A lack of oxygen may inhibit brain development in the unborn child.
exampleCn: 缺氧可能阻碍胎儿的大脑发育。

en: at the beginning
exampleEn: Initially, most people approved of the new plan.
exampleCn: 起初，大部分人都同意这个新方案。

en: always
exampleEn: The train is invariably late.
exampleCn: 火车总是晚点。

en: happening or existing only once, separate
exampleEn: There were only a few isolated cases of violent behaviour.
exampleCn: 只有几例孤立的暴力事件。

en: extreme or very strong
exampleEn: Many people are taking a keen interest in the result of the vote.
exampleCn: 许多人对投票结果表现出浓厚的兴趣。

en: in a very ordered, careful way
exampleEn: She planned her career carefully and methodically.
exampleCn: 她仔细而有条不紊地规划自己的事业。

en: the fact that you notice or see something
exampleEn: She has remarkable powers of observation.
exampleCn: 她具有非凡的观察力。

cn: 废弃的；过时的；淘汰的；老化的
en: not in use any more, having been replaced by something newer and better or more fashionable
exampleEn: Gas lamps became obsolete when electric lighting was invented.
exampleCn: 电灯发明以后煤气灯就被淘汰了。

cn: （尤指疾病、危险或不快之事的）发作，暴发，突然发生
en: a time when something suddenly begins, especially a disease or something else dangerous or unpleasant
exampleEn: Last weekend saw further thundery outbreaks.
exampleCn: 上周末仍然雷声不断。

en: in a way that shows you have taken a lot of care or made a lot of effort
exampleEn: She painstakingly explained how the machine worked.
exampleCn: 她悉心地解释这台机器是如何运转的。

en: more important than anything else
exampleEn: There are many priorities, but reducing the budget deficit is paramount importance.
exampleCn: 很多事情要优先解决，但当务之急是减少预算赤字。

en: belonging to, relating to, or found in only particular people or things
exampleEn: He gets on with things in his own peculiar way.
exampleCn: 他处理事情有自己独特的方法。

en: in a way that is repeated after a particular period of time
exampleEn: The equipment should be tested periodically.
exampleCn: 设备应定期检测。

en: relating directly to the subject being considered
exampleEn: Chapter One is pertinent to the post-war period.
exampleCn: 第一章讲述的是战后时期。

cn: 充斥各处的；弥漫的，遍布的
en: present or noticeable in every part of a thing or place
exampleEn: The influence of Freud is pervasive in her books.
exampleCn: 弗洛伊德的影响在她的作品中随处可见。

en: to go into or through something, making a hole in it using a sharp point
exampleEn: I couldn't wear these earrings because my ears aren't pierced.
exampleCn: 我没法戴这些耳环，因为我没有穿耳孔。

cn: （尤指在正式场合）提出（问题），质询
en: to ask a question, especially in a formal situation such as a meeting
exampleEn: Can we go back to the question that Helena posed earlier?
exampleCn: 我们能否回到海伦娜早先提出的那个问题上去？

cn: 占主导地位的；占绝大多数的；显着的
en: more noticeable or important, or larger in number, than others
exampleEn: Research forms the predominant part of my job.
exampleCn: 研究是我工作中的重要部分。

en: the largest part or greatest amount
exampleEn: The preponderance of evidence suggests that he's guilty.
exampleCn: 大量的证据表明他有罪。

en: to measure or judge the size or amount of something
exampleEn: It's difficult to quantify how many people will be affected by the change.
exampleCn: 很难确定将有多少人受到该变化的影响。

en: a small change that improves something
exampleEn: Clearly, the hypothesis does need some refinement, in the light of these surprising results.
exampleCn: 很显然，从这些令人惊讶的结果来看，该假设确实需要进一步完善。

en: not willing to do something and therefore slow to do it
exampleEn: I was having such a good time I was reluctant to leave.
exampleCn: 我玩得很开心，都不愿意离开了。

en: to make or do something again in exactly the same way
exampleEn: Researchers tried many times to replicate the original experiment.
exampleCn: 研究者们作了很多次努力，试图重复这一实验。

en: to solve or end a problem or difficulty
exampleEn: Have you resolved the problem of transport yet?
exampleCn: 你们解决交通问题了吗？

en: to surround something
exampleEn: Armed police ringed the hijacked plane.
exampleCn: 武装警察包围了被劫持的飞机。

cn: （为阻止敌人或对手成功而）毁坏，破坏（设备、武器或建筑物）
en: to damage or destroy equipment, weapons, or buildings in order to prevent the success of an enemy or competitor
exampleEn: The rebels had tried to sabotage the oil pipeline.
exampleCn: 叛乱分子曾试图破坏输油管道。

cn: 偶尔发生的；阵发性的；断断续续的
en: happening sometimes; not regular or continuous
exampleEn: More than 100 people have been killed this year in sporadic outbursts of ethnic violence.
exampleCn: 今年有超过一百人在零星爆发的种族暴力中丧生。

cn: 活动、干劲的）短时激增，迸发；突然加速，冲刺
en: a sudden and short period of increased activity, effort, or speed
exampleEn: There was a sudden spurt of activity in the housing market.
exampleCn: 房地产市场突然活跃了起来。

en: gradually
exampleEn: Prices have risen steadily.
exampleCn: 物价持续上涨。

cn: 异乎寻常的，惊人的；引人注目的
en: very unusual or easily noticed, and therefore attracting a lot of attention
exampleEn: She bears a striking resemblance to her mother.
exampleCn: 她酷似她母亲。

en: to add something to something to make it larger or better
exampleEn: Some vegetarians like to supplement their diets with iron.
exampleCn: 有些素食主义者喜欢在饮食之外吃一些含铁的药片。

cn: 怀疑，猜想，认为（某事有可能）
en: to think or believe something to be true or probable
exampleEn: We had no reason to suspect that he might try to kill himself.
exampleCn: 我们没有理由认为他会自杀。

en: in this way
exampleEn: Many scholars have argued thus.
exampleCn: 许多学者都这样论证过。

en: Something that is unpromising does not show any signs that it will be enjoyable or successful.
exampleEn: The car broke down, which was an unpromising start to the holiday.
exampleCn: 汽车坏了，这个假期刚一开始就前景不妙。

cn: 没有对手的；无可匹敌的；无与伦比的
en: having no equal; better than any other of the same type
exampleEn: The museum boasts an unrivalled collection of French porcelain.
exampleCn: 该博物馆拥有举世无双的法国瓷器藏品。

en: to leave a room, building, chair, etc. so that it is available for other people
exampleEn: Hotel guests are requested to vacate their rooms by noon.
exampleCn: 宾馆房客务请在中午之前退房。

cn: 可以实施的；可望成功的
en: able to work as intended or able to succeed
exampleEn: In order to make the company viable, it will unfortunately be necessary to reduce staffing levels.
exampleCn: 很遗憾，为使公司继续运转下去，将不得不裁员。

cn: 有利的；有优势的；有好处的
en: giving advantages or helping to make you more successful
exampleEn: The lower tax rate is particularly advantageous to poorer families.
exampleCn: 低税率对于较为贫困的家庭尤其有利。

en: in a way that is enough to have an important effect
exampleEn: Her health has improved appreciably since she changed her treatment.
exampleCn: 自从她换了治疗方案之后，她的健康状况有了显著改善。

en: a statement that you strongly believe is true
exampleEn: Do you have any evidence to support your assertions?
exampleCn: 你的断言是否有真凭实据？

cn: 将…（与…）联系起来，把…联系在一起
en: to connect someone or something in your mind with someone or something else
exampleEn: Most people associate this brand with good quality.
exampleCn: 大多数人把这个品牌和优良品质联系在一起。

en: to say or believe that sth is the result of a particular thing
exampleEn: Many scientists now attribute much of the warming of early Earth to oxygen-intolerant microbes.
exampleCn: 现在，许多科学家把早期造成地球变暖的大部分原因归结于厌氧微生物。

en: to increase or become successful and produce a lot of money very quickly
exampleEn: The leisure industry is booming.
exampleCn: 休闲产业正在蓬勃发展。

en: to increase the range of something
exampleEn: I hoped that going to college might broaden my horizons .
exampleCn: 我希望上大学能使我增长见识。

en: a number of things of the same type fastened together or in a close group
exampleEn: She picked me a bunch of flowers.
exampleCn: 她给我采了一束鲜花。

cn: 极差的，糟蹋透顶的，灾难性的
en: very bad
exampleEn: The water shortage in this country is potentially catastrophic.
exampleCn: 该国水资源的匮乏很可能是灾难性的。

en: to stop something
exampleEn: Whether the protests will cease remains to be seen.
exampleCn: 抗议活动是否会停止还说不定。

en: in a state of chaos
exampleEn: The traffic in the city is chaotic in the rush hour.
exampleCn: 在上下班高峰时间，城市的交通混乱不堪。

en: to happen at or near the same time
exampleEn: If the heavy rain had coincided with an extreme high tide, serious flooding would have resulted.
exampleCn: 如果暴雨同时伴有汹涌的潮汛，就会导致严重的洪灾

en: to agree or have the same opinion
exampleEn: Local feeling does not necessarily concur with the press.
exampleCn: 当地人的看法不一定和媒体一致。

cn: 经常发生的；连续发生的；连续不断的
en: happening a lot or all the time
exampleEn: This entrance is in constant use.
exampleCn: 此入口经常使用。

en: in a way that happens repeatedly
exampleEn: This information is continually updated.
exampleCn: 这些信息不断更新。

en: to discuss a subject in a formal way
exampleEn: Scientists were debating whether an asteroid was about to hit the Earth.
exampleCn: 科学家们在争论一颗小行星是否要撞上地球。

en: to destroy a place or thing completely or cause great damage
exampleEn: The bomb devastated much of the old part of the city.
exampleCn: 这颗炸弹炸毁了旧城的一大片地方。

en: to include as part of something
exampleEn: Kennett embodied in one man an unusual range of science, music, and religion.
exampleCn: 肯尼特集科学、音乐、宗教等方面的一系列非凡成就于一身。

en: famous, respected, or important
exampleEn: She invoked several eminent scholars to back up her argument.
exampleCn: 她援引了几位赫赫有名的学者来支持她的论点。

cn: 包含，包括（尤指很多不同事物）
en: to include different types of things
exampleEn: The festival is to encompass everything from music, theatre, and ballet to literature, cinema, and the visual arts.
exampleCn: 本届文化节将涵盖从音乐、戏剧、芭蕾到文学、电影、视觉艺术等各种艺术形式。

en: to improve the quality, amount, or strength of something
exampleEn: This is an opportunity to enhance the reputation of the company.
exampleCn: 这是提高公司声誉的机会。

cn: （尤指在技能、才智、品质等方面）卓越的，杰出的，不同凡响的
en: much greater than usual, especially in skill, intelligence, quality, etc.
exampleEn: The company has shown exceptional growth over the past two years.
exampleCn: 过去两年中，这家公司取得了不俗的发展业绩。

en: to prevent someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity
exampleEn: Microbes must, as far as possible, be excluded from the room during an operation.
exampleCn: 在手术过程中，要尽可能防止细菌进入手术室。

en: to make something last longer
exampleEn: I need to extend my visa.
exampleCn: 我的签证需要延期。

en: one of the parts of someone's face that you notice when you look at them
exampleEn: He has wonderful strong features.
exampleCn: 他五官分明，相貌英俊。

en: to develop all the details of a plan for doing something
exampleEn: Governments need to formulate energy policies that promote economically and environmentally sound development.
exampleCn: 各国政府需要制订促进经济和环境充分发展的能源政策。

en: to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen
exampleEn: Zoos fulfil an important function in the protection of rare species.
exampleCn: 动物园起着保护珍稀动物的重要功能。

en: to put furniture in something
exampleEn: The room was furnished with antiques.
exampleCn: 房间里摆放了古董。

en: to (cause to) stop moving or doing something or happening
exampleEn: Production has halted at all of the company's factories because of the pay dispute.
exampleCn: 由于工资纠纷，这家公司所有工厂都停产了。

en: dangerous
exampleEn: The report calls for a ban on the import of hazardous waste.
exampleCn: 这篇报道呼吁禁止危险废弃物的进口。

cn: （使）（尤指某种情绪或效果）增强，加强
en: to increase or make something increase, especially an emotion or effect
exampleEn: The strong police presence only heightened the tension among the crowd.
exampleCn: 大批警察的出现只能使人群更加紧张。

en: a person who copies someone or something that they think is good
exampleEn: For many, Rome is at best the imitator and the continuator of Greece on a larger scale.
exampleCn: 对许多人来说，罗马充其量只是希腊的模仿者和延续者，不过是规模更大而已。

cn: （人）灵巧的；（物品等）制作精巧的；（方法等）巧妙的
en: (of a person) very intelligent and skilful, or (of a thing) skilfully made or planned and involving new ideas and methods
exampleEn: This mousetrap is an ingenious device.
exampleCn: 这个捕鼠器是一件精巧的装置。

en: being between two other related things, levels, or points
exampleEn: This novel is too difficult for intermediate students of English.
exampleCn: 这部小说对于中等程度的英语学习者来说太难了。

en: affecting someone in a way that annoys them and makes them feel uncomfortable
exampleEn: The constant presence of the media was very intrusive.
exampleCn: 媒体一直在场十分令人讨厌。

en: a sign of something existing or happening
exampleEn: She claimed that the rise in unemployment was just a further manifestation of the government's incompetence.
exampleCn: 她声称失业率上升进一步表明了政府的无能。

en: (of amounts or numbers) very small or not enough
exampleEn: The prisoners existed on a meagre diet.
exampleCn: 囚犯们靠少得可怜的食物维持生存。

en: the number of deaths within a particular society and within a particular period of time
exampleEn: Infant mortality is much higher in the poorest areas of the city.
exampleCn: 在这个城市最贫困的地区，婴儿的死亡率要高得多。

en: very ordinary and therefore not interesting
exampleEn: Mundane matters such as paying bills and shopping for food do not interest her.
exampleCn: 她对付账单、购买食品等琐事不感兴趣。

en: left when there is nothing else to be taken away
exampleEn: The net weight of something excludes the weight of the material that it is packed in.
exampleCn: 净重不包括包装材料的重量。

en: to prevent something from being seen or heard
exampleEn: Two new skyscrapers had sprung up, obscuring the view from her window.
exampleCn: 两座新摩天大楼拔地而起，挡住了她窗外的风景。

en: decoration that is added to increase the beauty of something
exampleEn: The building relies on clever design rather than on ornament for its impressive effect.
exampleCn: 这幢大楼依靠其巧妙设计而非装饰给人留下了深刻的印象。

cn: 总的（来说） ；全面的（地） ；包括一切的（地）
en: in general rather than in particular, or including all the people or things in a particular group or situation
exampleEn: The overall situation is good, despite a few minor problems.
exampleCn: 尽管有一些小问题，局势总的来说是好的。

cn: 限定因素；界限；范围；规范
en: a set of facts or a fixed limit that establishes or limits how something can or must happen or be done
exampleEn: The researchers must keep within the parameters of the experiment.
exampleCn: 研究员必须在试验既定的范围内进行研究。

en: especially, or more than usual
exampleEn: We're particularly interested to hear from people who speak two or more European languages.
exampleCn: 我们特别希望能收到说两种或两种以上欧洲语言的人的来信。

en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time.
exampleEn: Mont Blanc has a permanent snow cap.
exampleCn: 勃朗峰的山顶终年积雪。

en: If a substance is permeable, it allows liquids or gases to go through it.
exampleEn: Certain types of sandstone are permeable to water.
exampleCn: 某些类型的沙岩可渗水。

en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.
exampleEn: Strawberries are plentiful in the summer.
exampleCn: 夏天草莓很多。

en: to suggest a theory, idea, etc. as a basic principle from which a further idea is formed or developed
exampleEn: It was the Greek astronomer, Ptolemy, who postulated that the earth was at the centre of the universe.
exampleCn: 是希腊天文学家托勒密假定地球是宇宙的中心。

en: almost or very nearly
exampleEn: She blamed me for practically every mistake in the report.
exampleCn: 她几乎把报告里所有的错误都怪在了我头上。

en: of great value because of being rare, expensive, or important
exampleEn: Clean water is a precious commodity in many parts of the world.
exampleCn: 在世界上很多地方洁净的水是昂贵的商品。

en: to keep something as it is, especially in order to prevent it from decaying or being damaged or destroyed
exampleEn: The agreement preserved our right to limit trade in endangered species.
exampleCn: 这项协议保留了我们限制濒危物种贸易的权利。

en: to believe something to be true because it is very likely, although you are not certain
exampleEn: I presume that they're not coming, since they haven't replied to the invitation.
exampleCn: 鉴于他们没有回复邀请，我认为他们不会来了。

en: before a particular time or event
exampleEn: There is evidence of agriculture in Africa prior to 3000 B.C.
exampleCn: 有证据表明，公元前三千年以前，非洲就有了农业。

en: a person who speaks publicly in support of a particular idea or plan of action
exampleEn: He is one of the leading proponents of capital punishment.
exampleCn: 他是死刑的主要支持者之一。

en: (a place that gives) protection or shelter from danger, trouble, unhappiness, etc.
exampleEn: These people are taking refuge from persecution.
exampleCn: 这些受到迫害的人正在寻求庇护。

en: without being influenced by any other events or conditions
exampleEn: Regardless of why people move, migration of large numbers of people causes conflict.
exampleCn: 不管人们为什么迁移，大量人口的迁移都会引起冲突。

cn: （尤指以乏味的方式）重复的，反复的
en: involving doing or saying the same thing several times, especially in a way that is boring
exampleEn: Robots can relieve people of dull and repetitive work.
exampleCn: 单调重复的工作，机器人可以代劳。

en: If an activity resumes, or if you resume it, it starts again after a pause.
exampleEn: Normal services will be resumed in the spring.
exampleCn: 春天将恢复正常服务。

en: the continued use, existence, or possession of something or someone
exampleEn: Two influential senators have argued for the retention of the unpopular tax.
exampleCn: 两位有影响的参议员主张保留这项不得人心的税收。

en: not easy to find or get
exampleEn: Food and clean water were becoming scarce.
exampleCn: 食物和洁净的水越来越少了。

en: to divide something into different parts
exampleEn: The market is segmented by price into three general categories.
exampleCn: 根据价格将市场大体分为三类。

en: to protect yourself, or another person or thing, from bad weather, danger, or attack
exampleEn: We were caught in a thunderstorm, without anywhere to shelter.
exampleCn: 我们遇上了雷暴雨，没有避雨的地方。

en: to reduce the force of something, or to prevent something from existing or developing
exampleEn: The fire burned for eight hours before the fire crews could subdue it.
exampleCn: 大火烧了八个小时后，消防队才控制住了火势。

en: happening one after the other without any break
exampleEn: It was the team's fourth successive defeat.
exampleCn: 那是球队接连第四次失利。

en: enough
exampleEn: The case was sufficiently serious to warrant investigation by the police.
exampleCn: 这个案子严重到需要交由警方来搜捕调查。

cn: 任务；（尤指经常、不情愿或很难做的）工作；（苦）差事
en: a piece of work to be done, especially one done regularly, unwillingly, or with difficulty
exampleEn: We usually ask interviewees to perform a few simple tasks on the computer just to test their aptitude.
exampleCn: 我们通常让接受面试者在电脑上进行一些简单操作，只想测测他们的能力。

en: in a way that obeys some rules but is not likely
exampleEn: It is theoretically possible.
exampleCn: 它在理论上是可能的。

en: the feeling of admiring someone or something:
exampleEn: My admiration for that woman grows daily.
exampleCn: 我对那个女子的钦佩与日俱增。

en: to accept or start to use something new
exampleEn: I think it's time to adopt a different strategy in my dealings with him.
exampleCn: 我觉得在和他的交往中该采用一种不同的策略了。

en: having some of the same qualities
exampleEn: They speak a language akin to French.
exampleCn: 他们说的是一种类似法语的语言。

en: similar or related in some way
exampleEn: Graphite is chemically allied to diamond.
exampleCn: 石墨和金刚石在化学组成上有联系。

cn: （计划、想法）要求过高的；需要极大努力及才干的；费劲的
en: If a plan or idea is ambitious, it needs a great amount of skill and effort to be successful or be achieved.
exampleEn: She has some ambitious plans for her business.
exampleCn: 她雄心勃勃，打算扩大经营规模。

en: a natural ability or skill
exampleEn: His aptitude for dealing with children got him the job.
exampleCn: 他善于和儿童打交道的本事使他得到了这份工作。

en: showing strong feelings
exampleEn: She was an ardent follower of the cause.
exampleCn: 她是这项事业的热烈追随者。

en: to move up or climb something
exampleEn: They slowly ascended the steep path up the mountain.
exampleCn: 他们沿着陡峭的山路缓缓向上攀登。

cn: 承担（责任）；就（职）；取得（权力）
en: to take or begin to have responsibility or control, sometimes without the right to do so, or to begin to have a characteristic
exampleEn: The court assumed responsibility for the girl's welfare.
exampleCn: 法庭承担了保障这个女孩福利的责任。

en: the ability to make your own decisions without being controlled by anyone else
exampleEn: It is necessary to give individuals greater autonomy in their own lives
exampleCn: 在生活中给个人更大自主权是有必要的。

cn: 怪诞的；罕见的；异乎寻常的
en: very strange and unusual
exampleEn: Fantasies cannot harm you, no matter how bizarre or far out they are.
exampleCn: 无论多么荒诞或怪异的幻想都伤害不到你。

en: to increase or improve something
exampleEn: The theatre managed to boost its audiences by cutting ticket prices.
exampleCn: 剧院设法通过降低票价来增加观众数量。

en: in a way that does not stop, or seems to have no end
exampleEn: Musicians work ceaselessly to improve.
exampleCn: 音乐家们不断努力提高。

cn: 按事件发生的年代排列的顺序；（大事）年表
en: the order in which a series of events happened, or a list or explanation of these events in the order in which they happened
exampleEn: I'm not sure of the chronology of events.
exampleCn: 我对事件发生的时间顺序不是很有把握。

en: to mention something as proof for a theory or as a reason why something has happened
exampleEn: She cited three reasons why people get into debt.
exampleCn: 她举出了人们为何负债的三个原因。

en: If two or more things coalesce, they come or grow together to form one thing or system.
exampleEn: The puddles had coalesced into a small stream.
exampleCn: 地面上水洼子里的水汇流成了一条小溪。

en: to risk having a harmful effect on something
exampleEn: We would never compromise the safety of our passengers.
exampleCn: 我们永远不会做有损乘客安全的事。

cn: 专注，专心；全神贯注；集中（注意力）
en: to direct your attention or your efforts towards a particular activity, subject, or problem
exampleEn: I can't concentrate on my work with all that noise.
exampleCn: 那么吵，我没法集中精力。

en: to limit an activity, person, or problem in some way
exampleEn: By closing the infected farms we're hoping to confine the disease to the north of the region.
exampleCn: 通过关闭受感染的农场，我们希望把疾病限制在该地区的北部。

en: to come together in a large group of people or animals
exampleEn: Young people often congregate in the main square in the evenings.
exampleCn: 年轻人傍晚时经常聚集在大广场上。

en: in large amounts, or more than enough
exampleEn: They drank copious amounts of wine.
exampleCn: 他们喝了好多酒。

cn: 核心，关键，最重要的部分
en: the basic and most important part of something
exampleEn: The lack of government funding is at the core of the problem.
exampleCn: 缺乏政府拨款是问题的关键所在。

en: the often gradual development of something, or the way something happens, or a way of doing something
exampleEn: Did the scandal have any effect on the course of the election?
exampleCn: 丑闻对选举进程有影响吗?

cn: 至关重要的；关键的；决定性的
en: extremely important or necessary
exampleEn: Her work has been crucial to the project's success.
exampleCn: 她的工作对于这个项目的成功至关重要。

en: a signal for someone to do something
exampleEn: They started washing up, so that was our cue to leave the party.
exampleCn: 他们开始洗刷碗碟了，这就是暗示我们该离开聚会了。

en: in a way that follows the usual or traditional way of doing something
exampleEn: Marriages in medieval Europe were customarily arranged by the families.
exampleCn: 在中世纪的欧洲，婚姻通常是由双方的家庭安排的。

en: clearly separate or different in shape or form
exampleEn: These small companies now have their own discrete identity.
exampleCn: 这些小公司现在都各有各的特点。

en: a difference between two similar things
exampleEn: There's a clear distinction between the dialects spoken in the two regions.
exampleCn: 这两个地区的方言有着明显的不同。

en: to record the details of an event, a process, etc.
exampleEn: His interest in cars has been well-documented by the media.
exampleCn: 他对汽车的兴趣在媒体的报道中都有详细的记载。

en: belonging or relating to the home, house, or family
exampleEn: She felt fenced in by domestic routine.
exampleCn: 她感到被日常家务束缚住了。

cn: （尤指行动）严厉的，猛烈的，激烈的
en: (especially of actions) severe and sudden or having very noticeable effects
exampleEn: Many employees have had to take drastic cuts in pay.
exampleCn: 许多员工不得不接受大幅降薪。

en: a disadvantage or the negative part of a situation
exampleEn: One of the drawbacks of living with someone is having to share a bathroom.
exampleCn: 和别人合住的缺点之一就是不得不合用洗手间。

cn: （使）小心缓慢地移动；（使）缓缓移动
en: to move or to make something move slowly and carefully in a particular direction or into a particular position
exampleEn: I eased myself out of the chair.
exampleCn: 我慢慢地从椅子上站起身。

en: an advantage over other people
exampleEn: In terms of experience, she definitely had the edge over the other people that we interviewed.
exampleCn: 就工作经验而言，她显然要比我们面试过的其他人都胜出一筹。

en: to accept something enthusiastically
exampleEn: They have clearly embraced Western consumerism.
exampleCn: 他们显然完全接受了西方的消费主义观念。

en: relating to the most important characteristics or ideas of something
exampleEn: What he's saying is essentially true.
exampleCn: 他说的基本上都是实话。

cn: 专用的，专有的；独有的，独占的
en: limited to only one person or group of people
exampleEn: This room is for the exclusive use of guests.
exampleCn: 这个房间是专供客人使用的。

cn: 如实的，丝毫不作改动的
en: true or not changing any of the details, facts, style, etc. of the original
exampleEn: She gave a faithful account of what had happened on that night.
exampleCn: 她如实讲述了那晚发生的事情。

en: strong and powerful
exampleEn: He launched a fierce attack on the Democrats.
exampleCn: 他对民主党人发动了猛烈的攻击。

en: happening because of good luck
exampleEn: Fortunately, we got home before it started to rain.
exampleCn: 很幸运，我们在开始下雨之前回到了家。

cn: 组织、公司、学校等的）创建，创办
en: the act of starting something for the first time; introducing something new
exampleEn: She was the driving spirit in the founding of New York's Museum of Modern Art.
exampleCn: 她推动了纽约现代艺术博物馆的建立。

en: N/A
exampleEn: Further more, he supplied some coordinate evidence.
exampleCn: 此外，他还提供了一些并列的证据。

en: a piece of clothing
exampleEn: This garment must be dry-cleaned only.
exampleCn: 这件衣服只可干洗。

en: (in) total
exampleEn: A person's gross income is the money they earn before tax is deducted from it.
exampleCn: 个人总收入是指税前的收入总和。

en: starting from this time
exampleEn: Henceforth, the said building shall be the property of Brendan Duggan.
exampleCn: 从现在开始，该大楼将是布伦丹‧达根的财产。

en: able to be recognized
exampleEn: In her bright yellow coat, she was easily identifiable in the crowd.
exampleCn: 她穿着鲜艳的黄色外套，在人群中很容易辨认。

en: to make it more difficult for something to happen or more difficult for someone to do something
exampleEn: Although he's shy, it certainly hasn't impeded his career in any way.
exampleCn: 尽管他很害羞，但这显然一点儿也没有妨碍他的事业。

en: something that encourages a particular activity or makes that activity more energetic or effective
exampleEn: The recent publicity surrounding homelessness has given a fresh impetus to the cause.
exampleCn: 最近围绕无家可归者的宣传对这一事业是个新的推动。

en: to start using a plan or system
exampleEn: The changes to the national health system will be implemented next year.
exampleCn: 国民医疗保健制度的改革将于明年实施。

en: an event, or the rate at which something happens
exampleEn: The incidence of breast cancer increases with age.
exampleCn: 乳腺癌的发病率随着年龄的增长而上升。

en: necessary and important as a part of a whole
exampleEn: He's an integral part of the team and we can't do without him.
exampleCn: 他是球队不可缺少的一员，没有他我们可不行。

en: to decide what the intended meaning of something is
exampleEn: It's difficult to interpret these statistics without knowing how they were obtained.
exampleCn: 不了解这些统计数字是怎样得来的就难以理解它们。

en: very large in size, amount, or number
exampleEn: She died after taking a massive overdose of drugs.
exampleCn: 她在吸食过量毒品后死亡。
