en: to cause someone to behave in a particular way
exampleEn: Like so many people, he's motivated by greed.
exampleCn: 像许多人一样，他为贪婪所驱使。

en: something that blocks a road, passage, entrance, etc. so that nothing can go along it, or the act of blocking something in this way
exampleEn: There's some kind of obstruction on the railway tracks.
exampleCn: 铁轨上有障碍物。

en: strongly or completely; in an overwhelming way
exampleEn: The team were overwhelmingly defeated in yesterday's game.
exampleCn: 在昨天的比赛中这支球队遭遇了惨败。

en: great danger, or something that is very dangerous
exampleEn: I never felt that my life was in peril.
exampleCn: 我从未意识到我的生命受到了严重的威胁。

en: Something that is pointless has no purpose, and it is a waste of time doing it.
exampleEn: This is a pointless exercise.
exampleCn: 这个练习毫无意义。

cn: （时间、顺序、重要程度等的）居前，领先
en: the condition of being dealt with before other things or of being considered more important than other things
exampleEn: Precedence must be given to the injured in the evacuation plans.
exampleCn: 在疏散计划中应优先考虑伤者。

en: existing in a particular place or at a particular time
exampleEn: The prevailing mood is one of optimism.
exampleCn: 普遍的情绪是乐观的。

en: the fact of something increasing a lot and suddenly in number or amount
exampleEn: The past two years have seen the proliferation of TV channels.
exampleCn: 过去的两年见证了电视频道数量的激增。

en: in a way that produces a great number or amount of something
exampleEn: He wrote prolifically throughout the 1950s.
exampleCn: 他在二十世纪五十年代大量地进行写作。

en: a quality in a substance or material, especially one that means that it can be used in a particular way
exampleEn: One of the properties of copper is that it conducts heat and electricity very well.
exampleCn: 铜的特性之一是导热导电能力强。

cn: 成功；（尤指经济上的）繁荣，昌盛
en: the state of being successful and having a lot of money
exampleEn: A country's future prosperity depends, to an extent, upon the quality of education of its people.
exampleCn: 一个国家未来的繁荣昌盛在一定程度上取决于国民的教育质量。

cn: 反复出现；再次发生；重新产生
en: to happen many times or to happen again
exampleEn: The theme of freedom recurs throughout her writing.
exampleCn: 自由这一主题在她的写作中反复出现。

en: to improve an idea, method, system, etc. by making small changes
exampleEn: Engineers spent many months refining the software.
exampleCn: 工程师们花了数月来完善这个软件。

en: famous for something
exampleEn: The region is renowned for its outstanding natural beauty.
exampleCn: 该地区因其秀美壮丽的自然风光而享有盛誉。

cn: 因而发生的；作为结果的
en: caused by the event or situation that you have just mentioned
exampleEn: Plus, since the pandemic and resultant labour shortages hit, employers are increasingly aware that skilled people are steering well clear of poorly remunerated work.
exampleCn: 另外，由于疫情导致的劳动力短缺，雇主们也越来越意识到，技术人员正在远离低薪工作。

cn: 僵硬的；固定的；不能弯曲的
en: stiff or fixed; not able to be bent or moved
exampleEn: I was rigid with fear.
exampleCn: 我被吓得呆若木鸡。

cn: 一连串；一系列；顺序，次序
en: a series of related things or events, or the order in which they follow each other
exampleEn: The first chapter describes the strange sequence of events that led to his death.
exampleCn: 第一章描述了造成他死亡的一连串奇特事件。

en: to end or severely damage something
exampleEn: The book shattered all her illusions about the Romans.
exampleCn: 这本书击碎了她对罗马人的一切幻想。

en: tto be a sign of something; to mean
exampleEn: Nobody really knows what the marks on the ancient stones signify.
exampleCn: 没人真正知道那些古代石头上的记号代表什么含义。

en: doubting that something is true or useful
exampleEn: Many experts remain skeptical of his claims.
exampleCn: 很多专家对他的主张仍然持怀疑态度。

en: an attitude that shows you doubt whether something is true or useful
exampleEn: The company's environmental claims have been treated with scepticism by conservationists.
exampleCn: 该公司的环保主张受到环保主义者的质疑。

en: relating to one thing and not others; particular
exampleEn: The virus attacks specific cells in the brain.
exampleCn: 这种病毒专门攻击大脑内特定的细胞。

en: to explain or describe something clearly and exactly
exampleEn: He said we should meet but didn't specify a time.
exampleCn: 他说我们应该见见面，但没说具体时间。

cn: 壮观的，壮丽的；令人惊叹的
en: very exciting to look at
exampleEn: He scored a spectacular goal in the second half.
exampleCn: 他在下半场攻进了漂亮的一球。

en: (of water or air) not flowing or moving, and smelling unpleasant
exampleEn: The canal that goes through the centre is stinking and stagnant.
exampleCn: 通过市区的运河一潭死水、臭气熏天。

cn: （使）潜入水中，（使）没入水中；浸没
en: to go below or make something go below the surface of the sea or a river or lake
exampleEn: The waters were rising about the rock and would soon submerge it.
exampleCn: 水涨到快跟岩石一样高了，很快就会将它淹没。

en: to replace
exampleEn: Printed books will soon be supplanted by e-books.
exampleCn: 纸质书将很快被电子书取代。

en: doubt or lack of trust
exampleEn: Since they discovered the truth about his background, his colleagues have regarded him with suspicion.
exampleCn: 自从他的同事知道了他的真实背景，就不再信任他了。

en: a planned way of doing something
exampleEn: These bomb attacks represent a change of tactics by the terrorists.
exampleCn: 这些炸弹袭击事件表明恐怖分子改变了策略。

cn: 真实的；非想象的；可触摸的；可感知的
en: real and not imaginary; able to be shown, touched, or experienced
exampleEn: We need tangible evidence if we're going to take legal action.
exampleCn: 如果我们要采取法律行动，就需要有实实在在的证据。

cn: 相同的；一律的；整齐划一的
en: the same; not changing or different in any way
exampleEn: The office walls and furniture are a uniform grey.
exampleCn: 办公室的墙壁和家具一律都是灰色的。

cn: 相同地；一律地；整齐划一地
en: in a way that is the same everywhere or for everyone
exampleEn: My experiences travelling to the US have been uniformly positive.
exampleCn: 我去美国旅行的经历一直都很愉快。

en: existing everywhere or involving everyone
exampleEn: The new reforms have not met with universal approval within the party.
exampleCn: 新的改革措施在政府内部还没有得到一致赞同。

en: completely or extremely
exampleEn: She was utterly devastated when her husband died.
exampleCn: 当她的丈夫去世时，她完全奔溃了。

en: to disappear or stop being present or existing, especially in a sudden, surprising way
exampleEn: Cheap rural housing is vanishing in the south of the country.
exampleCn: 廉价的乡间住房在该国南部行将绝迹。

cn: 充满活力地；有力量地；精力旺盛地
en: in a way that is very forceful or energetic
exampleEn: He vigorously denied the accusations.
exampleCn: 他极力否认这些指控。

en: to be strong enough, or not be changed by something, or to oppose a person or thing successfully
exampleEn: Our toys are designed to withstand the rough treatment of the average five-year-old.
exampleCn: 我们的玩具设计要能经得住一般五岁儿童粗野的摆弄。

en: to get something
exampleEn: She has acquired a good knowledge of English.
exampleCn: 她英语已经学得很好。

en: to allow someone to have something pleasant or necessary
exampleEn: The tree affords some shelter from the sun.
exampleCn: 这棵树可以挡一挡太阳。

en: a result that your plans or actions are intended to achieve
exampleEn: Our main aim is to increase sales in Europe.
exampleCn: 我们的主要目标是增加在欧洲的销售量。

en: although
exampleEn: The evening was very pleasant, albeit a little quiet.
exampleCn: 那个夜晚过得非常愉快，尽管有点儿冷清。

cn: 把…系住（或扎牢）；使稳固，使固定
en: to make something or someone stay in one position by fastening him, her, or it firmly
exampleEn: We anchored ourselves to the rocks with a rope.
exampleCn: 我们用绳子把自己固定在岩石上。

en: to destroy something completely so that nothing is left
exampleEn: The human race has enough weapons to annihilate itself.
exampleCn: 人类有足够的武器灭绝自己。

en: to understand a situation and realize that it is important
exampleEn: I appreciate that it's a difficult decision for you to make.
exampleCn: 我体会得出，你作出这样的决定有多难。

en: to come near or nearer to something or someone in space, time, quality, or amount
exampleEn: We could just see the train approaching in the distance.
exampleCn: 我们刚好能看到火车从远处驶来。

en: to be almost the same as
exampleEn: Student numbers this year are expected to approximate 5,000.
exampleCn: 预计今年学生人数可达五千人左右。

en: difficult, needing a lot of effort and energy
exampleEn: Climbing Mount Everest is an arduous, exhausting challenge.
exampleCn: 攀登珠穆朗玛峰是一项艰难的挑战。

en: to discover something
exampleEn: The police have so far been unable to ascertain the cause of the explosion.
exampleCn: 警方到目前为止尚未查明爆炸原因。

en: to absorb food or a substance into the tissue of a living organism
exampleEn: In this form vitamins can be easily assimilated by the body.
exampleCn: 在这种形态下，维生素非常易于身体吸收。

cn: 可以达到的；可以获得的
en: possible to achieve
exampleEn: We must ensure that we do not set ourselves goals that are not attainable.
exampleCn: 我们切不可给自己定下一些无法实现的目标。

en: to cause someone to be completely unable to understand or explain something
exampleEn: She was completely baffled by his strange behavior.
exampleCn: 她完全被他怪异的举动搞糊涂了。

en: helpful, useful, or good
exampleEn: A stay in the country will be beneficial to his health.
exampleCn: 在乡下生活一段时间，有利于他的健康。

en: large size or mass
exampleEn: It was a document of surprising bulk.
exampleCn: 这是一份篇幅惊人的文件。

en: to judge the number or amount of something by using the information that you already have, and adding, taking away, multiplying, or dividing numbers
exampleEn: At some stage we need to calculate when the project will be finished.
exampleCn: 在一定阶段，我们需要计算一下工程何时会结束。

cn: 可共存的；协调的；兼容的
en: able to exist, live together, or work successfully with something or someone else
exampleEn: Such policies are not compatible with democratic government.
exampleCn: 此类政策与民主政体格格不入。

en: to be the parts that something is made of
exampleEn: Ten men compose the committee.
exampleCn: 委员会由十人组成。

en: to have as parts or members, or to be those parts or members
exampleEn: The course comprises a class book, a practice book, and a CD.
exampleCn: 这门课的教材包括一本课堂用书、一本练习用书和一张光盘。

en: to prevent something from being seen or known about
exampleEn: The listening device was concealed in a pen.
exampleCn: 窃听装置藏在了笔里。

en: a large number or amount of something in the same place
exampleEn: There is a heavy concentration of troops in the area.
exampleCn: 该地区有重兵驻扎。

en: a principle or idea
exampleEn: The concept of free speech is unknown to them.
exampleCn: 他们没有言论自由的概念。

en: the particular arrangement or pattern of a group of related things
exampleEn: We tried the furniture in different configurations to see which fit best.
exampleCn: 我们尝试了不同的家具布局，看看哪一种最适合。

en: to make something blocked or crowded in a way that causes difficulties, or to become blocked or crowded
exampleEn: There is no need for us to congest the city with traffic.
exampleCn: 我们没有必要让城里的交通变得拥挤。

en: a situation in which a place is too blocked or crowded, causing difficulties
exampleEn: These facilities are designed to ease the congestion of emergency rooms.
exampleCn: 这些设施旨在缓解急诊室的拥挤状况。

en: a lot of disagreement or argument about something, usually because it affects or is important to many people
exampleEn: There was a big controversy over the use of drugs in athletics.
exampleCn: 体育界对使用违禁药物争议很大。

cn: （使）改变，（使）转变；（使）改信；（使）皈依
en: to (cause something or someone to) change in form or character
exampleEn: What's the formula for converting pounds into kilograms?
exampleCn: 把磅换算成公斤的公式是什么？

en: If two or more facts, numbers, etc. correlate or are correlated, there is a relationship between them.
exampleEn: Stress levels and heart disease are strongly correlated.
exampleCn: 压力程度和心脏病密切相关。

en: in a way that is very bad or serious
exampleEn: They were both critically injured in the accident.
exampleCn: 他俩在车祸中都身受重伤。

en: in a way that is extremely important or necessary
exampleEn: The vessels had little food and, crucially, no engines.
exampleCn: 船上的食物很少，而更为关键的是船没有引擎。

en: If an event or series of events culminates in something, it ends with it, having developed until it reaches this point.
exampleEn: Their summer tour will culminate at a spectacular concert in London.
exampleCn: 在伦敦举行的一场精彩的音乐会将为他们的夏季巡回演出画上句号。

en: to explain and describe the meaning and exact limits of something
exampleEn: We need to define the task ahead very clearly.
exampleCn: 我们需要明确今后的任务。

en: a feeling of wanting better treatment or an improved situation
exampleEn: Discontent among junior ranks was rapidly spreading.
exampleCn: 下级军官的不满情绪正在迅速蔓延。

en: to hide an opinion, a feeling, etc.
exampleEn: I couldn't disguise my disappointment.
exampleCn: 我无法掩饰自己的失望。

en: to become weaker or be destroyed by breaking into small pieces
exampleEn: The plane disintegrated as it fell into the sea.
exampleCn: 飞机坠入大海时解体了。

en: a change to the original or natural shape of something
exampleEn: When you project the photographs onto a surface, some distortion of the image may occur.
exampleCn: 将照片投射到表面时，可能会出现图像变形的情况。

cn: （无毒而）可以吃的；适宜食用的
en: suitable or safe for eating
exampleEn: Only the leaves of the plant are edible.
exampleCn: 这种植物仅叶子可食。

en: to remove or take away someone or something
exampleEn: This diet claims to eliminate toxins from the body.
exampleCn: 这种饮食据称具有排除体内毒素的作用。

en: to come out of or be produced by something or someone
exampleEn: Marital problems emanate from selfishness and pride.
exampleCn: 婚姻的问题，来自于我们的自私和骄傲。

en: to make something necessary, or to involve something
exampleEn: Such a large investment inevitably entails some risk.
exampleCn: 这样的巨额投资必然会有一定的风险。

en: to get rid of something completely or destroy something bad
exampleEn: The government claims to be doing all it can to eradicate corruption.
exampleCn: 政府声称正尽其所能根治腐败。

en: to remove or destroy something, especially something that shows that that person or thing ever existed or happened
exampleEn: You cannot erase injustice from the world.
exampleCn: 任何人都不可能让非正义从世界上消失。

en: to use something
exampleEn: I exercised my democratic right by not voting in the election.
exampleCn: 在选举中，我通过拒不投票的方式来行使我的民主权利。

cn: 运用；行使（权威、权力等）；施加（影响等）
en: to use something such as authority, power, influence, etc. in order to make something happen
exampleEn: Some managers exert considerable pressure on their staff to work extra hours without being paid.
exampleCn: 一些老板向员工施加巨大的压力迫使他们无偿加班。

en: to make something possible or easier
exampleEn: The new ramp will facilitate the entry of wheelchairs.
exampleCn: 新坡道将方便轮椅进入。

cn: 可行的；行得通的；做得到的
en: able to be made, done, or achieved
exampleEn: With the extra resources, the project now seems feasible.
exampleCn: 有了额外的资源，这个计划现在看来是可行的。

en: to escape by running away, especially because of danger or fear
exampleEn: Many refugees have been forced to flee from their homeland.
exampleCn: 很多难民被迫逃离了祖国。

cn: 茁壮成长；繁荣；蓬勃发展
en: to grow or develop successfully
exampleEn: These plants flourish in a damp climate.
exampleCn: 这些植物在潮湿的气候下长势茂盛。

en: to encourage the development or growth of ideas or feelings
exampleEn: The club's aim is to foster better relations within the community.
exampleCn: 俱乐部的宗旨是促进团体内部的关系。

en: standing alone and not attached to a wall, etc.
exampleEn: I'd like to get a freestanding dishwasher.
exampleCn: 我想买一个独立式的洗碗机。

en: to supply a system with a substance that can be burned to provide heat or power
exampleEn: Our heating is fuelled by gas.
exampleCn: 我们的供暖系统是烧天然气的。

en: to do something that is expected, hoped for, or promised, or to cause it to happen
exampleEn: Zoos fulfill an important function in the protection of rare species.
exampleCn: 动物园起着保护珍稀动物的重要功能。

cn: （以某种形式）产生，发生（能量等）
en: to produce energy in a particular form
exampleEn: The new development will generate 1,500 new jobs.
exampleCn: 新开发项目将会创造一千五百个新的就业岗位。

en: the production of energy in a particular form
exampleEn: The power-generation plant belched out five tons of ash an hour.
exampleCn: 发电厂每小时喷出了五吨的灰。

en: to promise that something will happen or exist
exampleEn: European Airlines guarantees its customers top-quality service.
exampleCn: 欧洲航空公司保证为乘客提供最好的服务。

en: Hasty actions are done in a hurry, sometimes without the necessary care or thought.
exampleEn: He warned against making hasty decisions.
exampleCn: 他警告过不要仓促作出决定。

en: until now or until a particular time
exampleEn: Mira revealed hitherto unsuspected talents on the dance floor.
exampleCn: 时至今日，米拉已经显示出了在舞蹈方面潜藏的非凡才能。

en: having a hole or empty space inside
exampleEn: Hollow blocks are used because they are lighter.
exampleCn: 使用空心砖是因为它们更轻。

en: used when describing the perfect situation
exampleEn: Ideally, I'd like to work at home but it's just not practical.
exampleCn: 对我来说最理想的是在家上班，可这根本不现实。

cn: 不大可能发生的；未必确实的
en: not likely to happen or be true
exampleEn: It's highly improbable that Norris will agree.
exampleCn: 诺里斯很可能不会同意。

en: to encourage someone to do or feel something unpleasant or violent
exampleEn: She was expelled for inciting her classmates to rebel against their teachers.
exampleCn: 她因煽动同学反对老师而被开除。

cn: 不加思考的，未加计划的，任意的（尤指带来不良后果）
en: not showing careful thought or planning, especially so that harm results
exampleEn: The indiscriminate use of fertilizers can cause long-term problems.
exampleCn: 滥用化肥可能导致长期的问题。

en: the process of absorbing nutrients or medications into the body by eating or drinking them
exampleEn: There is a therapy option that does not require the ingestion of drugs.
exampleCn: 有一种不需要摄取药物的治疗方案。

en: to say firmly or demand forcefully, especially when others disagree with or oppose what you say
exampleEn: Greg still insists that he did nothing wrong.
exampleCn: 格雷格仍坚称自己没有做错任何事。

en: the action or process of combining two or more things in an effective way
exampleEn: The heads of government were trying to encourage regional integration.
exampleCn: 各国政府首脑正努力鼓励区域一体化。

en: the strength of something that can be measured such as light, sound, etc.
exampleEn: When a surface is perpendicular to the rays, their intensity is at its maximum.
exampleCn: 当表面与射线垂直时，射线的强度最大。

en: planned or intended
exampleEn: Did you leave his name out by accident or was it intentional?
exampleCn: 你漏掉了他的名字，是无意的还是有意的？

cn: 亲密的；有性关系的；宜于密切关系的
en: having, or being likely to cause, a very close friendship or personal or sexual relationship
exampleEn: He's become very intimate with an actress.
exampleCn: 他和一名女演员的关系非常亲密。

cn: 错综复杂的；复杂精细的；难理解的；难解决的
en: having a lot of small parts or details that are arranged in a complicated way and are therefore sometimes difficult to understand, solve, or produce
exampleEn: The watch mechanism is extremely intricate and very difficult to repair.
exampleCn: 手表的机械结构非常复杂精细，很难修理。

en: being an extremely important and basic characteristic of a person or thing
exampleEn: Diamonds have little intrinsic value and their price depends almost entirely on their scarcity.
exampleCn: 钻石没有多少内在价值，它们的价格几乎完全取决于其稀有程度。

en: to act in a way that causes or encourages something to happen or someone to believe or feel something
exampleEn: Behaving provocatively in class is just inviting trouble.
exampleCn: 课堂上的挑衅行为只会带来麻烦。

en: fair; morally correct
exampleEn: The judge's sentence was perfectly just in the circumstances.
exampleCn: 在这种情况下，法官的判决非常公正。

en: a good reason or explanation for something
exampleEn: There is no justification for treating people so badly.
exampleCn: 没有理由如此恶劣地对待他人。

en: food remaining after a meal
exampleEn: Making soup is a good way of using up leftover vegetables.
exampleCn: 把剩下的蔬菜全部用来做汤是个好主意。

en: in the same way
exampleEn: Just water these plants twice a week, and likewise the ones in the bedroom.
exampleCn: 这些植物一周浇两次水，卧室里的那些也一样。

en: to make a problem bigger or more important
exampleEn: The hot summer magnified the racial tensions in the community.
exampleCn: 炎热的夏日加深了社区的种族矛盾。

en: the most important part of something, providing support for everything else
exampleEn: Cattle farming is the mainstay of the country's economy.
exampleCn: 养牛业是这个国家的经济支柱。

en: to express firmly your belief that something is true
exampleEn: Throughout his prison sentence, Dunn has always maintained his innocence.
exampleCn: 邓恩在监狱服刑期间一直坚称自己是无辜的。

en: to order someone to do something
exampleEn: Our delegates have been mandated to vote against the proposal at the conference.
exampleCn: 我们的代表受命在会议上对提议投反对票。

en: extremely good
exampleEn: He's done a marvellous job of the decorating.
exampleCn: 他所做的装饰真是棒极了。

en: extremely or very much
exampleEn: The film is a massively ambitious project.
exampleCn: 这部电影是一个极具雄心的项目。

en: if two things match or if one thing matches another, they are the same or very similar
exampleEn: Her fingerprints match those found at the scene of the crime.
exampleCn: 她的指纹与犯罪现场的指纹相吻合。

en: a mean number is an average number
exampleEn: Their mean weight was 76.4 kilos.
exampleCn: 他们的平均体重是七十六点四公斤。

en: power, strength, or force
exampleEn: Pizarro defeated the might of the Inca Empire with only a few hundred men.
exampleCn: 皮萨罗依靠区区几百人打败了强大的印加帝国。

en: to copy the way in which a particular person usually speaks and moves, usually in order to make people laugh
exampleEn: She was mimicking the various people in our office.
exampleCn: 她在学我们办公室里各种人的样子。

en: (used to add information) also and more importantly
exampleEn: The whole report is badly written. Moreover, it's inaccurate.
exampleCn: 整个报告写得很差，而且还描述不实。

en: having many different parts
exampleEn: It's a multifaceted business, offering a range of services.
exampleCn: 这是一个业务多元化的企业，提供各种服务。

cn: 大量的； 各种各样的
en: Myriad means having a large number or great variety.
exampleEn: The magazine has been celebrating pop in all its myriad forms.
exampleCn: 该杂志一直在赞美各种形式的流行音乐。

en: to be greater or more important than something else
exampleEn: The benefits of this treatment far outweigh any risks.
exampleCn: 这种治疗方法的好处远远大于任何风险。

en: to watch or organize a job or an activity to make certain that it is being done correctly
exampleEn: As marketing manager, her job is to oversee all the company's advertising.
exampleCn: 作为营销经理，她的工作是负责公司所有的广告业务。

en: special, or this and not any other
exampleEn: She wanted a particular type of cactus.
exampleCn: 她要某一特定品种的仙人掌。

en: to move into or through something
exampleEn: Amazingly, the bullet did not penetrate his brain.
exampleCn: 令人惊讶的是，子弹并未射入他的脑部。

en: to spread through something and be present in every part of it
exampleEn: Dissatisfaction with the government seems to have permeated every section of society.
exampleCn: 社会的每一个角落似乎都弥漫着对政府的不满。

en: confusing, often because you do not know how to solve something
exampleEn: They find the company's attitude perplexing and unreasonable.
exampleCn: 他们觉得这家公司的态度令人困惑而且不合理。

cn: 不断困扰；折磨；使受煎熬
en: to cause worry, pain, or difficulty to someone or something over a period of time
exampleEn: Financial problems have been plaguing their new business partners.
exampleCn: 财政问题一直困扰着他们的新商业合作伙伴。

en: to think carefully about something, especially for a noticeable length of time
exampleEn: She sat back for a minute to ponder her next move in the game.
exampleCn: 她在椅背上靠了一会儿，思考下一步棋该怎么走。

en: light and small enough to be easily carried or moved
exampleEn: I have a portable typewriter.
exampleCn: 我有一个便携式打字机。

en: very simple and old-fashioned, especially when sth is also not convenient and comfortable
exampleEn: The facilities on the campsite were very primitive.
exampleCn: 营地的设施非常简陋。

en: in large amounts
exampleEn: She apologized us profusely.
exampleCn: 她再三向我们道歉。

en: Something that is in a prominent position can easily be seen.
exampleEn: New books are displayed in a prominent position on tables at the front of the store.
exampleCn: 新书陈列在商店前面桌子上的一个显眼位置。

cn: 有望的；可能的；预期的；潜在的
en: expected to do sth or to become sth
exampleEn: We've had three sets of prospective buyers looking at the house.
exampleCn: 已经有三批可能买我们房子的人来看过房子了。

en: completely or extremely
exampleEn: The accident radically changed the course of his life.
exampleCn: 这次事故从根本上改变了他的生活轨迹。

en: to suggest that someone or something would be good or suitable for a particular job or purpose, or to suggest that a particular action should be done
exampleEn: The headmistress agreed to recommend the teachers' proposals to the school governors.
exampleCn: 女校长同意把这位老师的建议提请学校董事们考虑。

en: the state of depending on or trusting in something or someone
exampleEn: The region's reliance on tourism is unwise.
exampleCn: 这一地区依赖旅游业谋发展是不明智的。

en: to need a particular thing or the help and support of someone or something in order to continue, to work correctly, or to succeed
exampleEn: The success of this project relies on everyone making an effort.
exampleCn: 这个项目的成功要靠每个人的努力。

en: used for emphasizing how surprising or unusual something is
exampleEn: It is a remarkably noisy and crowded city.
exampleCn: 这是座非常嘈杂拥挤的城市。

en: the act of refusing to accept something or someone as true, good, or reasonable
exampleEn: They were surprised by his sudden repudiation of all his former beliefs.
exampleCn: 他们对他突然否定自己以前的所有信仰感到惊讶。

en: to return something or someone to an earlier good condition or position
exampleEn: The badly neglected paintings have all been carefully restored.
exampleCn: 那些由于严重疏忽而损毁的画作得到了精心修复。

en: ordinary and not special or unusual
exampleEn: He died of a heart attack during a routine operation.
exampleCn: 他在一次普通手术中死于心脏病。

cn: （土地）荒芜崎岖的；崎岖难行的
en: (of land) wild and not even; not easy to travel over
exampleEn: The enemy would always have the advantage of familiarity with the rugged terrain.
exampleCn: 敌人会一直在对崎岖地形的熟悉上占有优势。

cn: 使…成为不可能，使…不可能发生；防止
en: to prevent something from happening
exampleEn: This recent wave of terrorism has ruled out any chance of peace talks.
exampleCn: 最近的这一波恐怖行动已经使得任何和谈的机会都化为泡影。

en: the size or level of something, especially when this is large
exampleEn: Nuclear weapons cause destruction on a massive scale.
exampleCn: 核武器杀伤力很大。

en: smaller in size or amount than is considered necessary or is hoped for
exampleEn: The rainfall was rather scanty this month.
exampleCn: 这个月的雨量不足。

cn: 多愁善感的；感情用事的
en: A sentimental person is strongly influenced by emotional feelings, especially about happy memories of past events or relationships with other people, rather than by careful thought and judgment based on facts.
exampleEn: It's a cheap ring but it has great sentimental value for me.
exampleCn: 这只戒指不贵，但对我来说却有很大的纪念价值。

en: in a way that follows a particular order
exampleEn: The engineers formerly performed their jobs sequentially, but can now do them concurrently.
exampleCn: 工程师们以前是按顺序进行工作的，但现在可以同时进行多项工作。

en: having only a short distance from the top to the bottom
exampleEn: The stream was fairly shallow so we were able to walk across it.
exampleCn: 小溪很浅，所以我们可以趟水过去。

en: importance
exampleEn: The discovery of the new drug is of great significance for people suffering from heart problems.
exampleCn: 这种新药的发现对心脏病患者来说具有重要意义。

en: the quality of being sophisticated
exampleEn: Her sophistication is evident from the way she dresses.
exampleCn: 从衣着打扮明显可以看出她精明老练。

en: a particular way of standing
exampleEn: Jenny took up a stance with her feet slightly apart, ready to catch the ball.
exampleCn: 珍妮两脚稍稍分开站好了姿势，准备接球。

en: (especially of people) height
exampleEn: His red hair and short stature made him easy to recognize.
exampleCn: 他红头发，五短身材，很容易认出来。

cn: （强调只适用于某人、物或情况）只，仅限于
en: used to emphasize that sth only applies to one particular person, thing or situation
exampleEn: I know we're friends, but this is strictly business.
exampleCn: 我知道我们是朋友，但这完全是公务。

en: having a very severe effect, or being extremely limiting
exampleEn: We need to introduce more stringent security measures such as identity cards.
exampleCn: 我们需要采取更为严格的安全措施，例如发放身份证

en: in a way that is small and difficult to notice or describe, but important
exampleEn: His expression changed subtly.
exampleCn: 他的表情微妙地变了。

en: to come after another person or thing in time
exampleEn: In the weeks that succeeded, five more patients showed similar symptoms.
exampleCn: 接下来的几周里，又有五名患者出现了类似的症状。

cn: 增补性的；补充性的；额外的；外加的
en: provided in addition to sth else in order to improve or complete it
exampleEn: They also will need supplementary food and firewood.
exampleCn: 他们还将需要得到食品和柴禾的补给。

en: used to express that you are certain or almost certain about something
exampleEn: The problem surely lies in the design of the equipment.
exampleCn: 问题肯定出在设备的设计上。

cn: 有条理地，有计划地，系统地
en: in a way that is done according to an agreed set of methods or organized plan
exampleEn: They aim to systematically tackle the root causes of the disease.
exampleCn: 他们的目标是系统地解决该疾病的根本原因。

en: not lasting or needed for very long
exampleEn: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.
exampleCn: 停火只能暂时解决危机。

en: to (cause something to) end or stop
exampleEn: They terminated my contract in October.
exampleCn: 他们在十月份终止了我的合同。

en: as a result of this action
exampleEn: We were unable to get funding and therefore had to abandon the project.
exampleCn: 我们无法筹到资金，因此不得不放弃计划。

en: the friendly feelings that people have for other people, or special connections with places
exampleEn: Family ties are weaker if you move a long way away.
exampleCn: 离家太远就会与家人疏远。

en: to accept behaviour and beliefs that are different from your own, although you might not agree with or approve of them
exampleEn: I will not tolerate that kind of behaviour in my class.
exampleCn: 在我的课堂上我不会容许那种行为。

en: a particular characteristic that can produce a particular type of behaviour
exampleEn: His sense of humour is one of his better traits.
exampleCn: 具有幽默感是他更讨人喜欢的特点之一。

cn: 变幻莫测的；难以预见的，无法预测的
en: likely to change suddenly and without reason and therefore not able to be predicted (= expected before it happens) or depended on
exampleEn: The result is entirely unpredictable.
exampleCn: 结果是完全无法预料的。

en: to prove that something exists or is true, or to make certain that something is correct
exampleEn: These numbers are surprisingly high and they'll have to be verified.
exampleCn: 这些数字高得令人吃惊，必须加以核实。

cn: 目击，看到（尤指事故或犯罪）
en: to see something happen, especially an accident or crime
exampleEn: Did anyone witness the attack?
exampleCn: 有人看到那次袭击了吗？

cn: 值得的；值得花钱（或时间、精力）的
en: useful, important, or good enough to be a suitable reward for the money or time spent or the effort made
exampleEn: She considers teaching a worthwhile career.
exampleCn: 她把教书看成是一项值得从事的事业。

en: in a sudden, unexpected, and sometimes unpleasant way
exampleEn: He stood up abruptly and went outside.
exampleCn: 他猛地站起身，向外面走去。

en: completely
exampleEn: I believed him absolutely.
exampleCn: 我绝对相信他。

en: the increase in the speed at which something happens
exampleEn: The acceleration in the decline of manufacturing industry began several years ago.
exampleCn: 制造业的加速衰退从几年前就开始了。

cn: 着重，强调；使明显，使突出
en: to emphasize a particular feature of something or to make something more noticeable
exampleEn: The new policy only serves to accentuate the inadequacy of help for the homeless.
exampleCn: 这项新政策更加突显了政府对无家可归者的扶助不足。

en: to finish something successfully or to achieve something
exampleEn: She accomplished such a lot during her visit.
exampleCn: 她在访问期间取得了丰硕的成果。

en: an amount of something that has been collected
exampleEn: Despite this accumulation of evidence, the government persisted in doing nothing.
exampleCn: 尽管种种迹象不断出现，政府仍然坚持不采取任何行动。

en: If a bad situation is acute, it causes severe problems or damage.
exampleEn: The problem of poverty is particularly acute in rural areas.
exampleCn: 贫困问题在农村地区尤为严重。

cn: 有适应能力的，能适应的；适应性强的
en: able or willing to change in order to suit different conditions
exampleEn: The survivors in this life seem to be those who are adaptable to change.
exampleCn: 能在这种生活状态下幸存的人好像都是那些可以适应变化的人。

en: sticky
exampleEn: He put on a strip of adhesive tape over the wound.
exampleCn: 他在伤口上贴了一条橡胶布。

cn: 绝妙地，极好地，可钦佩地
en: very well, or in a way that is admirable (= deserving respect or approval)
exampleEn: I think she coped admirably with a very difficult situation.
exampleCn: 我认为她出色地应对了非常困难的情况。

cn: （不快事件）结束后的一个时期；（不快事件的）后果
en: the period that follows an unpleasant event or accident, and the effects that it causes
exampleEn: Many more people died in the aftermath of the explosion.
exampleCn: 更多的人死于爆炸后的一段时间里。

cn: 聚集体，集成体；总数，合计
en: something formed by adding together several amounts or things
exampleEn: Snowflakes are loose aggregates of ice crystals.
exampleCn: 雪花是冰晶松散的凝聚体。

en: to help
exampleEn: Aided by heat and strong winds, the fire quickly spread.
exampleCn: 借助高温和大风，火势迅速蔓延。

cn: （通常指轻微地）改动，修改；改变，（使）变化
en: a change, usually a slight change, in the appearance, character, or structure of something
exampleEn: Some alterations to our original plans might be necessary.
exampleCn: 或许有必要对我们最初的计划作一些改动。

en: to happen or exist one after the other repeatedly
exampleEn: She alternated between cheerfulness and deep despair.
exampleCn: 她时而情绪亢奋，时而又深陷绝望之中。

en: more than enough
exampleEn: There's ample evidence that the lawyer knew exactly what she was doing.
exampleCn: 有充分的证据表明，该律师十分清楚她自己在做什么。

en: old-fashioned or unsuitable for modern society
exampleEn: It will take many years to modernize these antiquated industries.
exampleCn: 这些老工业实现现代化将需要很多年的时间。

en: an uncomfortable feeling of nervousness or worry about something that is happening or might happen in the future
exampleEn: If you're worried about your health, share your anxieties with your doctor.
exampleCn: 你要是担心自己的健康，就把你的忧虑告诉医生吧。

en: except for or not considering
exampleEn: Apart from a brief interlude of peace, the war lasted nine years.
exampleCn: 除了一段短暂的和平，那场战争持续了九年。

en: a violent attack
exampleEn: He was charged with sexual assault.
exampleCn: 他被指控性侵犯。

en: to say that something is certainly true
exampleEn: She continued to assert that she was innocent.
exampleCn: 她仍然坚称自己无辜。

cn: 与…不合；与…意见不一致；与…相矛盾
en: in disagreement with
exampleEn: The findings, published in Global Change Biology, are at odds with previous research.
exampleCn: 该研究结果发表在了《全球变化生物学》上，与先前的研究意见相左。

en: to reach or succeed in getting something
exampleEn: He has attained the highest grade in his music exams.
exampleCn: 他在音乐考试中得了最高分。

en: to give support to someone or something with money or words
exampleEn: Other actions can be taken to back up the policy.
exampleCn: 可以采取其他行动来支持该政策。

en: without any clothes or not covered by anything
exampleEn: I can see the bare branches of winter trees.
exampleCn: 我能看见冬天树木光秃秃的枝丫。

en: by the smallest amount
exampleEn: She was barely 15 when she won her first championship.
exampleCn: 她首次获得冠军时刚刚十五岁。

en: a long pole, fence, wall, or natural feature, such as a mountain or sea, that stops people from going somewhere
exampleEn: Barriers have been erected all along the route the Pope will take.
exampleCn: 在教皇将要经过的路上，沿途都设置了路障。

en: N/A
exampleEn: The system is adaptable to different rope types and diameters.
exampleCn: 该系统可适应不同类型和直径的绳索。

en: in addition to; also
exampleEn: The house was out of our price range and too big anyway. Besides, I'd grown fond of our little rented house.
exampleCn: 反正这个房子超出了我们的预算范围，而且也太大了。再说，我已经渐渐喜欢上我们租的小房子了。

en: an important discovery or event that helps to improve a situation or provide an answer to a problem
exampleEn: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.
exampleCn: 科学家们希望在治愈癌症的研究上取得突破。

en: causing difficulties or work
exampleEn: The load was too burdensome.
exampleCn: 负担太繁重了。

en: to live or exist together at the same time or in the same place
exampleEn: Different traditions coexist successfully side by side.
exampleCn: 不同的传统和谐地共存着。

en: as a group
exampleEn: She has a staff of four who collectively earn almost $200,000.
exampleCn: 她有四名员工，创造收入近二十万美元。

cn: 常见的；经常的；普遍的；普通的；平常的
en: the same in a lot of places or for a lot of people
exampleEn: "Smith" is a very common name in Britain.
exampleCn: “史密斯”是英国很常见的姓氏。

en: to press something together in a tight and solid way
exampleEn: Cars had compacted the snow until it was like ice.
exampleCn: 汽车把雪碾得越来越实，直到变得像冰一样。

en: to cause worry to someone
exampleEn: The state of my father's health concerns us greatly.
exampleCn: 我父亲的健康状况让我们非常担心。

en: providing the right conditions for something good to happen or exist
exampleEn: In short, team spirit and effective communication are conducive to employee and business performance alike.
exampleCn: 总之，团队精神和有效的沟通有利于员工和企业的绩效。

en: to build something or put together different parts to form something whole
exampleEn: You must learn how to construct a logical argument.
exampleCn: 你必须学会怎样确立合乎逻辑的论点。

en: to have something inside or include something as a part
exampleEn: Try to avoid foods which contain a lot of fat.
exampleCn: 尽量别吃脂肪含量高的食物。

en: without a pause or interruption
exampleEn: The orientation of the planet's orbit is changing continuously.
exampleCn: 该行星轨道的方向不断变化。

en: suitable for your purposes and needs and causing the least difficulty
exampleEn: A bicycle is often more convenient than a car in towns.
exampleCn: 在城镇骑自行车常常比开车更方便。

cn: 传统；（尤指社会）习俗，常规，惯例
en: a usual or accepted way of behaving, especially in social situations, often following an old way of thinking or a custom in one particular society
exampleEn: In many countries, it is a convention to wear black at funerals.
exampleCn: 在葬礼上穿黑色的衣服是许多国家的习俗。

cn: 令人信服的；有说服力的
en: able to make you believe that something is true or right
exampleEn: The end of the book wasn't very convincing.
exampleCn: 这本书的结局难以令人信服。

en: to add proof to an account, statement, idea, etc. with new information
exampleEn: Recent research seems to corroborate his theory.
exampleCn: 最新研究似乎证实了他的理论。

en: to react to something with an opposing opinion or action, or to defend yourself against something
exampleEn: Such arguments are not easily countered.
exampleCn: 这种论点不易反驳。

cn: 粗糙的；简陋的；粗制的；未加修饰的
en: simple and not skilfully done or made
exampleEn: Crude oil is the world's most important commodity.
exampleCn: 原油是世界上最重要的商品。

cn: 培养，培育；养成；陶冶；改进
en: to try to develop and improve something
exampleEn: At the primary level, the main aim is to cultivate good habits, like learning to plan and exercising self-discipline.
exampleCn: 在小学阶段，主要目的是培养良好的习惯，如学会做计划和锻炼自律的能力。

en: (an) amount or level of something
exampleEn: The number of terrorist attacks has increased to a terrifying degree.
exampleCn: 恐怖袭击的次数已经到了骇人的程度。

cn: 可以信赖的，可以信任的
en: If someone or something is dependable, you can have confidence in him, her, or it.
exampleEn: I need someone dependable to take care of the children while I'm at work.
exampleCn: 我上班的时候需要有一个可靠的人来照顾孩子们。

en: to choose someone officially to do a particular job
exampleEn: Thompson has been designated to be team captain.
exampleCn: 汤姆森被指定为队长。

cn: 值得拥有的；渴望获得的，令人向往的
en: worth having and wanted by most people
exampleEn: She chatted for a few minutes about the qualities she considered desirable in a secretary.
exampleCn: 她随便谈了谈她认为一个秘书应有的品质。

en: to separate or remove something from something else that it is connected to
exampleEn: You can detach the hood if you prefer the coat without it.
exampleCn: 大衣上的帽兜如果不想要可以拆掉。

en: the fact or process of becoming worse
exampleEn: The recent deterioration has been caused by an apparently endless recession.
exampleCn: 最近的恶化是由貌似没完没了的萧条造成的。

en: something that controls or affects what happens in a particular situation
exampleEn: Soil and climate are the main determinants of how land is used.
exampleCn: 土壤和气候是土地使用形式的决定因素。

en: causing harm or damage
exampleEn: These chemicals have a detrimental effect on the environment.
exampleCn: 这些化学品对环境有危害。

cn: 巧妙构思；巧妙设计；发明
en: to invent a plan, system, object, etc., usually using your intelligence or imagination
exampleEn: He's good at devising language games that you can play with students in class.
exampleCn: 他善于设计可供师生在课堂上使用的语言游戏。

en: to notice or understand the difference between two things, or to make one person or thing seem different from another
exampleEn: I sometimes have difficulty distinguishing Spanish from Portuguese.
exampleCn: 我有时很难分清西班牙语和葡萄牙语。

en: something that you have to do because it is part of your job, or something that you feel is the right thing to do
exampleEn: The duty of the agency is to act in the best interests of the child.
exampleCn: 这个机构的责任就是为孩子谋取最大利益。

en: a house or place to live in
exampleEn: The present position of the house coincides with that of an earlier dwelling.
exampleCn: 这栋房子现在的位置恰与原住宅的位置一致。

en: to use something
exampleEn: Sophisticated statistical analysis was employed to obtain these results.
exampleCn: 利用尖端的统计分析技术得到了这些结果。

en: wishing you had what another person has
exampleEn: Being envious of another's achievements is painful.
exampleCn: 嫉妒别人的成就是很痛苦的。

en: respect for or a good opinion of someone
exampleEn: There has been a drop in public esteem for teachers.
exampleCn: 公众对教师的尊重程度有所下降。

en: equal or equally balanced
exampleEn: Children do not learn at an even pace.
exampleCn: 孩子学东西时快时慢。

cn: 显而易见的；明白的，明显的
en: easily seen or understood
exampleEn: From the smell it was evident that the drains had been blocked for several days.
exampleCn: 散发出的气味表明下水道显然已经被堵好几天了。

en: to make something seem larger, more important, better, or worse than it really is
exampleEn: The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.
exampleCn: 遭受袭击的威胁被过分夸大了。

en: to remove earth that is covering very old objects buried in the ground in order to discover things about the past
exampleEn: Ice age bones are being excavated in the caves.
exampleCn: 冰河时期的遗骸正从岩洞中发掘出来。

cn: 异国风情的，外国情调的；奇异的
en: unusual and exciting because of coming (or seeming to come) from far away, especially a tropical country
exampleEn: Distinctions between exotic and native species are artificial.
exampleCn: 外来物种和本地物种的区分是人为的。

en: to force air or liquid out of something
exampleEn: As the lungs exhale this waste, gas is expelled into the atmosphere.
exampleCn: 当肺呼出这股废气，气体就被排到空气中。

en: N/A
exampleEn: The school is experimenting with new teaching methods.
exampleCn: 这所学校正在尝试新的教学法。

en: in a way that is clear and exact
exampleEn: I told you quite explicitly to be home by midnight.
exampleCn: 我非常明确地告诉过你要在午夜前回到家。

en: in a very beautiful and delicate way
exampleEn: Their house is exquisitely furnished.
exampleCn: 他们的房子布置得非常精致。

en: one part of a subject, situation, etc. that has many parts
exampleEn: She has so many facets to her personality.
exampleCn: 她的性格具有多面性。

en: more than average, but less than very
exampleEn: I'm fairly sure that this is the right address.
exampleCn: 我相当肯定这个地址没错。

en: very thin or in very small pieces or drops
exampleEn: He has fine lines around his eyes.
exampleCn: 他的眼睛周围有细细的皱纹。

en: connected with (public) money
exampleEn: The government brought itself to the brink of fiscal disaster.
exampleCn: 该政府把自己带到了财政灾难的边缘。

cn: 较早的，早先的；以前的；旧时的
en: of or in an earlier time; before the present time or in the past
exampleEn: The painting was then restored to its former glory.
exampleCn: 这幅油画又恢复了原先的光彩。

en: more important than anything else
exampleEn: Some understanding of grammar is fundamental to learning a language.
exampleCn: 掌握一些语法对学习一种语言来说很重要。

cn: （尤指用测量仪器）测量，计量，测算
en: to calculate an amount, especially by using a measuring device
exampleEn: Use a thermometer to gauge the temperature.
exampleCn: 用温度计测量一下温度。

cn: 真正的；非伪造的；名副其实的
en: If something is genuine, it is real and exactly what it appears to be.
exampleEn: If it is a genuine Michelangelo drawing, it will sell for millions.
exampleCn: 如果这幅画是米开朗琪罗的真迹，它的售价将会达数百万。

en: extremely large
exampleEn: The cost has been gigantic.
exampleCn: 费用非常庞大。

cn: 按等级划分的；等级制度的
en: arranged according to people's or things' level of importance, or relating to such a system
exampleEn: The military has a hierarchical rank structure.
exampleCn: 军队的军衔结构是按等级划分的。

en: to show great respect for someone or something, especially in public
exampleEn: The President honoured us with a personal visit.
exampleCn: 总统亲临，使我们感到荣幸。

en: used to refer to something or someone that is close to, or is a cause of or an effect of, something or someone else
exampleEn: There are few facilities in the immediate area.
exampleCn: 在邻近地区几乎没有什么设施。

en: to communicate an idea or feeling without saying it directly
exampleEn: Variable rate loans, as the name implies, have a variable interest rate.
exampleCn: 可变利率贷款，正如名字所暗示的，是一种利率可能变化的贷款。

cn: （安排、想法或方法）不切实际的，不现实的
en: Impractical arrangements, ideas, or methods cannot be done or used easily or effectively.
exampleEn: It's impractical to have so many people all trying to use this equipment at the same time.
exampleCn: 要让这么多人同时使用这个设备是不切实际的。

en: having none of the characteristics of life that an animal or plant has
exampleEn: He looks at me as if I'm an inanimate object.
exampleCn: 他看着我的样子好像我是个没有生命的物体。

en: really or certainly, often used to emphasize something
exampleEn: Indeed, it could be the worst environmental disaster in Europe this century.
exampleCn: 这确实可能是本世纪西欧最严重的环境灾难。

en: something that shows what a situation is like
exampleEn: Commodity prices can be a useful indicator of inflation, he claimed.
exampleCn: 他声称，商品价格可以作为一种有用的通货膨胀指标。

en: in a way that cannot be avoided
exampleEn: Their arguments inevitably end in tears.
exampleCn: 他们的争论不可避免地以眼泪告终。

en: unable to be explained or understood
exampleEn: For some inexplicable reason, he's decided to cancel the project.
exampleCn: 出于某种无法解释的原因，他决定取消这个项目。

en: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
exampleEn: We will try to give cheap electric energy and heat to every inhabitant of the world.
exampleCn: 我们努力向全世界每位居民提供廉价的电能和热能。

en: in a way that exists as a natural or basic part of something
exampleEn: Man is not inherently violent.
exampleCn: 人类并非生来就暴力。

cn: 不好客的；不殷勤待客的
en: not welcoming or generous to people who visit you
exampleEn: I'll have to cook them a meal or they'll think I'm inhospitable.
exampleCn: 我得给他们做顿饭，否则他们会认为我不好客。

en: too many to be counted
exampleEn: The project has been delayed by innumerable problems.
exampleCn: 由于问题太多，计划已被推迟。

en: (the ability to have) a clear, deep, and sometimes sudden understanding of a complicated problem or situation
exampleEn: It was an interesting book, full of fascinating insights into human relationships.
exampleCn: 这是一本有趣的书，充满了对人际关系独到的见解。

en: the quality of being whole and complete
exampleEn: A modern extension on the old building would ruin its architectural integrity.
exampleCn: 在古老建筑物上附加扩建的现代建筑会破坏建筑风格的完整统一。

en: to have as a plan or purpose
exampleEn: We intend to go to Australia next year.
exampleCn: 我们打算明年去澳大利亚。

cn: 非常有趣的；引人入胜的；神秘的
en: very interesting because of being unusual or mysterious
exampleEn: She has a really intriguing personality.
exampleCn: 她的个性极具魅力。

cn: 不可改变的，不可逆转的
en: not possible to change; impossible to return to a previous condition
exampleEn: Smoking has caused irreversible damage to his lungs.
exampleCn: 吸烟已经对他的肺部造成了永久的损害。

en: making you feel annoyed
exampleEn: I found her extremely irritating.
exampleCn: 我觉得她极其令人恼火。

cn: 使处于危险境地；危及，损害
en: to put something such as a plan or system in danger of being harmed or damaged
exampleEn: She knew that by failing her finals she could jeopardize her whole future.
exampleCn: 她知道考试不及格会影响自己的整个前程。

cn: 无可非议的，有充分理由的
en: If something is justifiable, there is a good reason for it.
exampleEn: Her actions were quite justifiable in the circumstances.
exampleCn: 在那种情况下，她的行为是无可非议的。

cn: 为…辩护；证明…正当（或有理、正确）；是…的正当理由
en: to give or to be a good reason for
exampleEn: I can't really justify taking another day off work.
exampleCn: 我真的找不出理由再多休一天假了。

en: alone
exampleEn: He was a lone voice arguing against a reduction in payments.
exampleCn: 他是唯一反对减薪的人。

en: to persuade someone to do something or go somewhere by offering them something exciting
exampleEn: She was lured into the job by the offer of a high salary.
exampleCn: 她受高薪诱惑接受了那份工作。

cn: 极好的；壮丽的；令人羡慕的
en: very good, beautiful, or deserving to be admired
exampleEn: They live in a magnificent Tudor house.
exampleCn: 他们住在一座都铎时代的豪宅内。

cn: 易操作的，容易控制的；灵活的
en: easy to move and direct
exampleEn: The new missile is faster and more manoeuvrable than previous models.
exampleCn: 新型导弹比老型号速度更快，机动性更强。

en: to prevent something from being seen or noticed
exampleEn: I've put some flowers in there to mask the smell.
exampleCn: 我在那儿放了一些花来遮住那种味道。

en: Mature people behave like adults in a way that shows they are well developed emotionally.
exampleEn: He's very mature for his age.
exampleCn: 就他的年纪而言，他已非常成熟。

cn: （用于强调不大，不重要或效果不大）只不过的，仅仅的
en: used to emphasize that something is not large or important
exampleEn: The plane crashed mere minutes after take-off.
exampleCn: 飞机起飞后仅几分钟就坠毁了。

en: paying careful attention to every detail
exampleEn: Many hours of meticulous preparation have gone into writing the book.
exampleCn: 为了写这本书，我们做了许多小时的精心准备。

en: extremely small
exampleEn: All she gave him to eat was two minuscule pieces of toast.
exampleCn: 她只给他吃了两小片烤面包。

cn: 适中的；一定量的；一定规模的
en: in a way that is neither small nor large in size, amount, degree, or strength
exampleEn: The company remains moderately profitable, but it is not making as much money as it should.
exampleCn: 这家公司的利润不算可观，但它赚得不如应赚的多。

cn: 动量，冲量；冲力；推动力；势头
en: the force that keeps an object moving or keeps an event developing after it has started
exampleEn: Once you push it, it keeps going under its own momentum.
exampleCn: 一旦你推动了它，它就会在自己的动量作用下持续运动。

en: as you would expect; added to, or used to introduce, a remark giving information that is expected and not surprising
exampleEn: Needless to say, he'll be off work for a while.
exampleCn: 当然，他会暂停工作一段时间。

cn: 显要的；显著的；值得注意的
en: important and deserving attention, because of being very good or interesting
exampleEn: Getting both sides to agree was a notable achievement.
exampleCn: 使双方达成共识是一项显著的成就。

cn: 显而易见的，明显的，显著的
en: easy to see or recognize
exampleEn: There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's cooking.
exampleCn: 蒂姆的烹饪水平有了显著提高。

en: a belief or idea
exampleEn: The show's director rejects the notion that seeing violence on television has a harmful effect on children.
exampleCn: 节目制片人们并不认为看到电视上的暴力场景会对孩子们造成不良影响。

en: new and original, not like anything seen before
exampleEn: Keeping a sheep in the garden is a novel way of keeping the grass short!
exampleCn: 在花园里养只羊来阻止草长高，这办法可真新奇！

en: to force someone to do something, or to make it necessary for someone to do something
exampleEn: The law obligates companies to pay decent wages to their employees.
exampleCn: 法律强制公司向其雇员支付适当的工资。

en: to get something, especially by asking for it, buying it, working for it, or producing it from something else
exampleEn: First editions of these books are now almost impossible to obtain.
exampleCn: 这些书的第一版现在已几乎弄不到了。

en: best; most likely to bring success or advantage
exampleEn: A mixture of selected funds is an optimum choice for future security and return on investment.
exampleCn: 同时选择几种基金是确保未来投资安全和投资收益的最佳选择。

en: approximately
exampleEn: We stayed for an hour or so.
exampleCn: 我们待了一个小时左右。

en: to come from a particular place, time, situation, etc.
exampleEn: Although the technology originated in the UK, it has been developed in the US
exampleCn: 尽管这项技术起源于英国，但它在美国得到了发展。

cn: （强烈的感情）充溢，使难以承受，使不知所措
en: to cause someone to feel sudden strong emotion
exampleEn: I was overwhelmed by all the flowers and letters of support I received.
exampleCn: 收到这些鲜花和支持者的来信让我激动得不知所措。

en: If something paves the way for/to something else, it makes the other thing possible.
exampleEn: Scientists hope that data from the probe will pave the way for a more detailed exploration of Mars.
exampleCn: 科学家们希望探测飞船发回的数据会为更深入地探索火星提供条件。

en: happening repeatedly over a period of time
exampleEn: He suffers periodic mental breakdowns.
exampleCn: 他周期性地精神失常。

cn: （尤指因事故或遇害）丧生，死亡；消亡；毁灭
en: to die, especially in an accident or by being killed, or to be destroyed
exampleEn: He believes that Europe must create closer ties or it will perish.
exampleCn: 他认为整个欧洲必须建立更紧密的联系，否则就会灭亡。

cn: （指时间或空间上）处在…之前，先于
en: to be or go before something or someone in time or space
exampleEn: It would be helpful if you were to precede the report with an introduction.
exampleCn: 你给这份报告加上一段引言会更好些。

en: something that comes before a more important event or action that introduces or prepares for it
exampleEn: The changes are seen as a prelude to wide-ranging reforms.
exampleCn: 这些变化被视为大范围改革的序幕。

en: an idea or subject that someone thinks about most of the time
exampleEn: My main preoccupation now is trying to keep life normal for the sake of my two boys.
exampleCn: 我现在想得最多的是要为了我的两个儿子而尽力使生活保持正常。

cn: 先决条件，前提，必备条件
en: something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen
exampleEn: Passing a written test is a prerequisite for taking the advanced course.
exampleCn: 通过笔试是学习高级课程的前提。

en: mainly
exampleEn: The advertising campaign is aimed principally at women.
exampleCn: 广告大战主要瞄准了女性。

en: to announce something publicly or officially, especially something positive
exampleEn: All the countries have proclaimed their loyalty to the alliance.
exampleCn: 所有的国家都表明了他们对联盟的忠诚。

en: deeply or extremely
exampleEn: Society has changed so profoundly over the last 50 years.
exampleCn: 在过去的五十年里，社会发生了如此深刻的变化。

en: to officially refuse to allow something
exampleEn: Motor vehicles are prohibited from driving in the town centre.
exampleCn: 机动车辆禁止在市中心行驶。

en: to increase a lot and suddenly in number
exampleEn: Small businesses have proliferated in the last ten years.
exampleCn: 在过去的十年里，小型企业大量涌现。

en: continuing for a long time
exampleEn: Prolonged use of the drug is known to have harmful side-effects.
exampleCn: 据了解，长期服用此药会产生对人体有害的副作用。

en: to make something happen
exampleEn: The bishop's speech has prompted an angry response from both political parties.
exampleCn: 主教的发言激起了两大政党的愤怒回应。

en: the number or amount of a group or part of something when compared to the whole
exampleEn: Children make up a large proportion of the world's population.
exampleCn: 孩子占世界人口的很大一部分。

en: to offer or suggest a possible plan or action for other people to consider
exampleEn: I propose that we wait until the budget has been announced before committing ourselves to any expenditure.
exampleCn: 我建议我们在预算没有宣布以前不要有任何支出。

en: the act of trying to achieve a plan, activity, or situation, usually over a long period of time
exampleEn: The company is ruthless in its pursuit of profit.
exampleCn: 公司为追求利润不择手段。

en: to accept or continue to accept an unpleasant situation or experience, or someone who behaves unpleasantly
exampleEn: I can put up with the house being messy, but I hate it if it's not clean.
exampleCn: 房子凌乱我能忍受，但我讨厌房子不干净。

en: a long search for something that is difficult to find, or an attempt to achieve something difficult
exampleEn: Nothing will stop them in their quest for truth.
exampleCn: 没有什么可以阻止他们对真理的追求。

en: a good understanding of someone and an ability to communicate well with them
exampleEn: She has an excellent rapport with her staff.
exampleCn: 她和手下员工关系十分融洽。

en: A reciprocal action or arrangement involves two people or groups of people who behave in the same way or agree to help each other and give each other advantages.
exampleEn: Our relationship is based on reciprocal respect.
exampleCn: 我们的关系是以互相尊重为基础的。

en: to make someone have a feeling that they had in the past
exampleEn: The holiday was a last chance to rekindle their love.
exampleCn: 这次休假是使他们重新燃起爱情之火的最后一次机会。

cn: 有关的；有联系的；相关的
en: connected
exampleEn: We discussed unemployment and related issues.
exampleCn: 我们探讨了失业及相关问题。

cn: 给…展期，延长…的期限；更新，更换
en: to increase the life of or replace something old
exampleEn: Every year I renew my membership of the sports club.
exampleCn: 我每年都将体育俱乐部会员资格续期。

cn: 补充；把…再备足；重新装满
en: to fill something up again
exampleEn: Food stocks were replenished with imports from abroad.
exampleCn: 粮食储备通过从国外进口得到了补充。

cn: 赶走，驱逐；击退（尤指进攻）；拒绝，拒绝接受
en: to push away or refuse something or someone unwanted, especially to successfully stop a physical attack against you
exampleEn: The enemy attack was quickly repulsed.
exampleCn: 敌人的进攻很快被击退了。

en: the act of fighting against something that is attacking you, or refusing to accept something
exampleEn: There's a lot of resistance to the idea of a united Europe.
exampleCn: 很多人反对欧洲大一统的想法。

en: the unpleasant or severe conditions of something
exampleEn: They survived the rigours of the winter.
exampleCn: 他们熬过了严冬。

cn: 分散的；散布的；疏疏落落的
en: covering a wide area
exampleEn: My family is scattered all over the world.
exampleCn: 我的家人遍布世界各地。

en: N/A
exampleEn: The Stock Exchange is very sensitive to political change.
exampleCn: 证券市场对政局变化非常敏感。

en: to start a machine or process
exampleEn: We filled in a form to set the whole process in motion.
exampleCn: 我们填写了表格，启动一整套程序。

en: a reduction in the size of something, or the process of becoming smaller
exampleEn: Synthetic fabrics are less susceptible to shrinkage than natural ones.
exampleCn: 化纤布料比天然布料不易缩水。

cn: （尤指头发、衣服）平滑发亮的，整洁的；（外形）线条流畅的
en: (especially of hair, clothes, or shapes) smooth, shiny, and lying close to the body, and therefore looking well cared for; not untidy and with no parts sticking out
exampleEn: The cat had sleek fur.
exampleCn: 那只猫的皮毛油光发亮。

en: a situation in which something stays the same and does not grow and develop
exampleEn: Despite more than 10 years of economic stagnation, the unemployment rate remains low.
exampleCn: 尽管经济萧条了十年，失业率仍然处于低位。

cn: 战略；策略；计谋；行动计划；策划，部署
en: a detailed plan for achieving success in situations such as war, politics, business, industry, or sport, or the skill of planning for such situations
exampleEn: The president held an emergency meeting to discuss military strategy with the Pentagon yesterday.
exampleCn: 总统昨天召开紧急会议，跟五角大楼商讨军事战略

cn: 费力的，费劲的；繁重的；耗费精力的
en: needing or using a lot of physical or mental effort or energy
exampleEn: He rarely does anything more strenuous than changing the channels on the television.
exampleCn: 他很少做比换电视频道更费神的事。

en: to make someone or something experience an unpleasant or worrying thing
exampleEn: The investigation found that they had been subjected to unfair treatment.
exampleCn: 调查发现他们曾受到过不公正待遇。

en: in a way that is not complete and involves only the most obvious things
exampleEn: The arguments were very superficially discussed.
exampleCn: 这些论点得到了非常肤浅的讨论。

en: If small pieces of solid material are suspended in a gas or a liquid, they hang or float in the gas or liquid.
exampleEn: The drug is suspended in a saline solution.
exampleCn: 这种药悬浮在生理盐水中。

en: to turn on something
exampleEn: She emptied both their mugs and switched on the electric kettle.
exampleCn: 她倒空了他们俩的杯子，然后打开了电水壶。

en: the mixing of different ideas, influences, or things to make a whole that is different, or new
exampleEn: He describes his latest record as "a synthesis of African and Latin rhythms".
exampleCn: 他说他的最新唱片“融合了非洲和拉丁音乐的韵律”。

en: to give something a name or to describe it with a particular expression
exampleEn: Technically, a horse that is smaller than 1.5 metres at the shoulder is termed a pony.
exampleCn: 严格地说，肩高低于一点五米的马称为矮种马。

en: with the help of; because of
exampleEn: Thanks to mobile libraries, these people can still borrow books.
exampleCn: 由于有了移动图书馆，这些人仍然可以借书。

en: completely, very much
exampleEn: I thoroughly enjoyed the performance.
exampleCn: 我非常喜欢这个演出。

en: a feeling of extreme excitement, usually caused by something pleasant
exampleEn: It gave me a real thrill to see her again after so many years.
exampleCn: 这么多年以后与她重逢，着实令我激动。

cn: 欣欣向荣的，繁华的，兴旺的
en: growing, developing, or being successful
exampleEn: The place has rapidly developed from a small fishing community into a thriving tourist resort.
exampleCn: 这地方由原来的小渔村迅速发展成一个繁荣的旅游胜地。

en: a very slight amount
exampleEn: Traces of drugs were found in his blood.
exampleCn: 在他的血液中发现了少许毒品。

en: to pass something from one person or place to another
exampleEn: Somehow your panic and fear transmits itself to the horse that you're riding.
exampleCn: 不知怎么的，你的恐惧会传染给你骑的马。

en: If a substance or object is transparent, you can see through it very clearly.
exampleEn: Grow the bulbs in a transparent plastic box, so the children can see the roots growing.
exampleCn: 把球茎种在透明的塑料盒里，这样孩子们就能看到根的生长。

cn: （经历）痛苦难忘的，造成精神创伤的
en: If an experience is traumatic, it causes you severe emotional shock and upset.
exampleEn: Some of the most disturbed children had witnessed really traumatic things, such as rape and murder.
exampleCn: 有些心理极不正常的孩子曾经目睹过给他们造成精神创伤的事情，例如强奸和谋杀。

en: very great in amount or level, or extremely good
exampleEn: They were making a tremendous amount of noise last night.
exampleCn: 昨晚他们弄出的噪声震天响。

en: to be characteristic of something
exampleEn: His latest book reflects the old preoccupations with sex and religion that typify much of his work.
exampleCn: 他的新书反映了人们历来对于性和宗教的关注，这也是他大部分作品的特点。

en: continuing and unlikely to stop or become less
exampleEn: The authors are grateful for the unceasing support of the editors in London and New York.
exampleCn: 作者们非常感激伦敦和纽约两地编辑们的不懈支持。

cn: 是…的深层原因；对…有重大影响
en: to be a hidden cause of or strong influence on something
exampleEn: Psychological problems very often underlie apparently physical disorders.
exampleCn: 心理问题常常是明显生理疾病的深层原因。

cn: （开始）做，承担，从事（尤指耗时或困难之事）
en: to do or begin to do something, especially something that will take a long time or be difficult
exampleEn: Students are required to undertake simple experiments.
exampleCn: 要求学生们做些简单的实验。

en: to a level that is more than is necessary, acceptable, or reasonable
exampleEn: Such a high increase will impose an undue burden on the local tax payer.
exampleCn: 涨幅如此之高会给当地纳税人增加过度负担。

en: the speed at which an object is travelling
exampleEn: Light travels at the highest achievable velocity in the universe.
exampleCn: 光的传播速度是宇宙中物体所能达到的最高速度。

en: ability to continue to exist or develop as a living being
exampleEn: As the world population of Hawaiian geese has shrunk to very small numbers, the bird's continuing viability is in doubt.
exampleCn: 全球范围内夏威夷雁已经所剩无几，这种鸟能否继续繁衍下去让人怀疑。

en: energy and strength
exampleEn: According to the packet, these vitamin pills will restore lost vitality.
exampleCn: 据包装上的说明，这些维生素片可以恢复活力。

en: not having something; lacking
exampleEn: The new system was tried and found wanting.
exampleCn: 这一新系统经测试发现不够好。

en: something that makes you understand there is a possible danger or problem, especially one in the future
exampleEn: There's a warning on the cigarette packet that says "Cigarettes cause cancer".
exampleCn: 香烟的包装盒上有一条警告：“烟草严重危害健康。”

en: To wipe out something such as a place or a group of people or animals means to destroy them completely.
exampleEn: The disease threatens to wipe out the entire population.
exampleCn: 这种疾病有可能毁灭整个种群。

en: to cause something to happen
exampleEn: Mr Simmonds has wrought considerable changes in the company.
exampleCn: 西蒙兹先生已使这家公司发生了巨大的变化。

en: to reach, enter or use sth
exampleEn: The loft can be accessed by a ladder.
exampleCn: 搭梯子可以上阁楼。

en: in a way that is suitable or right for the situation
exampleEn: When we receive your instructions we will act accordingly.
exampleCn: 我们接到你的指令就会遵命行事。

en: near, next to, or touching
exampleEn: We asked for adjoining rooms.
exampleCn: 我们要了相邻的房间。

en: able to be changed to suit particular needs
exampleEn: The height of the bicycle seat is adjustable.
exampleCn: 这辆自行车车座的高度可以调节。

en: in a way that has a negative or harmful effect:
exampleEn: Price changes must not adversely affect the living standards of the people.
exampleCn: 价格变化一定不能负面地影响人们的生活水平。

cn: 好斗的；富于攻击性的；挑衅的
en: behaving in an angry threatening way, as if you want to fight or attack someone
exampleEn: If I criticize him, he gets aggressive and starts shouting.
exampleCn: 如果我批评他，他就会寻衅大吵大闹。

en: to give something to someone as their share of a total amount, to use in a particular way
exampleEn: More resources are being allocated to the project.
exampleCn: 正在调拨更多的资源给这个项目。

en: different from the usual
exampleEn: Do you have an alternative solution?
exampleCn: 你有没有别的解决办法？

en: completely
exampleEn: I don't altogether agree with you.
exampleCn: 我不完全同意你的意见。

cn: 集聚，积累，大量收集（尤指钱或信息）
en: to get a large amount of something, especially money or information, by collecting it over a long period
exampleEn: She has amassed a huge fortune from her novels.
exampleCn: 她靠写小说慢慢积攒了一大笔钱。

cn: 相似的；类似的；可比拟的
en: having similar features to another thing and therefore able to be compared with it
exampleEn: The emergency vehicle for the International Space Station is analogous to a lifeboat.
exampleCn: 国际空间站的应急车辆类似于救生艇。

en: to study or examine something in detail, in order to discover more about it
exampleEn: We should analyze the cause and effect of this event.
exampleCn: 我们应该分析这场事变的因果。

en: having life
exampleEn: We are animate beings, living creatures.
exampleCn: 我们是有生命的存在，有生命的动物。

en: to make something known or tell people about something officially
exampleEn: She announced the winner of the competition to an excited audience.
exampleCn: 她向激动的观众宣布了比赛的获胜者。

cn: 匿名的；不知姓名的；名字不公开的
en: made or done by someone whose name is not known or not made public
exampleEn: The money was donated by a local businessman who wishes to remain anonymous .
exampleCn: 这笔款子是当地一位不愿透露姓名的企业家捐赠的。

cn: 使对抗，使对立；引起…的敌意（或反感）
en: to make someone dislike you or feel opposed to you
exampleEn: Not wishing to antagonize her further, he said no more.
exampleCn: 他不愿惹她更生气，便不再说话。

cn: （尤指作为后来存在或发生之事的起因或起源的）前事，前情，先例；祖先
en: someone or something existing or happening before, especially as the cause or origin of something existing or happening later
exampleEn: Charles Babbage's mechanical calculating engines were the antecedents of the modern computer.
exampleCn: 查尔斯•巴贝奇的机械计算机是现代计算机的前身。

en: worried and nervous
exampleEn: I saw my sister's anxious face at the window.
exampleCn: 我看到了窗口姐姐那张忧心忡忡的脸。

cn: 有吸引力的；有感染力的；令人感兴趣的
en: attractive or interesting
exampleEn: He had a nice smile and an appealing personality.
exampleCn: 他的微笑非常迷人，个性也充满魅力。

en: The appliance of a skill or of knowledge is its use for a particular purpose.
exampleEn: These advances were the result of the intellectual appliance of science.
exampleCn: 这些进步是巧妙应用科学的结果。

en: to accept, allow, or officially agree to something
exampleEn: He doesn't approve of smoking.
exampleCn: 他反对抽烟。

en: one part of a situation, problem, subject, etc.
exampleEn: Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?
exampleCn: 你最喜欢这个工作的哪些方面？

en: very great surprise
exampleEn: To the astonishment of her colleagues, she resigned.
exampleCn: 她竟然辞职了，这让她的同事们大吃一惊。

cn: 真的；真正的；可靠的；可信的
en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.
exampleEn: I don't know if the painting is authentic.
exampleCn: 我不知道这幅画是不是真迹。

en: to make a process in a factory or office operate by machines or computers, in order to reduce the amount of work done by humans and the time taken to do the work
exampleEn: Massive investment is needed to automate the production process.
exampleCn: 要实现生产过程的自动化需要大量的投资。

en: simple and not complicated, so able to provide the base or starting point from which something can develop
exampleEn: The crisis has led to price rises in basic foodstuffs, such as meat, cheese, and sugar.
exampleCn: 危机导致了肉、奶酪、糖等基本食品价格的上涨。

en: the action of supporting or opposing a particular person or thing in an unfair way, because of allowing personal opinions to influence your judgment
exampleEn: There was clear evidence of a strong bias against her.
exampleCn: 有明显证据表明，她受到了严重的不公平待遇。

en: the accepted or furthest limits of sth
exampleEn: What you did was beyond the bounds of acceptable behaviour.
exampleCn: 你的所作所为令人无法接受。

en: an increase, especially one that is gradual
exampleEn: The build-up of troops in the region makes war seem more likely.
exampleCn: 在这一地区集结军队加大了战争爆发的可能性。

en: able to float
exampleEn: Cork is light and buoyant.
exampleCn: 软木质轻，可浮在水上。

en: to develop or grow quickly
exampleEn: Love burgeoned between them.
exampleCn: 他们双双迅速坠入爱河。

en: If a place is bustling, it is full of busy activity.
exampleEn: This used to be a bustling town but a lot of people have moved away over recent years.
exampleCn: 这儿曾经是个繁荣的市镇，但近年来许多人都搬走了。

en: the ability to do something
exampleEn: These tests are beyond the capability of an average twelve-year-old.
exampleCn: 这些测试超出了一个普通十二岁孩子的能力。

en: to succeed in getting something when you are competing with other people
exampleEn: The company has captured 90% of the market.
exampleCn: 这家公司已争取到九成的市场份额。

cn: 不小心的；粗心的，马虎的
en: not taking or showing enough care and attention
exampleEn: My son's teacher says that his work is often rather careless.
exampleCn: 我儿子的老师说他做作业经常粗心大意。

en: a sudden event that causes very great trouble or destruction
exampleEn: They were warned of the ecological catastrophe to come.
exampleCn: 他们收到警告，生态灾难即将来临。

cn: 首要的；最重要的；最主要的
en: most important or main
exampleEn: The chief problem we have in the area now is the spread of disease.
exampleCn: 目前我们在这一地区面临的首要问题是疾病的蔓延。

cn: （尤指疾病或不好的事物）慢性地，长期地
en: in a way that continues or has continued for a long time
exampleEn: Officials say that the agency is chronically underfunded and understaffed.
exampleCn: 官员们说，这个机构长期资金不足，人手不够。

cn: 按事件发生的年代顺序排列的
en: following the order in which a series of events happened
exampleEn: Give me the dates in chronological order.
exampleCn: 把日期按早晚顺序给我。

cn: 澄清；阐明；使更清晰易懂
en: to make something clear or easier to understand by giving more details or a simpler explanation
exampleEn: Could you clarify the first point please? I don't understand it completely.
exampleCn: 请你把第一点再阐释一下，好吗？我没有完全明白。

en: to work with someone else for a special purpose
exampleEn: Two writers collaborated on the script for the film.
exampleCn: 两位作家合写了这部电影的剧本。

cn: 联合组织；联合体；集体企业
en: an organization or business that is owned and controlled by the people who work in it
exampleEn: He will see that he is participating in all the decisions of the collective.
exampleCn: 他要确保他在参与集体企业的所有决策。

en: to force someone to do something
exampleEn: The new circumstances compelled a change in policy.
exampleCn: 新情况迫使在政策上作出改变。

cn: 难懂的，费解的；错综复杂的
en: difficult to understand or find an answer to because of having many different parts
exampleEn: It's a very complex issue to which there is no straightforward answer.
exampleCn: 这个问题错综复杂，没有简单直接的答案。

en: the act or process of calculating an answer or amount by using a machine
exampleEn: The amount due was a simple matter of mathematical computation.
exampleCn: 应付金额是一个简单的数学计算问题。

en: to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true
exampleEn: The government has conceded that the new tax policy has been a disaster.
exampleCn: 政府承认新的税收政策是彻底失败的。

cn: 遵守，遵照；符合，达到；依照
en: to obey a rule or reach the necessary stated standard, or to do things in a traditional way
exampleEn: Relations of production must conform to the level of productive forces.
exampleCn: 生产关系必须适合生产力。

en: to consider or show a person or thing to be related to someone or something else
exampleEn: She's an actress I connect with the theatre rather than films.
exampleCn: 这个女演员让我联想到的是戏剧而不是电影。

cn: （常指不好或不利的）结果，后果
en: a result of a particular action or situation, often one that is bad or not convenient
exampleEn: Scientists think it is unlikely that any species will actually become extinct as a consequence of the oil spill.
exampleCn: 科学家们认为实际上不太可能会有什么物种因为石油泄漏而灭绝。

cn: 作为结果的；随之而来的；由此引起的
en: happening as a result of something
exampleEn: Our use of harmful chemicals and the consequent damage to the environment is a very serious matter.
exampleCn: 我们使用有害化学物品且因此对环境造成了破坏，这是件非常严重的事情。

cn: 一贯地；坚持地；始终如一地
en: in a way that does not change
exampleEn: The president has consistently denied the rumours.
exampleCn: 主席一直否认这些传言。

en: to form or make something
exampleEn: The under-18s constitute nearly 25 percent of the town's population.
exampleCn: 十八岁以下的人口占该城镇人口的近百分之二十五。

en: to get information or advice from a person, book, etc. with special knowledge on a particular subject
exampleEn: If the symptoms get worse, consult your doctor.
exampleCn: 如果症状恶化就要去就医。

en: to spend time considering a possible future action, or to consider one particular thing for a long time in a serious and quiet way
exampleEn: They were contemplating a move to California.
exampleCn: 他们打算搬到加利福尼亚去。

en: to compete in order to win something
exampleEn: He's contending against someone with twice his experience.
exampleCn: 他在和经验比他丰富一倍的人竞争。

en: in a way that is suitable for your purposes and needs and causes the least difficulty
exampleEn: The box conveniently folds flat when not in use.
exampleCn: 盒子在不使用时可以折叠起来，十分方便。

en: to persuade someone to do something
exampleEn: I hope this will convince you to change your mind.
exampleCn: 我希望这会说服你改变主意。

en: certain
exampleEn: I'm convinced that she is lying.
exampleCn: 我确信她在撒谎。

cn: 反直觉的；与预期相反的
en: Something that is counter-intuitive does not happen in the way you would expect it to.
exampleEn: These results seem counter-intuitive.
exampleCn: 这些结果似乎与预料的相反。

en: the point at which an event or series of events ends, having developed until it reaches this point
exampleEn: He reached the culmination of his career after twenty year of hard work.
exampleCn: 他在努力工作二十年之后达到了事业的顶点。

en: of the present time
exampleEn: The company was unable to match his current salary.
exampleCn: 当时公司付不起和他现在相同的工资。

en: to become gradually damaged, worse, or less; to cause something to do this
exampleEn: Most of the crops had decayed in waterlogged fields.
exampleCn: 大多数庄稼都在淹水的田里烂掉了。

cn: 正派的；体面的，正经的；像样的，相当不错的
en: socially acceptable or good
exampleEn: But, after a decent interval, trade relations began to return to normal.
exampleCn: 但是在一段适当的间断之后，贸易关系开始恢复正常。

cn: 有欺骗性的，骗人的；造成假象的
en: making you believe something that is not true
exampleEn: One should never judge a person by mere external appearances because appearances are deceptive.
exampleCn: 永远不要只通过外表来评判一个人，因为外表具有欺骗性。

en: to reach an answer or a decision by thinking carefully about the known facts
exampleEn: We cannot deduce very much from these figures.
exampleCn: 我们无法从这些数字中推断出太多东西。

en: a fault or problem in something or someone that spoils that thing or person or causes it, him, or her not to work correctly
exampleEn: There are so many defects in our education system.
exampleCn: 我们的教育体制缺陷太多了。

cn: 最终的，决定性的；不可更改的
en: not able to be changed or improved
exampleEn: The problem is that there's no definitive answer.
exampleCn: 但问题是始终得不出一个最后的答案。

en: the process in which the beauty or quality of something is destroyed or spoiled
exampleEn: Rallies all over the United States were organized to protest environmental degradation.
exampleCn: 在美国，人们组织了很多集会，以抗议环境恶化。

en: intentionally
exampleEn: I'm sure he says these things deliberately to annoy me.
exampleCn: 我敢肯定他是故意说这些来气我的。

en: needing to be done carefully
exampleEn: Repairing damaged nerves is a very delicate operation/process.
exampleCn: 修复受损神经的手术需要非常小心谨慎。

cn: 需要，要求（时间、精力、特定数量等）
en: to need something such as time, effort, or a particular quality
exampleEn: This sport demands both speed and strength.
exampleCn: 这项运动既需要速度也需要体力。

en: in a way that can be proved
exampleEn: The Arctic regions of North America, Europe, and much of Russia are all becoming demonstrably warmer.
exampleCn: 北美、欧洲和俄罗斯大部分地区的北极地区都明显变暖。

en: to represent something
exampleEn: The colour red is used to denote passion or danger.
exampleCn: 红色用于表示激情或危险。

en: to represent or show something in a picture or story
exampleEn: he writer depicted country life before the industrial revolution.
exampleCn: 作家描写了工业革命前的乡村生活。

en: the way that something is represented or shown
exampleEn: I disapprove of the depiction of violence on television.
exampleCn: 我反对电视节目中的暴力描写。

en: a reduction in something
exampleEn: Increased expenditure has caused a depletion in our funds.
exampleCn: 开支增加使我们的资金减少了。

en: the fact of noticing or discovering something
exampleEn: Early detection of the cancer improves the chances of successful treatment.
exampleCn: 癌症及早发现会提高治愈的机率。

en: the act of moving away from what is normal or acceptable; a difference from what is expected or acceptable
exampleEn: The deviation from the previously accepted agreement cannot be forgiven.
exampleCn: 违背事先接受的协议是不可原谅的。

cn: 极其糟糕的；极为失败的；灾难性的
en: extremely bad or unsuccessful
exampleEn: Such a war would be disastrous for the country.
exampleCn: 这样一场战争会给国家带来灾难性的后果。

en: to see, recognize, or understand something that is not clear
exampleEn: I could just discern a figure in the darkness.
exampleCn: 在黑暗中我只能看出一个人影。

cn: 能看出的；可辨别出的；能明白的
en: able to be seen or understood
exampleEn: His face was barely discernible in the gloom.
exampleCn: 在黑暗中很难看得清他的脸。

cn: （尤指对正式建议、计划或普遍看法的）不同意，异议
en: a strong difference of opinion on a particular subject, especially about an official suggestion or plan or a popular belief
exampleEn: When the time came to approve the proposal, there were one or two voices of dissent.
exampleCn: 在通过该项提案的时候，有一两个人表示不同意。

en: changed from the usual, original, natural, or intended form
exampleEn: A distorted sex ratio will result in many social problems.
exampleCn: 一个被毁坏的性别比率将导致许多社会问题。

cn: 使分心，使转移注意力，干扰
en: to make someone stop giving their attention to something
exampleEn: He tried to distract attention from his own illegal activities.
exampleCn: 他试图转移人们对其非法活动的注意。

en: to give something out to several people, or to spread or supply something
exampleEn: Leaf veins distribute food and water throughout the leaf.
exampleCn: 叶脉把养料和水分分配给整张叶子。

en: to start to include more different types or things
exampleEn: Millions of years ago, changes in the earth's climate caused animal and plant life to diversify.
exampleCn: 数百万年前，地球气候的变化导致了动植物的多样化。

en: the fact of many different types of things or people being included in something; a range of different things or people
exampleEn: Conservationists are mostly wedded to preserving diversity in nature.
exampleCn: 自然环境保护主义者大多致力于保持物种的多样性。

cn: 主要的；主导的；占优势的
en: more important, strong, or noticeable than anything else of the same type
exampleEn: Unemployment will be a dominant issue at the next election.
exampleCn: 失业将成为下届选举中的主要辩论问题。

en: to have control over a place or person
exampleEn: Fathers have the power to dominate children and young people.
exampleCn: 父辈们有控制孩子们和年轻人的能力。

cn: 毫无疑问，毋庸置疑，肯定
en: used to mean that you are certain that something will happen or is true
exampleEn: They will doubtless protest, but there's nothing they can do.
exampleCn: 他们肯定会提出抗议，但却也无能为力。

en: to reduce or cause something to reduce
exampleEn: War drains a nation of its youth and its wealth.
exampleCn: 战争消耗掉的是国家的青年和财富。

en: as a result of
exampleEn: The coast road is closed due to bad weather.
exampleCn: 由于天气恶劣，滨海公路暂时封闭。

cn: 不拘一格的；兼收并蓄的；博采众长的
en: Methods, beliefs, ideas, etc. that are eclectic combine whatever seem the best or most useful things from many different areas or systems, rather than following a single system.
exampleEn: She has very eclectic tastes in literature.
exampleCn: 她在文学方面的兴趣非常广泛。

en: to appear by coming out of something or out from behind something
exampleEn: She emerged from the sea, blue with cold.
exampleCn: 她浮出了海面，浑身冻得发青。

en: starting to exist
exampleEn: In this newly emerging economic order, workers sometimes organized to protect their rights and traditional ways of life.
exampleCn: 在这个新兴的经济秩序中，工人们有时会组织起来保护他们的权利和传统的生活方式。

en: the part of a place or thing that is furthest away from the centre
exampleEn: We've travelled from one end of Mexico to the other.
exampleCn: 我们从墨西哥的一端旅行到了另一端。

en: an attempt to do something
exampleEn: In spite of our best endeavours, it has proven impossible to contact her.
exampleCn: 尽管我们尽了最大的努力，但最后还是未能联系上她。

cn: 费解的；难以捉摸的；神秘的
en: mysterious and impossible to understand completely
exampleEn: He left an enigmatic message on my answering machine.
exampleCn: 他在我的电话答录机中留了一条莫名其妙的留言。

en: extremely large
exampleEn: I was absolutely enormous when I was pregnant.
exampleCn: 我怀孕的时候，身体十分臃肿。

en: showing enthusiasm
exampleEn: He's always been very enthusiastic about sports.
exampleCn: 他对体育运动一直很有热情。

en: to cover or surround something completely
exampleEn: Clouds enveloped the mountain tops.
exampleCn: 云雾笼罩着山顶。

en: to imagine or expect something in the future, especially something good
exampleEn: It's hard to envisage how it might happen.
exampleCn: 真是难以设想怎么会发生这种事情。

en: in equal amounts
exampleEn: The inheritance money was shared equally among the three sisters.
exampleCn: 遗产的钱由三姐妹均分。

en: to build a building, wall, or other structure
exampleEn: The war memorial was erected in 1950.
exampleCn: 这座战争纪念碑建于一九五零年。

cn: （动作、行为等）不规则的，不确定的，无计划的
en: moving or behaving in a way that is not regular, certain, or expected
exampleEn: He drove in an erratic course down the road.
exampleCn: 他开车忽左忽右地在路上行驶。

cn: （因长期存在而）已确立的；被承认的；既定的
en: accepted or respected because of having existed for a long period of time
exampleEn: There are established procedures for dealing with emergencies.
exampleCn: 处理紧急情况有一些既定程序。

en: the process of starting or creating something, for example, an organization
exampleEn: The establishment of new areas of employment is a priority.
exampleCn: 创建新的就业领域是当务之急。

en: to judge or calculate the quality, importance, amount, or value of something
