exampleEn: We shall need to evaluate how the new material stands up to wear and tear.
exampleCn: 我们需要对新材料的耐磨损度作出鉴定。

en: in or into equal amounts
exampleEn: The meat is divided evenly and boiled in a stew.
exampleCn: 肉被均等地切开并在锅里炖。

cn: 引起，唤起（感情、记忆或形象）
en: to bring a feeling, a memory or an image into your mind
exampleEn: The music evoked memories of her youth.
exampleCn: 这乐曲勾起了她对青年时代的回忆。

cn: 筋疲力尽的；疲惫不堪的
en: very tired
exampleEn: She felt limp and exhausted.
exampleCn: 她感到浑身无力，累极了。

cn: 花费，消费，耗费（尤指时间、精力或钱）
en: to use or spend time, effort, or money
exampleEn: Governments expend a lot of resources on war.
exampleCn: 各国政府在战争上消耗了大量资源。

cn: （尤指科学方面）实验（性）的，试验（性）的，根据实验（试验）的
en: relating to tests, especially scientific ones
exampleEn: The changes to the distribution system are purely experimental at the moment.
exampleCn: 目前分配体系的变革纯粹是试验性的。

en: the use of something in order to get an advantage from it
exampleEn: Conservationists in Chile are concerned over the effect of commercial exploitation of forests.
exampleCn: 智利的自然保护者对森林商业化开发的后果感到担忧。

cn: 无遮蔽的；暴露于风雨中的
en: having no protection from bad weather
exampleEn: The house is in a very exposed position.
exampleCn: 这座房子孤零零的，毫无遮蔽。

en: very beautiful and delicate
exampleEn: We admired her exquisite handiwork.
exampleCn: 我们欣赏她精致的手工艺品。

en: long or longer than usual
exampleEn: There was an extended news bulletin because of the plane crash.
exampleCn: 因为发生了坠机事件，新闻简报的播出时间延长了。

en: very large in amount or degree
exampleEn: We are working under extreme pressure at the moment.
exampleCn: 目前我们正在极大的压力下工作。

cn: 凶猛的，凶恶的；激烈的；可怕的
en: frightening and violent
exampleEn: The president came in for some ferocious criticism.
exampleCn: 总统遭到了一些猛烈抨击。

en: the state of being frightening and violent
exampleEn: The hurricane hit with terrible ferocity.
exampleCn: 飓风以可怕的烈度袭来。

en: to make very small changes to something in order to make it work as well as possible
exampleEn: She spent hours fine-tuning her speech.
exampleCn: 她花了好几个小时对自己的讲稿作细微的修改润饰。

en: to repair something
exampleEn: They couldn't fix my old computer, so I bought a new one.
exampleCn: 他们修不好我的旧电脑了，所以我买了台新的。

en: arranged or decided already and not able to be changed
exampleEn: Many restaurants offer fixed-price menus.
exampleCn: 很多餐馆提供固定价格的菜单。

en: short or quick
exampleEn: This is just a fleeting visit.
exampleCn: 这只是一次短暂的访问。

cn: 可弯曲的；柔韧的；有弹性的
en: able to bend or to be bent easily without breaking
exampleEn: Copper wire is flexible.
exampleCn: 铜丝易弯曲。

en: to change, especially continuously and between one level or thing and another
exampleEn: Vegetable prices fluctuate according to the season.
exampleCn: 蔬菜价格随着季节变化而涨落。

en: in the past
exampleEn: The European Union was formerly called the European Community.
exampleCn: 欧盟旧称欧洲共同体。

cn: 可怕的；令人敬畏的；难对付的
en: causing you to have fear or respect for something or someone because that thing or person is large, powerful, or difficult
exampleEn: They had to overcome formidable obstacles.
exampleCn: 他们得克服重重障碍。

en: new or different
exampleEn: We need to take a fresh look at the problem.
exampleCn: 我们需要重新看待该问题。

cn: 普遍化，归纳陈述，给出普遍性的论述
en: a written or spoken statement in which you say or write that something is true all of the time when it is only true some of the time
exampleEn: Generalization can be dangerous.
exampleCn: 普遍化的概括可能会很危险。

en: to protect someone or something from being attacked or stolen
exampleEn: Soldiers guard the main doors of the embassy.
exampleCn: 大使馆的主要门口都有士兵把守。

cn: 庇护，窝藏，藏匿（罪犯或赃物）
en: to protect someone or something bad, especially by hiding that person or thing when the police are looking for him, her, or it
exampleEn: I will not harbor unhealthy thoughts anymore.
exampleCn: 我不会再庇护任何不健康的思想。

en: the quality of being unkind or severe
exampleEn: The harshness of the Canadian winter took them by surprise.
exampleCn: 加拿大冬天的严酷让他们大吃一惊。

en: something that is dangerous and likely to cause damage
exampleEn: The busy traffic entrance was a hazard to pedestrians.
exampleCn: 那个繁忙的车辆入口处对行人来说很不安全。

en: an animal that eats only plants
exampleEn: Cows and sheep are herbivores.
exampleCn: 牛和羊是食草动物。

en: to attract attention to or emphasize something important
exampleEn: The report highlights the need for improved safety.
exampleCn: 那份报告强调了加大安全力度的重要性。

en: to limit the ability of someone to do something, or to limit the development of something
exampleEn: High winds have hindered firefighters in their efforts to put out the blaze.
exampleCn: 大风妨碍了消防队员扑灭大火。

en: something that makes it more difficult for you to do something or for something to develop
exampleEn: I've never considered my disability a hindrance, but other people have.
exampleCn: 我从来没有把自己的残疾看成是一种障碍，可其他人不这么想。

cn: 由同类事物（或人）组成的；同类的；相似的
en: consisting of parts or people that are similar to each other or are of the same type
exampleEn: The population of the village has remained remarkably homogeneous.
exampleCn: 这个村庄的人口保持着显着的同族特征。

cn: （使）变均匀；（使）变纯一；（使）变类同
en: to change something so that all its parts or features become the same or very similar
exampleEn: TV has homogenized the culture and language of large parts of the planet.
exampleCn: 电视使地球上大部分地区的文化和语言同质化。

cn: 完全相同的；极为相似的
en: exactly the same, or very similar
exampleEn: The two rooms were virtually identical.
exampleCn: 这两个房间几乎一模一样。

en: not working or being used
exampleEn: Half these factories now stand idle.
exampleCn: 这些工厂如今有半数闲置。

en: not affected or upset by a particular type of behaviour or emotion
exampleEn: You'll eventually become immune to criticism.
exampleCn: 你终究会不用在乎批评了。

en: to give something a particular feeling, quality, or taste
exampleEn: Preservatives can impart colour and flavour to a product.
exampleCn: 防腐剂能使产品保持色泽和味道。

en: difficult to believe, or unlikely
exampleEn: The whole plot of the film is ridiculously implausible.
exampleCn: 影片的整个情节荒谬得令人难以置信。

en: very difficult or impossible to travel to
exampleEn: Parts of the forest are still dense and inaccessible.
exampleCn: 森林的一些地方仍然茂密不可进入。

en: not intentional
exampleEn: All authors need to be wary of inadvertent copying of other people's ideas.
exampleCn: 所有作者都需注意不要在无意中抄袭了他人的观点。

cn: 开创（新时代）；开始（新风尚或新活动）
en: to mark the beginning of a new period, style, or activity
exampleEn: The change of government inaugurated a new era of economic prosperity.
exampleCn: 政府的变革开创了经济繁荣的新时代。

en: the beginning of an organization or official activity
exampleEn: From the inception of our company, we have focused on communication.
exampleCn: 从创建公司开始，我们就关注沟通。

cn: 不显眼的，不引人注目的
en: not easily or quickly noticed or seen, or not attracting attention
exampleEn: This type of bird is very inconspicuous because of its dull feathers.
exampleCn: 这种鸟因其羽毛灰暗而毫不起眼。

cn: 不确定的；不清楚的；无限期的
en: not exact, not clear, or without clear limits
exampleEn: The project has been postponed for an indefinite period.
exampleCn: 这项目被无限期推迟了。

en: not good, but not very bad
exampleEn: She had starred in several very indifferent movies.
exampleCn: 她主演过几部表现非常一般的电影。

cn: 当地的；本土的，土生土长的
en: naturally existing in a place or country rather than arriving from another place
exampleEn: Are there any species of frog indigenous to the area?
exampleCn: 这一地区是否有本地品种的青蛙？

cn: 不容置疑的，无可争辩的
en: true, and impossible to doubt
exampleEn: It is indisputable that the crime rate has been rising.
exampleCn: 毫无疑问，犯罪率一直在上升。

cn: 难以区别的，难以分辨的
en: impossible to judge as being different when compared to another similar thing
exampleEn: These forgeries are so good that they are more or less indistinguishable from the originals.
exampleCn: 这些赝品很逼真，几乎没法将它们和真品区分开来。

en: not attractive
exampleEn: The grand piano has been replaced with a small, inelegant electric model.
exampleCn: 这架大钢琴被一架粗俗的小电子琴所取代。

en: in a way that cannot be explained or understood
exampleEn: Inexplicably, the men were never questioned about where the explosives came from.
exampleCn: 令人费解的是，这些人从未被问及炸药的来源。

cn: 渗透（入某物质、地方、系统或机构）
en: to move slowly into a substance, place, system, or organization
exampleEn: At about this time the new ideas about "corporate management" had begun to infiltrate into local government.
exampleCn: 大约此时，有关“共同管理”的一些新思想逐步开始为当地政府所接受

cn: 非正式的，非正规的；（服装）日常使用的；（言行）随意的
en: (of situations) not formal or official, or (of clothing, behaviour, speech) suitable when you are with friends and family but not for official occasions
exampleEn: The two groups agreed to hold an informal meeting.
exampleCn: 两个集团同意举行一次非正式会议。

en: to eat or drink something
exampleEn: The chemicals can be poisonous if ingested.
exampleCn: 这些化学制品如果摄入体内可能会引起中毒。

en: of or at the beginning
exampleEn: My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.
exampleCn: 我最初的惊讶很快变成了兴奋。

en: a new plan or process to achieve something or solve a problem
exampleEn: The peace initiative was welcomed by both sides.
exampleCn: 和平倡议受到了双方的欢迎。

cn: 新观念；新方法；（新观念或方法的）创造，使用
en: (the use of) a new idea or method
exampleEn: We must promote originality, inspire creativity and encourage innovation.
exampleCn: 我们必须提倡独创性，激发创造力，鼓励创新。

en: firmly saying that something must be true or done
exampleEn: The teacher is insistent that the school is not to blame for the situation.
exampleCn: 这位老师坚持说学校不应对这种情况承担责任。

en: to make someone feel that they want to do something and can do it
exampleEn: His confident leadership inspired his followers.
exampleCn: 他那自信的领导风采激励着他的追随者。

en: encouraging, or making you feel you want to do something
exampleEn: She was an inspiring example to her followers.
exampleCn: 她是令追随者振奋的楷模。

en: happening immediately, without any delay
exampleEn: Death was not instantaneous because none of the bullets hit the heart.
exampleCn: 因为没有一颗子弹射中心脏，所以没有即刻死亡。

en: in a planned or intended way
exampleEn: She was being intentionally unpleasant.
exampleCn: 她是故意耍态度的。

cn: 交流，交往；互相作用，互相影响
en: to communicate with or react to
exampleEn: Dominique's teacher says that she interacts well with the other children.
exampleCn: 多米尼克的老师说她与别的孩子相处得很好。

en: a period between two events or times
exampleEn: There is a 15-minute interval between two boats. 两艘船之间有十五分钟的间隔。

en: to intentionally become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse
exampleEn: The minister intervened personally to stop the museum from being closed.
exampleCn: 部长亲自干预以阻止博物馆的关闭。

en: happening between two times or between other events or activities
exampleEn: It was a long time since my last visit to Berlin, and it had changed dramatically in the intervening years.
exampleCn: 自从我上次去柏林已过了很长时间，这些年柏林发生了巨大的变化。

en: closely in a personal or sexual way
exampleEn: The two of them have been intimately involved for a year.
exampleCn: 他们两人已经亲密交往了一年。

en: very important and having a lot of influence on other people or things
exampleEn: She was a key figure in the international art world.
exampleCn: 她是国际艺术界的重要人物。

en: in a way that needs a lot of time and effort
exampleEn: McGinnis pushed himself laboriously out of the chair and waddled to the window.
exampleCn: 麦金尼斯吃力地从椅子上站起来，蹒跚走到了窗前。

en: relating to the sides of an object or plant or to sideways movement
exampleEn: Mr. Dawson walked into the court from a lateral door.
exampleCn: 道森先生从一个侧面的门走进法庭。

en: to take a long time to leave or disappear
exampleEn: After the play had finished, we lingered for a while in the bar hoping to catch sight of the actors.
exampleCn: 戏演完后我们在酒吧里等了一会儿，希望能与演员见上一面。

en: The literal meaning of a word is its original, basic meaning
exampleEn: You will need to show more than just a literal understanding of the text.
exampleCn: 你需要显示自己对文本的理解没有仅仅停留在字面含义上。

en: using the real or original meaning of a word or phrase
exampleEn: They were responsible for literally millions of deaths.
exampleCn: 他们的确对数百万人的死负有责任。

en: living for a long time
exampleEn: To what do you attribute your longevity?
exampleCn: 你的长寿归功于哪些因素？

cn: 易处理的；易办的；可应付的
en: easy or possible to deal with
exampleEn: The work has been divided into smaller, more manageable sections.
exampleCn: 这项工作被分解成又小又容易处理的几部分。

cn: 操纵（出于个人利益操纵某人某事，常指使用不公平或不诚信的方式）
en: controlling someone or something to your own advantage, often unfairly or dishonestly
exampleEn: There's been so much media manipulation of the facts that nobody knows the truth of the matter.
exampleCn: 媒体操控得太厉害，没人知道事情的真相。

cn: （通常指工厂利用机械大量）制造，（批量）生产
en: to produce goods in large numbers, usually in a factory using machines
exampleEn: He works for a company that manufactures car parts.
exampleCn: 他在一家生产汽车部件的公司工作。

en: consisting of separate parts that are connected to each other
exampleEn: The head contains the eyes and a pair of long, many-segmented antennae.
exampleCn: 头部包含眼睛和一对长而多节的触角。

en: in a very obvious or noticeable way
exampleEn: Eye-witness accounts of the fighting differ markedly from police reports of what happened.
exampleCn: 目击者对殴斗的描述与警方对事件的报道明显不同。

en: until something expected happens, or while something else is happening
exampleEn: Carl's starting college in September. Meanwhile, he's travelling around Europe.
exampleCn: 卡尔九月将开始大学生活。此间他将会环游欧洲。

cn: 普通的，平庸的，不够好的
en: not very good
exampleEn: Parents don't want their children going to mediocre schools.
exampleCn: 家长不想让自己的孩子去上普普通通的学校。

en: the quality of being good and deserving praise
exampleEn: Brierley's book has the merit of being both informative and readable.
exampleCn: 布赖尔利的书兼具内容丰富和可读性强的特点。

en: in a way that shows great care and attention to detail
exampleEn: The entire project was meticulously planned.
exampleCn: 整个项目经过了精心策划。

cn: 使降到最低限度；使减到最少
en: to reduce something to the least possible level or amount
exampleEn: We must minimize the risk of infection.
exampleCn: 我们必须将感染的风险降到最低。

en: extremely small
exampleEn: The documentary showed an eye operation in minute detail.
exampleCn: 这部纪录片纤毫毕现地展示了一次眼科手术的过程。

en: of the present or recent times, especially the period of history since around 1500
exampleEn: What do you think is the role of religion in the modern world?
exampleCn: 你如何看待宗教在现代社会中的角色？

en: Molten metal or rock is in a liquid state because of great heat.
exampleEn: An immense volume of rocks and molten lava was erupted.
exampleCn: 大量岩石和熔岩喷发出来。

cn: 单调乏味的；毫无变化的
en: not changing and therefore boring
exampleEn: The music became monotonous after a while.
exampleCn: 过了一会儿音乐变得单调起来。

en: standards for good or bad character and behaviour
exampleEn: Young people these days have no morals.
exampleCn: 现在的年轻人根本不讲道德。

en: a pattern or design
exampleEn: We chose some curtains with a flower motif.
exampleCn: 我们选择了一些带花卉图案的窗帘。

en: used when you want to give more detail or be more exact about something you have just said
exampleEn: We need to concentrate on our target audience, namely women aged between 20 and 30.
exampleCn: 我们须针对我们的听众对象，即年龄在二十到三十岁之间的妇女。

cn: （为选举、工作、职位或荣誉）提名，推荐
en: to officially suggest someone for an election, job, position, or honour
exampleEn: He's been nominated by the Green Party as their candidate in the next election.
exampleCn: 他被绿党提名为下届选举的候选人。

en: especially or most importantly
exampleEn: The company is beginning to attract investors, most notably big Japanese banks.
exampleCn: 这家公司开始吸引投资者，特别是日本大型金融会社。

cn: 臭名昭著的，声名狼藉的
en: famous for something bad
exampleEn: The company is notorious for paying its bills late.
exampleCn: 该公司出了名地喜欢拖欠账单。

en: a person who is not experienced in a job or situation
exampleEn: I'm a complete novice at skiing.
exampleCn: 滑雪我完全是个新手。

cn: 养育，培育（尤指幼儿或植物）
en: to take care of, feed, and protect someone or something, especially young children or plants, and help him, her, or it to develop
exampleEn: She wants to stay at home and nurture her children.
exampleCn: 她想留在家里照看孩子。

en: something that you plan to do or achieve
exampleEn: Her main objective now is simply to stay in power.
exampleCn: 她现在的主要目标就是继续掌权。

en: the fact that you are obliged to do something
exampleEn: If you have not signed a contract, you are under no obligation to pay them any money.
exampleCn: 如果你没有签合同，你就没有义务付给他们钱。

en: to try to stop something from happening or developing
exampleEn: He was charged with obstructing justice.
exampleCn: 他被控以妨碍司法公正。

cn: （指不愉快的事情）的开始，发作
en: the moment at which something unpleasant begins
exampleEn: The new treatment can delay the onset of the disease by several years.
exampleCn: 新的治疗方法可以把疾病开始的时间延后几年。

cn: （文字或演讲）难理解的；晦涩的；含糊的
en: Opaque writing or speech is difficult to understand.
exampleEn: I find her poetry a little too opaque.
exampleCn: 我发现她的诗相当晦涩。

en: opposed to or against a particular thing or person
exampleEn: Many protesters insist they are pacifists, opposed to war in all forms.
exampleCn: 许多抗议者坚持说他们是和平主义者，反对一切形式的战争。

en: hoping or believing that good things will happen in the future
exampleEn: She is optimistic about her chances of winning a gold medal.
exampleCn: 她对赢得金牌很乐观。

en: to make something as good as possible
exampleEn: We need to optimize our use of the existing technology.
exampleCn: 我们需要充分利用现有技术。

cn: 以…为目标；使面向；使适应
en: to aim something at someone or something, or make something suitable for a particular group of people
exampleEn: It is essential that the public sector orientates itself more towards the consumer.
exampleCn: 公共部门要更多地适应消费者，这是最基本的。

en: decoration
exampleEn: Male birds also have strange ornamentation on their skull.
exampleCn: 雄鸟头上也有奇异的装饰。

cn: 装饰华丽的，装饰繁复的
en: having a lot of complicated decoration
exampleEn: The style is ornate and highly decorative.
exampleCn: 这种风格很华丽，而且装饰效果很好。

cn: 铺张的，摆阔的；炫耀的，卖弄的；招摇的
en: too obviously showing your money, possessions, or power, in an attempt to make other people notice and admire you
exampleEn: They criticized the ostentatious lifestyle of their leaders.
exampleCn: 他们批评领导们铺张的生活方式。

en: a result or development
exampleEn: This policy is just an outgrowth of earlier decisions.
exampleCn: 这项政策不过是先前决议的产物。

cn: 远离城镇的；远离中心的；边远的
en: far away from main towns and cities, or far from the centre of a place
exampleEn: Many of the students travel in by bus from outlying areas.
exampleCn: 很多学生乘坐公共汽车从偏远地区到市区上学。

en: to fail to notice or consider something or someone
exampleEn: I think there is one key fact that you have overlooked.
exampleCn: 我认为你忽略了一个重要的事实。

en: extremely full of people
exampleEn: The restaurant was packed.
exampleCn: 餐馆里坐满了客人。

cn: 认真仔细的，精心的，费尽心思的
en: extremely careful and correct, and involving a lot of effort
exampleEn: It took months of painstaking research to write the book.
exampleCn: 这本书是经过好几个月的苦心研究才写出来的。

en: to allow something
exampleEn: The regulations do not permit much flexibility.
exampleCn: 这些规章不允许有太大的灵活性。

en: continuing for ever in the same way
exampleEn: They lived in perpetual fear of being discovered.
exampleCn: 他们长期生活在恐惧中，担心被发现。

en: to confuse and worry someone slightly by being difficult to understand or solve
exampleEn: The disease has continued to perplex doctors.
exampleCn: 这种病仍然困扰着医生们。

en: a particular way of considering something
exampleEn: Her attitude lends a fresh perspective to the subject.
exampleCn: 她的态度为这一问题提供了新的视角。

cn: 有说服力的，令人信服的
en: making you want to do or believe a particular thing
exampleEn: Your arguments are very persuasive.
exampleCn: 你的论据非常有说服力。

en: to be one of the first people to do something
exampleEn: It was universities that pioneered these new industries.
exampleCn: 是大学开创了这些新兴产业。

en: to fall very quickly and suddenly
exampleEn: House prices have plummeted in recent months.
exampleCn: 房价近几个月来暴跌。

cn: 强有力的，强大的；有效力的
en: very powerful, forceful, or effective
exampleEn: Surprise remains the terrorists' most potent weapon.
exampleCn: 突袭仍是恐怖分子最强有力的武器。

en: possibly
exampleEn: Hepatitis is a potentially fatal disease.
exampleCn: 肝炎是可能致命的疾病。

en: exactly
exampleEn: What do you think the problem is, precisely?
exampleCn: 确切地说，你认为问题在哪里？

cn: 前任，前辈；原有事物，前身
en: someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series
exampleEn: My predecessor worked in this job for twelve years.
exampleCn: 我的前任做这份工作做了十二年。

cn: 预先决定的，预先确定的；事先安排的
en: decided or arranged at an earlier time
exampleEn: When grain prices fall below a predetermined level, the government provides funds.
exampleCn: 当粮食价格低于预定水平时，政府会提供资金补贴。

en: the quality of being more important or better than others
exampleEn: His preeminence in his subject is internationally recognized.
exampleCn: 他在他研究中的卓越性得到了国际上的认可。

en: more important or powerful than all others
exampleEn: The dollar's preeminent position may be the first casualty of this shift.
exampleCn: 在这场剧变中，傲视群雄的美元将是第一个倒下的受害者。

en: coming before a more important action or event, especially introducing or preparing for it
exampleEn: We've decided to change the design based on our preliminary findings.
exampleCn: 我们决定依据初步调查的结果对设计方案进行更改。

cn: 假定…为先决条件，作为…的前提
en: to base a theory, argument, etc. on an idea, thought, or belief
exampleEn: He premised his argument on several incorrect assumptions.
exampleCn: 他把自己的论证建立在了几个错误的假设之上。

en: the act of keeping something the same or of preventing it from being damaged
exampleEn: There is great public concern about some of the chemicals used in food preservation.
exampleCn: 公众对一些用于食物保藏的化学物表示极为担忧。

en: existing very commonly or happening often
exampleEn: These diseases are more prevalent among young children.
exampleCn: 这些疾病在幼儿中更普遍。

en: before the present time or the time referred to
exampleEn: She was previously employed as a tour guide.
exampleCn: 她以前受聘当导游。

en: A priceless object has such a high value, especially because it is rare, that the price of it cannot be calculated.
exampleEn: A priceless collection of vases was destroyed.
exampleCn: 一批贵重的花瓶被毁坏了。

en: first in order of importance
exampleEn: Iraq's principal export is oil.
exampleCn: 伊拉克最重要的出口商品是石油。

en: to think that someone or something is very valuable or important
exampleEn: In parts of Asia this plant is prized for its medicinal qualities.
exampleCn: 在亚洲某些地区，这种植物因其药用价值而倍受重视。

en: to get something, especially after an effort
exampleEn: She's managed somehow to procure his phone number.
exampleCn: 她不知怎么设法弄到了他的电话号码。

en: the fact of having the skill and experience for doing something
exampleEn: The job ad said they wanted proficiency in at least two languages.
exampleCn: 招聘广告说他们希望至少精通两种语言。

en: the act of changing to the next stage of development
exampleEn: Drugs can slow down the progression of the disease.
exampleCn: 药物能减缓疾病的恶化。

en: developing or happening gradually
exampleEn: There's been a progressive decline in the standard of living over the past few years.
exampleCn: 最近几年的生活水平每况愈下。

en: producing a great number or amount of something
exampleEn: He was probably the most prolific songwriter of his generation.
exampleCn: 他可能是他这代人中最多产的歌曲作家。

en: very noticeable or certain
exampleEn: I'm told I have a very pronounced English accent when I speak French.
exampleCn: 有人告诉我说，我在说法语时有明显的英国口音。

en: an official announcement
exampleEn: The treasurer has been taking a more optimistic view of economic recovery in his recent public pronouncements.
exampleCn: 财政大臣在最近的公开发言中对经济复苏持更乐观的态度。

en: (of a plant or animal) to produce young plants or animals
exampleEn: Most house plants can be propagated from stem cuttings.
exampleCn: 大多数家养植物都能由切下来的茎繁殖。

cn: 适合的；适当的；恰当的；正确的
en: real, satisfactory, suitable, or correct
exampleEn: In those days it was not thought entirely proper for a woman to be on the stage.
exampleCn: 在那时，女人登台演出不被认为是完全适宜的。

cn: （人或企业）成功；（尤指经济上）繁荣，昌盛
en: (of a person or a business) to be or become successful, especially financially
exampleEn: Lots of microchip manufacturing companies prospered at that time.
exampleCn: 许多生产芯片的公司都是在那时候发达起来的。

en: used to say that something will only be possible if something else happens or is done.
exampleEn: The other banks are going to be very eager to help, provided that they see that he has a specific plan.
exampleCn: 如果他有一个具体的计划，其他的银行才会非常渴望提供资助。

cn: （时间、顺序等方面）近邻的；最接近的
en: next or nearest in space or time
exampleEn: In other words, we have to go beyond the proximate cause and probe further and further.
exampleCn: 换句话说，我们必须超越事物的近因，进一步讨论其起因。

en: careful and avoiding risks
exampleEn: It's always prudent to read a contract carefully before signing it.
exampleCn: 签合同前先好好看一下，这样做永远都是明智的。

en: happening, done, or chosen by chance rather than according to a plan
exampleEn: We asked a random sample/selection of people what they thought.
exampleCn: 我们随机挑选一些人，问了他们的想法。

en: not often
exampleEn: Rarely have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
exampleCn: 如此美丽的日落景象我真是难得一见。

en: instead of; used especially when you prefer one thing to another
exampleEn: I think I'd like to stay at home this evening rather than go out.
exampleCn: 我觉得我今晚更想呆在家里，而不是出去玩儿。

en: to bring the memory of a past event into your mind, and often to give a description of what you remember
exampleEn: The old man recalled the city as it had been before the war.
exampleCn: 这位老人回忆起战前这座城市的样子。

en: a memory of something
exampleEn: I have many pleasant recollections of the time we spent together.
exampleCn: 我们一起度过的时光给我留下了许多美好的回忆。

en: to find a way in which two situations or beliefs that are opposed to each other can agree and exist together
exampleEn: It is sometimes difficult to reconcile science and religion.
exampleCn: 有时很难调和宗教和科学之间的矛盾。

cn: （在疾病或受伤之后）完全恢复健康
en: to become completely well again after an illness or injury
exampleEn: It took her a long time to recover from/after her heart operation.
exampleCn: 她心脏动手术后很长时间身体才复原。

en: respect or admiration for someone or something
exampleEn: The company holds her in high regard.
exampleCn: 公司很器重她。

en: the degree to which something is related or useful to what is happening or being talked about
exampleEn: He claims that the laws are antiquated and have no contemporary relevance.
exampleCn: 他声称这些法规过于陈旧，已没有任何现实意义。

cn: 可信赖地；可靠地；真实可信地
en: in a way that can be trusted or believed
exampleEn: I am reliably informed that you have been talking about resigning from the company.
exampleCn: 我收到可靠的消息说你一直说要从公司辞职。

en: in a way that shows that you are not willing to do something and are therefore slow to do it
exampleEn: She reluctantly agreed to step down as managing director.
exampleCn: 她勉强同意辞去总经理的职务。

en: the state of being famous
exampleEn: Her renown spread across the country.
exampleCn: 她的名声传遍了全国。

en: to force something or someone to move away or stop attacking you
exampleEn: This coat has a special surface that repels moisture.
exampleCn: 这件外套面料特殊，可以防潮。

en: to take the place of something, or to put something or someone in the place of something or someone else
exampleEn: The factory replaced most of its workers with robots.
exampleCn: 这家工厂用机器人取代了大多数工人。

en: that can be done in exactly the same way as before, or produced again to be exactly the same as before
exampleEn: It is always stressed that scientific results must be replicable in order to be valid.
exampleCn: 我们一直强调，科学成果必须是可复制的，才是有效的。

en: to refuse to accept something or someone as true, good, or reasonable
exampleEn: He repudiated the allegation that he had tried to deceive them.
exampleCn: 他们指控他企图欺骗他们，他对此进行了驳斥。

en: to fight against something or someone that is attacking you
exampleEn: The soldiers resisted the enemy attacks for two days.
exampleCn: 面对敌人的进攻士兵们抵抗了两天。

en: limited, especially by official rules, laws, etc.:
exampleEn: Access to the club is restricted to members only.
exampleCn: 俱乐部仅对会员开放。

en: to find and bring back something
exampleEn: Computers are used to store and retrieve information efficiently.
exampleCn: 计算机用于快速高效地存储和检索信息。

en: to make known or show something that is surprising or that was previously secret
exampleEn: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.
exampleCn: 他因为向俄国人泄密而被监禁。

cn: 例行公事，老规矩；（尤指）仪式
en: a set of fixed actions and sometimes words performed regularly, especially as part of a ceremony
exampleEn: Coffee and the newspaper are part of my morning ritual.
exampleCn: 喝咖啡和读报纸是我早晨必做的事情之一。

en: very little and not enough
exampleEn: He pays scant attention to the needs of his children.
exampleCn: 他很少关注自己孩子的需求。

en: almost not
exampleEn: I was scarcely able to move my arm after the accident.
exampleCn: 那场事故以后，我的手臂几乎不能动了。

en: less important than related things
exampleEn: The need for secrecy is secondary to the need to take immediate action.
exampleCn: 即刻行动起来比保守秘密更重要。

cn: 非常严重的；剧烈的；惨重的
en: causing very great pain, difficulty, worry, damage, etc.; very serious
exampleEn: This is a school for children with severe learning difficulties.
exampleCn: 这是一所为有严重学习障碍的孩子设立的学校。

en: moving with quick, short movements from side to side, not in a controlled way
exampleEn: Soon after it was born, the calf got up and tried to stand on its shaky legs.
exampleCn: 小牛出生不久，就起身摇摇晃晃地想站住了。

en: to become smaller, or to make something smaller
exampleEn: Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.
exampleCn: 用温度过高的水洗毛衣，毛衣会缩水。

en: happening or being done at exactly the same time
exampleEn: There were several simultaneous explosions in different cities.
exampleCn: 几起爆炸在几个不同的城市同时发生。

en: small in amount or degree
exampleEn: I don't have the slightest idea what he's talking about.
exampleCn: 我一点儿也不明白他在说什么。

en: a little
exampleEn: She's slightly taller than her sister.
exampleCn: 她比她姐姐稍高一点儿。

en: being one only; single
exampleEn: My sole objective is to make the information more widely available.
exampleCn: 我唯一的目的就是让更多的人能了解到这些信息。

en: to encourage an activity or development or make it happen faster
exampleEn: Rising consumer sales have the effect of spurring the economy to faster growth.
exampleCn: 消费的增长有刺激经济加速发展的作用。

en: usual rather than special, especially when thought of as being correct or acceptable
exampleEn: White is the standard colour for this model of refrigerator.
exampleCn: 白色是这种型号的冰箱的标准色。

cn: 基本的，主要的；标准的，常规的
en: basic or main; standard or regular
exampleEn: The staple diet here is mutton, fish and boiled potatoes.
exampleCn: 这里以羊肉、鱼和煮马铃薯为主食。

en: staying in the same position; not moving
exampleEn: Children find it difficult to sit still for very long.
exampleCn: 儿童很难长时间坐着不动。

cn: 精确的，完全正确的；严谨的
en: exactly correct
exampleEn: He would be found guilty under a strict interpretation of the law.
exampleCn: 按照对法律的严谨阐释，他会被判有罪。

cn: （尤指长期或不畏艰难地）努力，奋斗，力争
en: to try very hard to do something or to make something happen, especially for a long time or against difficulties
exampleEn: In her writing she strove for a balance between innovation and familiar prose forms.
exampleCn: 她在写作中力图在创新和传统散文形式之间求得平衡。

en: after something else
exampleEn: He was badly injured in the crash and subsequently died.
exampleCn: 他在车祸中严重受伤，随后死亡。

en: in a way that is acceptable and right for something or someone
exampleEn: There are rules about dressing suitably.
exampleCn: 有关于穿着得体的规定。

en: the fact of believing something is true without any proof or something that you believe to be true without any proof
exampleEn: That article was based on pure supposition.
exampleCn: 那篇文章纯粹是基于推测。

en: to do or be better than
exampleEn: The book's success has surpassed everyone's expectations.
exampleCn: 这本书获得了出乎所有人意料的成功。

cn: 易受影响的，易受伤害的
en: easily influenced or harmed by something
exampleEn: These plants are particularly susceptible to frost.
exampleCn: 这些植物很容易受霜冻的影响

en: to change direction, especially suddenly
exampleEn: The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting a cyclist.
exampleCn: 为了不撞上骑自行车的人，这辆公共汽车只好急转弯。

en: to believe something to be the truth without even thinking about it
exampleEn: We take having an endless supply of clean water for granted.
exampleCn: 我们想当然地认为洁净水的供应无穷无尽而不予以珍惜。

en: Something that is tantalizing causes desire and excitement in you, but is unlikely to provide a way of satisfying that desire.
exampleEn: I caught a tantalizing glimpse of the sparkling blue sea through the trees.
exampleCn: 透过树丛，我瞥见了令我心驰神往的波光粼粼的蔚蓝色大海。

cn: 建立理论；从理论上说明
en: to develop a set of ideas about something
exampleEn: It's easy to theorize about what might have happened.
exampleCn: 对于原本可能发生的事情作理论上的推测是很容易的。

en: having a small distance between two opposite sides
exampleEn: A thin cable carries the signal to a computer.
exampleCn: 一条细电缆把信号传给一台计算机。

cn: 整齐的；整洁的，有条理的
en: having everything ordered and arranged in the right place, or liking to keep things like this
exampleEn: The house was clean and tidy.
exampleCn: 房子干净整洁。

en: partly
exampleEn: To some extent, she was responsible for the accident.
exampleCn: 她要为事故负部分责任。

en: a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving
exampleEn: Surveys show a trend away from home-ownership and toward rented accommodation.
exampleCn: 调查表明，出现了一种从私人拥有住房转向租赁住房的趋势。

cn: 微不足道的，琐碎的；没有价值的
en: having little value or importance
exampleEn: I don't know why he gets so upset about something so trivial.
exampleCn: 我不明白他因何为芝麻大的事儿也如此烦恼。

en: expressed in a way that makes it completely clear what is meant
exampleEn: The minister promised a clear and unambiguous statement on the future of the coal industry.
exampleCn: 部长称她将尽快就煤炭工业的前途问题作一个清楚明确的表示。

cn: 令人讨厌的；不受欢迎的
en: not wanted, approved of, or popular
exampleEn: Houses near industrial sites often do not sell so quickly because they are regarded as undesirable.
exampleCn: 工厂附近的房子销路不是很好，因为人们认为那里的环境不理想。

cn: 不道德的，不合乎道德标准的
en: not ethical (= based on moral beliefs)
exampleEn: A number of doctors came under suspicion of unethical behaviour.
exampleCn: 一些医生涉嫌有不道德行为。

cn: 独一无二的；与众不同的；唯一的；独特的；罕见的
en: being the only existing one of its type or, more generally, unusual, or special in some way
exampleEn: Each person's genetic code is unique except in the case of identical twins.
exampleCn: 每个人的遗传密码都是独一无二的，同卵双胞胎除外。

en: N/A
exampleEn: Upon reflection, I decided not to accept the status quo and follow someone else's path, but to create a new path.
exampleCn: 反思过后，我决定不再接受现状，不再重复别人的道路，我要开辟一条新的道路。

en: designed to be useful rather than decorative
exampleEn: Like many factories, it's a very ugly utilitarian building.
exampleCn: 和许多工厂一样，这是一座外表丑陋但很实用的建筑。

en: the quality of being based on truth or reason, or of being able to be accepted
exampleEn: We had doubts about the validity of their argument.
exampleCn: 我们对他们的论点的正确性有过怀疑。

cn: 活跃的；精力充沛的；热情洋溢的
en: energetic, exciting, and full of enthusiasm
exampleEn: Thailand is at its most vibrant during the New Year celebrations.
exampleCn: 在欢度新年期间，泰国举国欢腾。

cn: 必不可少的；极其重要的
en: necessary for the success or continued existence of something; extremely important
exampleEn: A strong opposition is vital to a healthy democracy.
exampleCn: 有一个强大的反对党对于健康的民主制度来说非常重要。

cn: （值得投入所有时间和精力的）职业，工作；（认为某种职业适合自己的）使命感
en: a type of work that you feel you are suited to doing and to which you should give all your time and energy, or the feeling that a type of work suits you in this way
exampleEn: I feel I've found my true vocation.
exampleCn: 我觉得找到了真正适合自己的职业。

en: to make a determined decision or promise to do something
exampleEn: The guerrillas vowed that they would overthrow the government.
exampleCn: 游击队发誓要推翻政府。

en: the fact or state of not being strong or powerful
exampleEn: Any change of policy will be interpreted as a sign of weakness.
exampleCn: 政策上的任何改變都會被當作是軟弱的表現。

cn: 崇拜上帝的人；做礼拜的人
en: someone who goes to a religious ceremony to worship God
exampleEn: The congregation of the worshipper of God was a traditional Chinese civil religion organization essentially.
exampleCn: 拜上帝会本质上是一个传统的中国民间宗教组织。

en: (and) despite that; used to add something that seems surprising because of what you have just said
exampleEn: He's overweight and bald, and yet somehow, he's attractive.
exampleCn: 他肥胖且秃头，然而不知为何却很有魅力。
